title: Adjustment of Meet-up Subsidy Policy / 布道会补贴政策调整
body:
🗳 POTS DAO Proposal｜Adjustment of Meet-up Subsidy Policy

📖 Proposal Background

As the POTS global market continues to expand, meet-ups have become an important means of driving community consensus, market education, and brand dissemination.

In the past, to encourage more teams to host meet-ups, the subsidy policy was open to applications from leaders at V2 level and above. After a period of implementation, we have accumulated extensive experience from these activities.

To further enhance the professionalism and content quality of meet-ups, while ensuring that subsidy resources deliver greater market value, we now present this DAO proposal for the community to decide whether to adjust the eligibility criteria for meet-up subsidies.

⸻

📋 Proposal Content

Current Scheme

Eligibility for meet-up subsidies: V2 and above

Proposed Adjustment

Eligibility for meet-up subsidies: V4 and above  
Completion of the "Studio" application and approval  
Completion of the "Beyond the Peak" course training  
Joined the Telegram V4-level group

Under the current meet-up subsidy scheme, subsidies are still calculated based on new performance and distributed in IBS rewards. This month's bonus incentive mechanism also remains unchanged.

⸻

🎯 Proposal Objective

The core goal of this adjustment is to improve subsidy efficiency. We aim to prioritize subsidy resources for leaders who possess the following capabilities:

Ability to independently host high-quality meet-ups  
Ability to accurately convey POTS core values  
Ability to continuously replicate market success and nurture new members  
Ability to uphold brand image and maintain consistent market messaging  
Ability to drive long-term and stable team growth

So that every meet-up is not just a sharing event, but becomes an important node in advancing the global ecosystem development.

⸻

🌍 Why Support This Proposal?

As POTS continues to expand its global presence, meet-ups no longer represent only individual teams, but also the overall POTS brand image.

Raising the application threshold represents greater responsibility and higher professional standards. It ensures that leaders who have completed training, demonstrated leadership capabilities, and can consistently replicate market success receive official resource support.

⸻

🗳 DAO Voting Options

✅ YES  
Support adjusting the eligibility for "Meet-up Subsidies" from V2 to V4, to further improve the quality of meet-ups and market development efficiency.

❌ NO  
Maintain the current system, continuing to use V2 as the eligibility requirement for meet-up subsidies.

———————————————

🗳 POTS DAO 提案｜布道会补贴政策调整

📖 提案背景

随着 POTS 全球市场持续扩展，布道会已成为推动社区共识、市场教育与品牌传播的重要方式。

过去，为鼓励更多团队举办布道会，补贴政策开放给 V2 及以上领导人申请。经过一段时间的执行，我们也累积了大量活动经验。

为了进一步提升布道会的专业度与内容质量，同时让补贴资源发挥更大的市场价值，现提出本次 DAO 提案，由社区共同决定是否调整布道会补贴申请资格。

⸻

📋 提案内容

现行方案

布道会补贴申请资格：V2 及以上

提议调整为

布道会补贴申请资格：V4 及以上  
完成《工作室》申请并审核通过  
完成《超越巅峰》课程结训  
加入 Telegram V4 级别群组

根据现行布道会补贴方案，补贴仍依据新增业绩计算，并以 IBS 发放奖励，本月加码奖励机制亦维持不变。

⸻

🎯 提案目的

本次调整的核心目标，是为了提升补贴效益。希望将补贴资源优先投入具备以下能力的领导人：

能独立举办高质量布道会  
能准确传递 POTS 核心价值  
能持续复制市场与培养新人  
能维护品牌形象与统一市场口径  
能带动团队长期稳定成长

让每一场布道会，不只是一次分享，更成为推动全球生态发展的重要节点。

⸻

🌍 为什么支持这项提案？

随着 POTS 全球布局持续扩大，布道会已经不仅代表个人团队，更代表整个 POTS 品牌形象。

提高申请门槛，代表更高的责任，也代表更高的专业标准。让真正完成训练、具备领导能力、能够持续复制市场的领导人获得官方资源支持。

⸻

🗳 DAO 投票选项

✅ 赞成（YES）  
支持将《布道会补贴》申请资格由 V2 调整为 V4，进一步提升布道会质量与市场发展效率。

❌ 反对（NO）  
维持现行制度，继续采用 V2 作为布道会补贴申请资格。

title: Adjustment of Workshop Subsidy Policy / 工作室补贴政策调整
body:
🗳 POTS DAO Proposal｜Adjustment of Workshop Subsidy Policy

To further drive global market development and accelerate the rollout of offline workshops, we now present this proposal to optimize the "Workshop Subsidy Policy," with the goal of lowering the application threshold so that more outstanding teams can participate in ecosystem building.

📋 Proposal Content

Current Scheme:  
Eligibility for workshop subsidies: V4 and above

Proposed Adjustment:  
Eligibility for workshop subsidies: V2 and above

Under the updated subsidy scheme, V2–V5 leaders who meet the workshop standards and complete the relevant assessments may apply for workshop subsidies. The subsidy amount is 3% of new performance, with a monthly cap of 5,000 UT equivalent in IBS. Workshop leaders are still required to complete the designated courses and subsequent assessments, as well as meet office hardware standards and other requirements.

⸻

🎯 Proposal Objective

This adjustment is not simply about expanding subsidy coverage, but rather about achieving the following goals:

Accelerating the pace of global workshop establishment  
Cultivating more grassroots core leaders  
Building more standardized offline service hubs  
Increasing community engagement and new performance

Our goal is to incubate 1,000 high-quality workshops globally, creating a stable and sustainable offline ecosystem network.

⸻

🌍 Why Support This Proposal?

Lowering the threshold means that more teams actively building the market can receive official support.

It enables those who are truly committed to market development to access more resources for hosting events, setting up offices, and serving the community, ultimately forming a stronger global consensus network.

Supporting more builders is not just about helping individuals grow, but also about accelerating the overall development of the POTS ecosystem.

⸻

🗳 DAO Voting Options

✅ YES  
Support adjusting the eligibility for "Workshop Subsidies" from V4 to V2.

❌ NO  
Maintain the current system, continuing to use V4 as the eligibility requirement.

———————————————

🗳 POTS DAO 提案｜工作室补贴政策调整

为了进一步推动全球市场发展，加速线下工作室布局，现提出《工作室补贴政策》优化提案，希望通过降低申请门槛，让更多优秀团队能够参与生态建设。

📋 提案内容

现行方案：  
工作室补贴申请资格：V4 及以上

提议调整为：  
工作室补贴申请资格：V2 及以上

最新补贴方案，V2～V5 达成工作室标准并完成相关考核后，可申请工作室补贴，补贴金额为新增业绩的 3%，每月最高 5,000 UT 等值 IBS。工作室负责人仍需完成指定课程及后续考核，并符合办公室硬件标准等要求。

⸻

🎯 提案目的

本次调整并非单纯扩大补贴范围，而是为了实现以下目标：

加快全球工作室建设速度  
培养更多基层核心领导人

title: SDGP-75: Extend the SDGP-70 voluntary, ex gratia distribution to borrowers of the Arbitrum asdCRV LlamaLend market
body:
**Author:** Stake DAO Association

## Summary

SDGP-70 authorized a voluntary, ex gratia distribution of 1,535,421.76 sdCRV to liquidity providers affected by the May 27, 2026 vsdCRV incident. Borrowers on the asdCRV LlamaLend market on Arbitrum were also affected by the same incident, but were not covered by SDGP-70. This proposal extends the distribution to those borrowers, under the same terms, for a total of 17,681 sdCRV funded from treasury reserves. That is about 1.2% of the original distribution.

## Context

The attacked pool (CRV/vsdCRV/asdCRV on Arbitrum) feeds the price oracle of the asdCRV LlamaLend market. When the attacker distorted the pool on May 27, the oracle price collapsed for 55 minutes. During that window, some borrowers were liquidated on the basis of a manipulated oracle price that did not reflect prevailing market conditions.

The Association published the full [impact assessment](https://gov.stakedao.org/t/extend-sdgp-70-to-cover-users-that-were-liquidated-due-to-the-vsdcrv-exploit/1138/4), along with the [list of eligible addresses](https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1bL4GrmVV8huCbpub9IMDYtlmj_qO34eXsPuL0BEFopA/edit?gid=1667373604#gid=1667373604). The list has been open for community review since then.

## Proposal

Authorize the treasury committee to distribute 17,681 sdCRV from treasury reserves to the eligible borrowers listed in the published sheet, as finally determined by Stake DAO governance.

The same rules as SDGP-70 apply. The Association excludes allocations below 100 sdCRV. It also excludes positions opened during the incident window because those borrowers entered at prices the attacker had already distorted. Positions that stayed healthy lost nothing and receive nothing.

## Claim Mechanism

Eligible borrowers claim through the same Merkle distribution mechanism as SDGP-70, on Ethereum mainnet, open for six months. Unclaimed allocations return to the treasury after that window.

By claiming, each recipient acknowledges and agrees that: (i) the distribution is made on a voluntary and ex gratia basis, without any admission of liability, fault or wrongdoing by the Association, Stake DAO, the DAO, its token holders, contributors or service providers, and is accepted in full and final satisfaction and release of any and all claims the recipient may have against any of them arising out of or relating to the vsdCRV incident of 27 May 2026 (the "Incident"); (ii) the connected wallet belongs to the recipient and is the wallet associated with the recipient's eligible position; (iii) the recipient is not located in, and is not a resident or national of, a sanctioned jurisdiction and is not subject to any applicable sanctions list; and (iv) the recipient is solely responsible for any taxes arising from the distribution.

Claiming is subject to the [Stake DAO vsdCRV Compensation Claim Terms](https://www.stakedao.org/vsdcrv-terms.pdf), which govern the claim and prevail over this summary.

## Proposal Specifications

A 3-day vlSDT holders Community Feedback period, followed by a 7-day voting period, with standard governance quorum and majority.

## Voting Options

-   **FOR**: Authorise the treasury committee to proceed with the voluntary, ex gratia distribution to eligible affected borrowers.
    
-   **AGAINST**: Rework the proposal with another solution.
    
-   **ABSTAIN**: No preference.
    

## Disclaimers

This proposal does not constitute an offer of securities, a financial product, or a solicitation of any investment, and is not investment, legal, financial or tax advice, in any jurisdiction. All transfers are executed on-chain through transparent and auditable smart contracts. Recipients bear sole responsibility for any taxes arising from the distribution. The Association may withhold, screen, pause or reverse distributions where required for sanctions, legal or regulatory reasons, or to correct errors, and approval of this proposal does not create any obligation to distribute and does not guarantee that a distribution will occur. This is a one-time, discretionary measure and does not create any obligation or precedent to provide compensation in respect of any future incident.

title: Pawthereum Migration Framework
body:
This proposal defines the practical framework for the Pawthereum migration and relaunch.

## Holder Data

Based on the holder data from 27.07.2026 at a PAWTH price of $0.0002325:

**≥ 43,011 PAWTH (~$10)**
784 wallets - 1.50% of holders - 98.20% of total supply

## Migration Process

A 1-month token turn-in window opens for old PAWTH holders.

Any wallet that submits PAWTH during the turn-in window is included as an active migration participant.

Non-participating wallets are only eligible for passive migration compensation if they held at least ~$10 worth of PAWTH at the start of the turn-in window.

After the window closes, a snapshot is taken of:

* all participating wallets
* the amount of PAWTH each participating wallet submitted
* all eligible non-participating wallets

The collected PAWTH is used to extract as much ETH/liquidity as possible from the locked LP.

The extracted ETH becomes the migration treasury.

The migration treasury acquires the new PAWTH through the Bankr launch.

To reduce sniper risk, exact buy times are not announced in advance. The team/multisig has up to 1 month to acquire the new token at flexible times. All buys are reported transparently afterward.

## Migration Credits

Migration credits are not a fixed dollar value and not a guaranteed number of new tokens.

They are only the weighting system used to distribute the new PAWTH acquired by the migration treasury.

**Liquidity Recovery Rate = extracted ETH / maximum recoverable ETH from the locked LP**

**Active Credits = submitted PAWTH × 1.20**

**Inactive Credits = non-submitted eligible PAWTH × Liquidity Recovery Rate**

**Final Claim = wallet migration credits / total migration credits × new PAWTH acquired by the migration treasury**

## Example

Two wallets each hold 100,000 old PAWTH.

Wallet A submits 100,000 PAWTH:
100,000 × 1.20 = 120,000 credits

Wallet B does not submit but is above the passive eligibility threshold.
If liquidity recovery is 50%:
100,000 × 0.50 = 50,000 credits

Total credits:
170,000

If the treasury acquires 1,000,000 new PAWTH:

Wallet A receives 705,882 new PAWTH
Wallet B receives 294,118 new PAWTH

## Bankr Creator Fee Share

Bankr provides a creator fee share: 57% of the 1.2% trading fee goes to the fee beneficiary.

If this proposal passes, the Pawthereum treasury becomes the fee beneficiary.

The use of these fees is decided separately and may include:

* Donations
* Mamo / treasury growth
* Buybacks
* Marketing
* Operations
* Community rewards

## Automated Donations

Mamo yield is used for recurring animal welfare donations.

The Pawthereum X account starts automated, regular votes for eligible animal welfare organizations.

The organization with the most votes receives the donation.

## Vote

A vote in favor of this proposal approves this migration framework as the basis for the Pawthereum relaunch.

title: [SIP-57] Symbiosis: Enabling Cross-Chain Swaps for Stable
body:
# Context
StableChain (Stable) is an EVM-compatible Layer 1 designed for stablecoin payments and settlement.

The network uses StableBFT, a customized Proof-of-Stake consensus protocol built on CometBFT. Once a transaction is included in a confirmed block, it is final and does not require additional block confirmations.

StableChain uses USDT0 as both its native gas token and core settlement asset. USDT0 is an omnichain representation of USDT built on LayerZero’s Omnichain Fungible Token standard and maintains 1:1 backing with USDT.

StableChain supports standard Ethereum development workflows, including Solidity, Foundry, Hardhat, ethers.js, web3.js, and Ethereum-compatible JSON-RPC methods.

Stable launched its mainnet on December 8, 2025.

 # Proposal
Enable support for StableChain in the Symbiosis protocol.

The proposal includes the following steps:

* Deploying and configuring Symbiosis contracts on StableChain to support cross-chain and on-chain operations.
* Adding the StableChain-based token USDT0 to the Symbiosis AMM DEX on the host chain to enable cross-chain routing.
* Leveraging DEXs on StableChain to enable on-chain routing.
* Activating the Symbiosis Relayers Network to handle cross-chain messaging and verification for StableChain.

 # Key Points
* Supporting StableChain would expand Symbiosis coverage to a Layer 1 built specifically around stablecoin payments and settlement.
* The integration would enable cross-chain movement of supported assets into and out of the StableChain ecosystem, giving its users access to additional networks, tokens, and liquidity through Symbiosis.
* Stable’s EVM compatibility makes the network a natural fit for the existing Symbiosis model for supporting EVM-based chains.

title: Activate Withdrawal Fee for AnomaPay
body:
## **Summary**

This proposal introduces a **25 basis point (0.25%) fee on withdrawals** from AnomaPay's shielded pool back to transparent EVM wallets.

Revenue generated from the fee will be distributed as follows:

-   **50%** will be used to purchase **XAN** on the open market.
    
-   **50%** will be allocated to the **Anoma Treasury** to fund protocol development, infrastructure, security, and ecosystem growth.
    

The proposal does not introduce fees on deposits or private transfers, preserving the core user experience while establishing a sustainable source of protocol revenue.

---

## **Motivation**

AnomaPay enables seamless private payments across chains, including EVM-based chains and beyond. As adoption grows, the protocol should also begin generating sustainable revenue that can be reinvested into the ecosystem.

Rather than relying on treasury reserves or token emissions, this proposal introduces a modest fee that is only paid when users exit the shielded pool. Users can continue depositing assets and making private transfers without additional protocol fees, while withdrawals contribute to the long term sustainability of the protocol.

The proposed revenue split also creates direct alignment between protocol usage and the value of the ecosystem. Every withdrawal contributes to ongoing development while simultaneously creating continuous demand for XAN through market buybacks.

---

## **Rationale**

A 25 bps withdrawal fee is both competitive and conservative compared to existing privacy protocols.

For example, **Railgun** currently charges 0.25% protocol fees on both shielding (deposits) and unshielding (withdrawals), meaning users pay when entering and exiting the private pool.

In contrast, this proposal charges fees **only when funds leave AnomaPay**. Deposits remain free and users can continue making private transfers without protocol fees. This minimizes friction for the primary use case while still creating a sustainable revenue stream for the protocol.

The proposed allocation balances two long term objectives:

-   Building consistent buy pressure for XAN through open market purchases.
    
-   Funding continued development, audits, infrastructure, integrations, grants, and ecosystem expansion.
    

As AnomaPay adoption grows, both the treasury and XAN holders benefit directly from increased protocol activity.

---

## **Specification**

If approved, the protocol will implement the following changes:

-   A **25 bps (0.25%) fee** on every withdrawal from AnomaPay to a transparent wallet.
    
-   Fees will be collected in the asset being withdrawn.
    
-   Fee distribution:
    
    -   **50%** will be used for open market purchases of XAN.
        
    -   **50%** will be transferred to the Anoma Treasury.
        

Public reporting of fee revenue, treasury allocations, and buyback activity whenever applicable.

No changes are proposed to:

-   Deposits into AnomaPay.
    
-   Private transfers within AnomaPay.
    
-   The protocol's privacy guarantees or cryptographic design.
    

---

## **Benefits**

Adopting this proposal will:

-   Establish recurring protocol revenue.
    
-   Create continuous protocol driven demand for XAN.
    
-   Fund ongoing protocol development without relying exclusively on treasury reserves.
    
-   Align the success of AnomaPay with the long term growth of the Anoma ecosystem.
    
-   Preserve a low friction experience for users making private payments.

title: Proposal 45 – Reallocate Morini StockMarketTRBasisTrade Exposure to Royco Markets
body:
### **Summary**

This proposal seeks to optimize the USP reserve allocation to the Morini StockMarketTRBasisTrade strategy by introducing exposure through the newly launched Royco markets.

A portion of the current allocation will be reallocated from the existing StockMarketTRBasisTrade Vault into the **srStockMarketTRBasisTrade (Senior Tranche)** and **jrStockMarketTRBasisTrade (Junior Tranche)** markets on Royco. This adjustment aims to enhance capital efficiency while maintaining exposure to the same underlying delta-neutral strategy.

### **Rationale**

The launch of the **srStockMarketTRBasisTrade** and **jrStockMarketTRBasisTrade** markets on Royco provides USP with an opportunity to access the existing StockMarketTRBasisTrade strategy through an additional on-chain infrastructure designed for efficient capital deployment.

Under this proposal, the current **25% allocation** to the **Morini StockMarketTRBasisTrade Vault** will be updated as follows:

-   **15%** allocated to the Morini StockMarketTRBasisTrade Vault
    
-   **5%** allocated to the **srStockMarketTRBasisTrade** Royco market
    
-   **5%** allocated to the **jrStockMarketTRBasisTrade** Royco market
    

This proposal does **not** increase the protocol's total exposure to the StockMarketTRBasisTrade strategy. The 5% senior tranche allocation benefits from loss protection provided by junior tranche holders, while the 5% junior tranche represents USP's higher-risk, higher-reward participation — together maintaining the same total strategy exposure with a differentiated risk structure.

By diversifying deployment across the vault and Royco markets, USP can benefit from enhanced capital efficiency, broader DeFi integration, and additional opportunities within the evolving on-chain ecosystem while preserving exposure to the regulated, delta-neutral StockMarketTRBasisTrade strategy.

title: CRYO-26: Electing Dr. Emil Kendziorra as Research Steward
body:
Submitted by: CryoCore
Team Members: CryoCore

**Problem**

As CryoDAO continues to expand its research pipeline, the DAO requires a strong scientific review capacity to evaluate proposals, assess technical feasibility, and follow up with researchers and funded teams.

CryoDAO’s mission depends on identifying and supporting research that can meaningfully advance cryobiology, biostasis, organ preservation, and related fields. This requires not only sourcing promising opportunities but also applying experienced scientific and operational judgment to determine which projects are credible, feasible, and strategically aligned with the DAO’s goals.

This governance proposal enables the community to vote on electing Dr. Emil Kendziorra as Research Steward.

**Solution**

CryoCore proposes electing Dr. Emil Kendziorra as a Research Steward.
Dr. Kendziorra is the CEO & Co-Founder of Tomorrow Bio, a leading biostasis organization focused on human cryopreservation and cryomedicine. He has a background in medicine, cancer research, and entrepreneurship, including prior experience founding and leading medical and technology companies. He is also President of the Board of the European Biostasis Foundation and has been an active contributor to CryoDAO’s broader ecosystem.

As Research Steward, Dr. Kendziorra would support CryoDAO by helping evaluate research proposals, assess technical feasibility, provide scientific diligence on potential funding opportunities, and follow up with funded teams or prospective collaborators.
The role is intended to strengthen CryoDAO’s ability to identify promising research in cryobiology, biostasis, and organ preservation while ensuring that proposals receive expert review from someone with deep operational and scientific experience in the field.

**Budget**

This proposal requests no changes to the current budget; funds will be reallocated, requiring no further spend on total steward compensation.

Compensation will be paid at $2,500 USDC and 5,000 CRYO per month for 12 months.

**Timeline**
Immediately upon approval.

title: HYDRA-7: Kind Bio Integrated Organ Networks
body:
Submitted by: HydraCore
Team Members: HydraCore

**Problem**

Organ failure remains one of the largest unmet medical challenges. More than 100,000 people are currently waiting for organ transplants in the United States, while the supply of viable donor organs remains severely limited. Thousands of patients die each year before a suitable organ becomes available.

While significant progress has been made in organ preservation, xenotransplantation, and regenerative medicine, the ability to generate abundant, transplantable biological systems remains one of the greatest bottleneck in replacement medicine.

HydraDAO's mission is to accelerate technologies that enable replacement of aging or damaged body parts through engineering-driven approaches. Investing in scalable organ generation technologies is directly aligned with the DAO's long-term vision of advancing replacement biology and ultimately enabling whole-body replacement.

**Solution**

HydraCore proposes investing $250,000 USDC in Kind Biotechnology at the company's current $25 million valuation.

Kind Biotechnology is developing the Integrated Organ Network (ION) platform, a novel system that uses artificial genomic constructs to grow coordinated sets of peripheral organs that develop and function together as a unified biological system. Rather than engineering individual organs in isolation, the platform seeks to generate integrated bodyoids capable of supporting increasingly complex physiological functions.

This approach represents a fundamental shift from conventional tissue engineering. By allowing organs to develop together within a coordinated biological environment, the ION platform aims to better replicate natural development while providing a path toward abundant, transplantable biological systems.

Kind Bio has already established proof-of-concept in mouse models demonstrating genetically engineered, brain-deficient developmental systems. The company's next objective is to scale the platform to larger animal models and ultimately develop increasingly sophisticated bodyoids capable of supporting coordinated organ systems.
HydraDAO's investment will provide Kind Biotechnology with additional capital to accelerate development of the ION platform and advance replacement biology toward practical clinical applications.

More details on the company can be found in a recent Core Memory article:
https://www.corememory.com/p/the-man-growing-organs-on-demand-kind-bio-justin-rebo

**Strategic Vision**

Current longevity research primarily focuses on slowing, repairing, or reversing the aging process. Replacement biology offers a complementary approach: replacing damaged tissues, organs, and eventually entire biological systems with newly grown, fully functional ones while preserving the brain.

Kind Biotechnology's bodyoid platform represents one of the most ambitious technological paths toward this vision. If successful, it could provide the biological foundation for abundant organ transplantation, advanced disease modeling, pharmaceutical development, and, ultimately, whole-body replacement.

This investment also complements HydraDAO's existing partnership with Dowell Bio, which is developing rapid spinal cord and peripheral nerve fusion technologies. Together, these research programs address two of the fundamental challenges required for eventual whole-body replacement: generating replacement biological systems and reconnecting them to the central nervous system.

**Commercialization Potential**

If successful, Kind Biotechnology's platform could fundamentally transform organ transplantation by creating a scalable source of transplantable organs.
Beyond transplantation, the technology has potential applications in pharmaceutical testing, disease modeling, regenerative medicine, and other areas requiring functional biological systems. As replacement medicine advances over the coming decades, platforms capable of generating integrated bodyoids may become foundational infrastructure for modern healthcare.

By investing at the company's current $25 million valuation, HydraDAO gains ownership in a company pursuing one of the most ambitious approaches to replacement biology while supporting technology that is closely aligned with the DAO's long-term mission.

**Budget**

This proposal requests approval for a $250,000 USDC investment into Kind Biotechnology at the company's current $25 million valuation.

**Timeline**
Immediate.

body:
# 🗳️ GLOBAL WEB3 ACADEMY DAO PROPOSAL
![WhatsApp Image 2026-07-29 at 02.02.40.jpeg](ipfs://bafybeiavhi2djt4okba43ytlwu7nomsejpt7upjyh3zcvxywjmjsddpzqi)
# Proposal: Building the World's First Blockchain-Powered Class Network

**Proposal ID:** GWA-DAO-008

**Category:** Education • Student Leadership • Innovation

**Status:** Open for Community Vote

---

# 📖 Proposal Summary

Education has changed.

Technology has changed.

The job market has changed.

But one thing has remained almost the same for decades...

**The way university classes operate.**

Every academic year, students create new WhatsApp groups.

Class Representatives start from zero.

Lecture notes get lost.

Projects disappear after graduation.

Leadership ends when a new CR is elected.

Students spend large amounts of money printing the same materials every year.

At Global Web3 Academy, we believe it is time to change this.

This proposal introduces a blockchain-powered system that allows every class to build a permanent academic community instead of restarting every year.

---

# 🎯 Our Vision

## **One Course. One Community. One Lifelong Network.**

Every student who studies the same course becomes part of one connected academic family.

Instead of graduating and disappearing...

Students remain connected.

They mentor.

They build projects.

They create businesses.

They help future students.

They create opportunities together.

---

# ❓ What Problem Are We Solving?

Many students experience the same challenges every semester.

* Missing lecture notes
* Lost announcements
* Too many WhatsApp groups
* Expensive printing and photocopying
* Poor communication
* Weak connection between graduates and current students
* No permanent leadership system
* Little practical experience before graduation

Most importantly...

Every new class starts from zero.

---

# 💡 Our Solution

Global Web3 Academy introduces two powerful tools for every university course.

## 📚 1. Digital Course Library

Each course receives one permanent digital library managed by the Class Representative.

Students subscribe once every academic year.

Inside the library students access:

* Lecture notes
* Lecture summaries
* Assignment updates
* Class notices
* Examination guidance
* Previous materials
* Academic resources

Instead of paying repeatedly for photocopies, students access everything from one organized place.

Knowledge is preserved for future generations.

---

## 👩‍🎓 Why This Matters

Imagine a student from a low-income family.

They can afford tuition.

But every semester they struggle to buy lecture notes.

Sometimes they miss assignments simply because they couldn't access printed materials.

Now imagine...

That same student opens one Digital Course Library and immediately accesses everything needed to succeed.

No student should fail because they cannot afford stationery.

Knowledge should be accessible to everyone.

---

# ❤️ Building a Stronger Class Community

The Library is more than storage.

It strengthens the class community.

Subscription funds can help support:

* Academic materials
* Class activities
* Emergency support
* Condolence contributions
* Student welfare initiatives

Leadership becomes transparent.

Every contribution can be recorded.

Every student knows how resources are used.

---

# 👨‍🏫 2. Matrix Class Network

The Matrix Class connects every generation of students studying the same course.

For example:

Computer Science

↓

2024 Students

↓

2025 Students

↓

2026 Students

↓

Graduates

↓

Industry Professionals

↓

Future Students

Instead of separate groups every year...

Everyone joins one growing academic network.

---

# 🌍 Opportunities Inside Matrix Class

Students participate in:

* Leadership training
* Blockchain education
* Artificial Intelligence
* Entrepreneurship
* Public speaking
* Software development
* Research collaboration
* Community innovation
* Startup creation

The classroom becomes more than a place to pass exams.

It becomes a place to build careers.

---

# 🚀 Community Projects

Students work together on real projects.

Examples include:

* Y Internet Community Connectivity
* Student Startups
* DAO Projects
* AI Solutions
* Local Technology Innovation
* Research Collaboration
* Social Impact Programs

Students graduate with real experience.

Not only academic knowledge.

---

# 🪪 NFT Academic Profile

Every participating student receives a verified NFT Academic Profile.

Instead of storing only certificates...

The profile records:

* Leadership
* Community service
* Workshops
* Skills
* Projects
* Innovation
* Awards
* Mentorship
* Professional achievements

This becomes a trusted digital portfolio that employers can verify.

Your NFT Profile becomes your living CV.

---

# 👩 Leadership Legacy

Every Class Representative builds something that lasts.

When leadership changes...

The Digital Library remains.

The Matrix continues growing.

Knowledge is preserved.

Projects continue.

Leadership history remains recorded.

Instead of restarting every year...

Every generation builds on the work of the previous one.

---

# 🌍 Why Students Should Support This

This proposal creates opportunities that continue beyond graduation.

Students gain:

✅ Easier access to learning materials

✅ Better organization

✅ Reduced stationery costs

✅ Leadership opportunities

✅ Verified digital achievements

✅ Professional mentorship

✅ Real project experience

✅ Lifelong networking

✅ Career opportunities

✅ A stronger student community

---

# 💼 Future Career Opportunities

Employers increasingly want more than grades.

They want evidence of:

* Leadership
* Teamwork
* Innovation
* Community contribution
* Real projects

Your NFT Academic Profile helps demonstrate exactly that.

Instead of saying,

"I have experience."

You can prove it.

---

# 🌱 Long-Term Impact

Imagine five years from today.

Every course has its own Digital Library.

Every student joins a Matrix Class.

Graduates mentor current students.

Communities build real projects.

Employers recruit through verified NFT Profiles.

Students graduate with both knowledge and practical experience.

Universities become stronger.

Communities become stronger.

Students become leaders.

---

# 📊 Expected Benefits

### Students

* Better academic support
* Lower learning costs
* Practical skills
* Career readiness

### Class Representatives

* Better leadership tools
* Transparent administration
* Lasting impact

### Universities

* Stronger communication
* Better student engagement
* Improved alumni connections

### Employers

* Trusted student portfolios
* Easier recruitment

### Communities

* More innovation
* More startups
* More local solutions

---

This proposal is not about creating another student platform.

It is about giving every university course a permanent digital home, every Class Representative better leadership tools, every student equal access to knowledge, every graduate a lifelong professional network, and every achievement a trusted digital identity.



# 💬 Final Message to the Community

Education should not end at graduation.

A great Class Representative should leave behind more than memories.

A student should graduate with more than a certificate.

A university should build more than classrooms.


### **One Course. One Library. One Matrix. One Lifelong Legacy.**

## **Implementation Framework & Official Utility Adoption**

**Proposal ID:** GWA-DAO-002

**Category:** Education • Student Leadership • Blockchain Utility

---

# Introduction

Following the approval of the concept in Part I, this proposal seeks DAO approval to officially implement the **Global Web3 Academy Digital Course Library** and **Matrix Class Network** as a new utility for universities.

This proposal does **not** introduce new technology. The platform, Digital Course Library, and Matrix infrastructure already exist. The objective is to expand their official use to support university courses, Class Representatives (CRs), students, graduates, lecturers, employers, and future partners.

---

# Implementation Roadmap

### Phase 1 – DAO Approval

* Approve the new university utility.
* Approve governance guidelines.
* Approve pilot implementation.
* Approve NFT Academic Profile standards.

**Outcome:** Official DAO authorization.

---

### Phase 2 – University Pilot

Launch the program in **3–5 universities** covering **20–50 courses**.

Activities include:

* Register Class Representatives.
* Open Digital Course Libraries.
* Activate Matrix Classes.
* Train CRs.
* Collect feedback from students and lecturers.

**Outcome:** Validate the model before national expansion.

---

### Phase 3 – CR Leadership Training

Every participating Class Representative completes leadership training before receiving administrator access.

Training covers:

* Leadership
* Digital Library management
* Matrix moderation
* Financial transparency
* Community building
* NFT Academic Profiles
* Project coordination

Successful participants receive a **Verified Leadership NFT Certificate**.

---

### Phase 4 – Digital Course Library

Each course receives one permanent Digital Course Library managed by the Class Representative.

Students access:

* Lecture notes
* Assignments
* Notices
* Course materials
* Past papers
* Academic resources

Course or Department Heads may serve as co-administrators to ensure continuity and accountability.

---

### Phase 5 – Matrix Class Network

The Matrix connects:

* Current students
* Graduates
* Alumni
* Mentors
* Industry professionals

Activities include:

* Leadership programs
* Career mentorship
* Blockchain & AI training
* Startup collaboration
* Research initiatives
* Community innovation projects

Each course becomes one lifelong academic community.

---

### Phase 6 – NFT Academic Profiles

Students build verified blockchain portfolios that record:

* Leadership
* Skills
* Projects
* Workshops
* Awards
* Community service
* Innovation
* Certifications

Graduates leave university with a trusted digital identity alongside their academic qualifications.

---

### Phase 7 – Community Innovation

Each Matrix Class is encouraged to launch real-world projects such as:

* Y Internet
* Student startups
* AI solutions
* Blockchain applications
* Research collaborations
* Local innovation initiatives

Students graduate with practical experience, not only academic knowledge.

---

### Phase 8 – National Expansion

Following a successful pilot, the program expands to universities, colleges, technical institutions, and later to international partners.

---

# Governance Structure

### Global Web3 Academy

* Platform development
* Blockchain infrastructure
* Security
* DAO governance
* Technical support

### Universities

* Academic collaboration
* Student support
* Institutional oversight

### Course/Department Heads

* Academic verification
* Co-administration
* Leadership continuity

### Class Representatives

* Library management
* Student communication
* Matrix coordination
* Project leadership

### Students

* Participate in the Library
* Join Matrix Classes
* Build NFT Profiles
* Develop community projects

---

# Proposal Summary

This proposal officially introduces the **Digital Course Library** and **Matrix Class Network** as university utilities using technology already developed by Global Web3 Academy.

Rather than building a new platform, the proposal expands the purpose of existing infrastructure to create lifelong academic communities.

---

| -------------------------------------------- | ----------------------: |
| Higher Education Students                    |             **361,257** |
| Universities & Higher Education Institutions |                 **70+** |
| Academic Courses                             |         **1,000–1,300** |
| Current Stationery Cost                      |  **~$100/student/year** |
| Annual Library Subscription                  |         **$20/student** |
| Student Savings                              |   **~$80/student/year** |
| National Student Savings                     | **~$28.9 Million/year** |

---

# Financial Summary

### Digital Course Library

* Annual Subscription: **$20**
* Total Annual Revenue: **$7,225,140**

Distribution:

* **90% ($6,502,626)** → Class Representatives & Class Communities
* **10% ($722,514)** → Global Web3 Academy

---

### Matrix Class

* Membership Contribution: **$27**
* GWA Allocation: **$4 per participant**

Estimated Annual Matrix Revenue:

**$1,445,028**

Supports:

* Blockchain infrastructure
* NFT Academic Profiles
* Platform development
* Security
* Student innovation programs
* Community projects

---

# Combined Platform Revenue

| Source                 | Annual Revenue |
| ---------------------- | -------------: |
| Digital Course Library |   **$722,514** |
| Matrix Class           | **$1,445,028** |
| **Total**              | **$2,167,542** |

*Illustrative projections before operating expenses, taxes, reserves, and reinvestment.*

---

# Shareholder Outlook

Assuming **100 Global Web3 Academy shareholders**, the illustrative annual revenue equivalent is approximately:

## **$21,675 per shareholder**

This is **not a guaranteed investment return**. Actual shareholder value depends on adoption, operating costs, governance decisions, and company profitability.

---

# Long-Term Value

This initiative aims to:

* Connect every generation studying the same course.
* Preserve academic knowledge permanently.
* Give students verified NFT Academic Profiles.
* Strengthen Class Representative leadership.
* Support projects such as **Y Internet**.
* Improve graduate employability.
* Build lifelong academic and professional networks.

Its greatest value is not revenue—it is creating a permanent educational ecosystem where every generation leaves opportunities for the next.

---

# DAO Voting Question

### **Should Global Web3 Academy officially adopt its existing Blockchain-Powered Digital Course Library and Matrix Class Network as the standard platform for connecting university courses, empowering Class Representatives, preserving academic knowledge, building verified NFT Academic Profiles, and supporting lifelong student communities?**

### Voting Options

🟢 **YES** — Approve the official university utility and begin phased implementation.

🟡 **YES, WITH RECOMMENDATIONS** — Approve the concept with recommended improvements before rollout.

🔴 **NO** — Do not approve the proposal in its current form.

---

# Implementation Notice

If approved, the program will first be launched as a **pilot in selected universities** before national expansion. Feedback from students, Class Representatives, lecturers, and university administrators will guide improvements, ensuring the platform grows through real-world experience and community governance.

title: [GIP-28] Approval of the GoodDAO Treasury Committee
body:
This proposal requests approval to establish GoodDAO 2.0’s first expert execution body: the GoodDAO Treasury Committee.

The Treasury Committee will support GoodDAO’s capital allocation function by developing its mandate and preparing the DAO’s first community-approved treasury budget. It will be an expert-led body responsible for stewarding the treasury while remaining accountable to the wider GoodDAO community.

Approval of this proposal does not authorize the committee to move, spend, or deploy treasury funds. Any use of treasury funds, as well as the committee’s final mandate and budget, will require separate approval from GoodDAO.

Concretely, this proposal authorizes Good Labs to establish the Treasury Committee and recruit its founding members through a formal and transparent process. Official job postings will be published to fill the two open committee positions.

This is an important first step toward activating a treasury that has historically remained under the custody of Good Labs and gradually transferring management responsibility and decision-making power to the DAO.

Full details at the Discussion link below.

# **Adopt The SEAL Safe Harbor Agreement**

**Authors**: Orest (1inch), Ilya (1inch), Dickson (SEAL)

---

## **Introduction**

This proposal outlines 1inch’s adoption of the SEAL ([Security Alliance](https://www.securityalliance.org/)) Whitehat Safe Harbor Agreement (“Safe Harbor Agreement”). By adopting the Safe Harbor Agreement, 1inch improves the security of its on-chain assets by allowing whitehats to intervene during active exploits to save protocol funds.

### **What is the Safe Harbor Agreement?**

The Safe Harbor Agreement addresses a critical need in crypto: enabling whitehats to intervene during active exploits when the urgency of an attack makes traditional processes too slow to save funds.

The Safe Harbor Agreement was created by SEAL, a nonprofit founded by samczsun, to secure the future of crypto. In addition to the Safe Harbor Agreement, SEAL runs multiple initiatives, including SEAL 911 (emergency response hotline for exploits), SEAL Intel (crypto-native threat intelligence sharing), SEAL Frameworks (open source security best practices and playbooks), SEAL Wargames (incident response training), and more in development.

Key aspects of the agreement include:

* **Encouraging Whitehats to Protect the Protocol:** By adopting the Safe Harbor Agreement, 1inch incentivizes whitehats to step in and protect the protocol during active exploits by limiting their legal exposure.
* **Intervention Only During Active Exploits:** Whitehats are authorized to act only when there is an immediate or ongoing exploit that threatens the protocol. This agreement is not intended for routine security testing or bug bounty reporting. It applies only to critical situations where the urgency of the exploit supersedes traditional procedures for responsible disclosure in order to save funds.
* **Mandatory Return of Rescued Funds:** Under the terms of the Safe Harbor, whitehats are required to return all rescued assets to a pre-designated recovery address controlled by the protocol within 72 hours of recovery to ensure these funds are quickly secured, preventing delay or potential loss.
* **Clear Guidelines and Legal Protection:** The agreement establishes strict rules for how whitehats must operate during an exploit, ensuring recovery efforts are conducted professionally and safely, minimizing the risk of mistakes or further damage to the protocol. By adhering to these guidelines, whitehats can limit their potential legal exposure, allowing them to act in good faith without fear of liability.
* **Incentivized Rescue Efforts:** To motivate whitehats to act during critical situations, the agreement offers a bounty system that rewards rescuers with a percentage of the recovered assets, up to a predefined cap, for successful interventions.

Safe Harbor has already been adopted by leading protocols such as Uniswap, Zksync, Pendle, Pancakeswap, and Balancer, establishing it as a trusted industry standard for empowering whitehats during active exploits.

---

## **Rationale**

1inch is committed to enhancing its security and protecting user funds during critical moments. While security audits and other preventive measures are crucial, the unpredictable nature of active exploits requires a swift, decisive response mechanism to minimize potential damage.

Benefits of adopting the Safe Harbor Agreement include:

* **Agile Defense Against Exploits:** Whitehats are authorized to intervene as soon as an active exploit is detected, enabling them to respond faster than traditional methods. Immediate action minimizes the window for malicious actors, reduces damage, and accelerates asset recovery during critical moments.
* **Clarified Rescue Process:** The agreement ensures that every step, from intervention to fund recovery, is predetermined and streamlined. Whitehats know exactly where to send recovered funds, preventing chaotic negotiations or rushed decisions during an exploit. This clarity ensures efficient, decisive action when it matters most.
* **Clear Financial Boundaries:** The predefined bounty system, with a cap matching 1inch’s existing bug bounty, ensures that whitehats are incentivized fairly without creating conflicting priorities between exploit intervention and standard vulnerability disclosure. By setting expectations upfront, it eliminates post-exploit negotiations, ensuring funds are returned promptly without attempts to change the reward amount, keeping the process fair and transparent.
* **Aligning with Industry Best Practices:** By adopting the Safe Harbor Agreement, 1inch aligns itself with leading security practices across the industry, reinforcing its commitment to staying at the forefront of protocol security.

Adoption of the agreement complements audits by providing an additional layer of security, ensuring that the protocol is better prepared to respond to active threats.

---

## **Adoption Details**

The 1inch DAO, by approving this proposal, adopts the [Safe Harbor Agreement](https://github.com/security-alliance/safe-harbor/blob/main/documents/agreement.pdf) with the parameters set forth below. The 1inch Foundation will act as the designated representative for off-chain and on-chain administrative actions necessary to effectuate the adoption, including execution of the on-chain registration on behalf of the DAO, and will ensure that adjacent entities within the 1inch ecosystem implement the corresponding actions required to give full effect to the adoption.

**Bounty Terms**

* **Percentage**: 10%

* **Cap (USD)**: 500,000

* **Aggregate Cap (USD)**: 500,000. Bounties will be distributed pro rata across all qualifying whitehats for a single incident. USD value to be assessed at the time of rescue using the 24-hour volume-weighted average price (VWAP) from a recognized exchange.

* **Retainable**: No. Whitehats are required to return all recovered funds in full to the designated recovery address within 72 hours of rescue. 1inch will verify the recovered amounts and disburse the applicable bounty to the whitehat thereafter. No deductions from recovered funds are permitted under any circumstances.

* **Identity**: Pseudonymous. Whitehats must identify themselves to the protocol but are not required to provide their real name or any identification, except in cases where we reasonably expect a Whitehat to be in breach of the Diligence Requirements (see the Diligence Requirements section below)*.*

* **Diligence Requirements.  Whitehats must**:

1. **Notification.** Contact 1inch Security (contact details listed below in the Contact Details section) immediately upon initiating any rescue action;
2. **Disclosure.** Provide a full written disclosure of the vulnerability, rescue methodology, and all addresses used within 24 hours of initiating the rescue;
3. **Confidentiality.** Execute and adhere to a non-disclosure agreement covering all vulnerability details until 1inch confirms the vulnerability has been fully patched and publicly disclosed;
4. **Sanctions.** The Whitehat is not, and is not owned or controlled by or acting on behalf of any person that is the subject of sanctions administered or enforced by OFAC, the UK, the EU, or the UN, and will cooperate with comprehensive sanctions and AML screening by 1inch prior to disbursement.
5. **Forensic cooperation.** For any rescue involving gross exploited value exceeding USD 250,000, provide reasonable cooperation with a forensic investigation conducted by an independent incident-response firm engaged by 1inch, in each case solely for the purpose of verifying Whitehat's eligibility under Section 2.3(b) of the Agreement.
   **Not applicable to:**
6. **Blackhats and accomplices.** Any person who directly or indirectly caused, initiated, assisted, funded, or coordinated the exploit, or is acting in concert with or under common control with such a person. Returning funds does not convert such a person into an Eligible Whitehat.
7. **Former insiders (12-month look-back).** Any person who is, or within the twelve (12) months preceding the rescue was, an employee, contractor, officer, director, or service provider of an entity adjacent to the 1inch ecosystem or any of their affiliates (or an immediate family member of such a person).
   Where 1inch has reasonable doubt as to a Whitehat's compliance with any of the above, 1inch may require the Whitehat to provide additional information, including documentation sufficient to verify their identity, jurisdiction, and beneficial ownership, as a precondition to bounty disbursement. Failure to provide such information within a reasonable period renders the Whitehat ineligible.

**Contact Details**

|:---|:---|
| Legal Department | legal@1inch. com |
| Information Technology Department | security@1inch. com |
| Data Privacy | privacy@1inch. com |

**Chains & Asset Recovery Addresses**

The Asset Recovery Addresses listed above are wallets operated by Degensoft Ltd., the software development company and operator of 1inch User-facing interfaces. Degensoft Ltd. is designated as the recipient of rescued funds because if any active exploit affects Users, the relationship in respect of which the consequences of an incident are felt most acutely, Degensoft Ltd. is the entity that holds the direct contractual relationship with such Users through its Terms of Service.  Degensoft Ltd. is therefore best positioned, operationally and legally,  to receive rescued funds, coordinate with affected Users, and manage related communications and disclosures.

Where rescued funds are attributable to Users or counterparties of other entities within the 1inch ecosystem (including Resolvers), Degensoft Ltd. will coordinate with the relevant entity to ensure that all parties cooperate in good faith on verification, return, and any required follow-up.

**Scope & Limits**

This Safe Harbor is a unilateral public commitment from the 1inch Protocol Community to qualifying Whitehats. It irrevocably releases 1inch’s own claims against any Whitehat who conducts an Eligible Funds Rescue in full compliance with this agreement. It does not, and cannot, bind Users or third parties who are not parties to this agreement, including regulators and law enforcement, and does not waive or limit any claims, enforcement actions, or proceedings that such third parties may bring against Whitehat. User consent to Eligible Funds Rescues is obtained separately through the Safe Harbor clause inserted into the 1inch Terms of Service, which Users accept as a condition of using the Products. Residual third-party risk is disclosed in Exhibit E of the Safe Harbor Agreement and is acknowledged by Whitehats as a condition of participation.

**Scope Note**

1inch protocols are non-custodial. 1inch does not hold User private keys and does not take custody of User or counterparty funds. Tokens, nevertheless, may become exposed to an exploit through a variety of architectural dependencies, and the intended scope of Eligible Funds Rescues under this Agreement includes, without limitation:

1. Tokens with an on-chain balance attributable to any in-scope 1inch Account at the time of an active exploit;
2. Tokens subject to an active ERC-20 (or equivalent) approval granted by a User or other counterparty to any in-scope 1inch Account at the time of the exploit;
3. Tokens in transit or in temporary positions arising from the execution or settlement of any 1inch order, intent, or cross-chain flow, until final settlement is complete;
4. Any other Tokens that, at the time of an active exploit, are indirectly under the control of an in-scope 1inch Account by virtue of approvals, signed intents, routing dependencies, or other architectural linkage to such Account.

For the avoidance of doubt, the fact that such tokens are protected under this Agreement does not imply any custody or control by 1inch. 1inch does not hold User or counterparty private keys, does not take custody of tokens, and does not control assets held by Users, resolvers, or third parties. Exposure to a 1inch-related exploit arises through voluntary approvals, signed intents, cross-chain escrow arrangements, or other architectural dependencies between those actors and the in-scope 1inch contracts.

**Important Disclaimers**

* The Safe Harbor Agreement is a legal framework published by the Security Alliance (SEAL). 1inch DAO is proposed to adopt the standard Safe Harbor Agreement without modifying its core legal language, and to configure only protocol-specific parameters (bounty terms, scope, diligence requirements, asset recovery addresses, contact details).
* Safe Harbor is a civil contract. It does not provide immunity from criminal liability, regulatory enforcement action, or claims brought by third parties that are not bound by the Agreement.

The Agreement's enforceability may vary by jurisdiction. Whitehats remain solely responsible for compliance with all applicable laws, including securities, money transmission, tax, and cybercrime laws.

---

## **Implementation Plan**

1. **Register Agreement On-Chain**. The agreement will be registered on Ethereum in the Safe Harbor Registry at address `0x326733493E143b8904716E7A64A9f4fb6A185a2c`, including all adoptionDetails. This ensures transparency and immutability.
2. **Terms of Service integration.** 1inch DAO adopts the Agreement at the Protocol level; relevant disclosures shall be placed within GitHub repositories. Adjacent entities within the 1inch ecosystem that operate User-facing interfaces (including wallet applications, dApp front-ends, and other UIs interacting with in-scope 1inch Accounts) shall procure the corresponding User-consent language in their own terms, aligning those terms with Exhibit D of the Agreement.
3. **Documentation.** The adoption details, scope, recovery addresses, contact information, and associated disclosures shall be published on 1inch's official documentation site and maintained as an ongoing reference point for Whitehats, Users, and ecosystem participants.
4. **Communicate Adoption**. An official announcement will be made across all 1inch communication channels, explaining the adoption and its significance to the community.
5. **Future Updates to Scope:**
   * New protocols deployed within the 1inch ecosystem may be added to the scope of the Agreement either through a governance vote or, where such Protocols are deployed by other entities within the ecosystem, through action by those deploying entities in line with the purpose of this Proposal. The 1inch Foundation shall be requested to assist with the on-chain registration of such additions.
   * Material changes to the Agreement, including the removal of existing in-scope contracts, changes to the bounty percentage or cap, changes to the Asset Recovery Addresses, or amendments to the Diligence Requirements, shall require a governance vote.
   * A changelog of scope updates shall be published on the documentation site regularly.

---

## **Conclusion**

Adopting the SEAL Whitehat Safe Harbor Agreement equips 1inch with a rapid response mechanism for active exploits, enabling whitehats to step in effectively when needed most. The agreement provides clear guidelines for action, increasing the protection of User and protocol funds and demonstrating 1inch's commitment to proactive security.

**Note**: This proposal does **not** request any funds from the DAO treasury and does **not** involve any budget allocation. It solely seeks governance approval for 1inch to adopt the SEAL Whitehat Safe Harbor Agreement.

title: RENAMING MENTOR PANEL TO MENTOR SPACE AND COURSES TO LEARNING SPACE
body:
# Proposal: Renaming **Mentor Panel** to **Mentor Space** and **Courses** to **Learning Spaces**
FROM HERE
![WhatsApp Image 2026-07-29 at 08.26.13.jpeg](ipfs://bafkreic5wub3m4krwaq5mkjdsb4iwwx2thcu3zusdul7ozhuqwegonkguu)
TO HERE
![WhatsApp Image 2026-07-29 at 08.26.19.jpeg](ipfs://bafybeieud6wilr7x5yhnulxsfbxfrrm6nbmglguhot3ycnlapuvhc5eqju)
## Overview

As Global Web3 Academy continues to grow, the current **Mentor Panel** has expanded beyond a simple course management dashboard. It is becoming a complete digital environment where mentors can teach, organize resources, engage students, and build active learning communities.

To reflect this evolution, we propose two important updates:

* **Mentor Panel** → **Mentor Space**
* **Courses** → **Learning Spaces**

These changes better represent the platform's purpose today while providing flexibility for future growth without changing its core identity.

---

# Why "Mentor Space"?

A **Mentor Space** is more than a management panel.

It is a dedicated learning environment where mentors can continuously share knowledge, organize academic resources, support students, and manage all learning activities from one place.

Instead of being used only to upload materials once, Mentor Space becomes a dynamic workspace where new content can be published throughout the course, keeping students informed and engaged every day.

---

# Why Rename "Courses" to "Learning Spaces"?

The current name **Courses** suggests a collection of lessons or content.

However, Global Web3 Academy offers much more than traditional courses. Each course has the potential to become an active learning community where mentors and students continuously interact, collaborate, and grow together.

By renaming **Courses** to **Learning Spaces**, each space becomes a living academic environment that includes teaching, discussions, projects, resources, assessments, and student engagement—all within one organized location.

A Learning Space is not just where students learn; it is where they build skills, collaborate on projects, and create lasting academic and professional connections.

---

# Expanded Utilities

## 📚 Digital Library

A centralized library where mentors can upload and organize:

* Books
* Lecture notes
* Research papers
* Past papers
* Course materials
* Reference documents
* Learning resources

Students can easily access all academic materials from one organized location.

---

## 📢 Learning Updates

Mentors can continuously publish new content, including:

* Daily announcements
* Weekly learning materials
* Assignment instructions
* Study reminders
* Class notices
* Important updates

This transforms the platform into a living learning space that grows throughout the academic journey.

---

## 🔗 Matrix Activities

A collaborative area where mentors can:

* Share Matrix learning materials
* Launch practical projects
* Organize teamwork
* Guide innovation activities
* Connect students from different academic years

This strengthens collaboration while building a lifelong academic network.

---

## 📝 Assessments

Mentors can create and manage:

* Examinations
* Quizzes
* Assignments
* Practice tests
* Continuous assessments

Helping students evaluate their understanding and track their academic progress.

---

## 👨‍🎓 Student Management

Mentors can efficiently manage their learning community by:

* Viewing enrolled students
* Monitoring student participation
* Communicating directly with learners
* Tracking learning engagement
* Supporting academic progress
* Building stronger mentor–student relationships

This creates a more organized, interactive, and student-centered learning experience within Global Web3 Academy.

---

## New Platform Structure

The proposed naming creates a clearer and more scalable learning ecosystem:

**Mentor Space** *(Main Dashboard)*

⬇

**Learning Spaces** *(Individual Courses & Communities)*

⬇

📚 Digital Library

📢 Learning Updates

🔗 Matrix Activities

📝 Assessments

👨‍🎓 Student Management

This structure reflects the vision of Global Web3 Academy: transforming every course into an interactive learning community where knowledge is continuously shared, collaboration thrives, and lifelong opportunities are created.

title: HOGE Liquidity Using Community Wallet Funds
body:
Option A – Forever Commitment

- Use the community wallet funds to sell 50% of the HOGE into ETH.
- Lock 100% of the resulting HOGE and ETH liquidity forever.

Option B – Forever + 7-Year Commitment

- Use the community wallet funds to sell 50% of the HOGE into ETH.
- Split the liquidity into two equal parts:
  - 50% locked forever.
  - 50% locked for 7 years (until 2033).

Why 7 years?
2033 is around the middle of the cycle after the next major bull market, allowing the community to reassess the project's needs while still demonstrating a strong long-term commitment.

title: BIP055 [Roadmap] Integration of the Plume Network on BIM Exchange
body:
Author: @LP17 – @BIMLabs

**Summary of the Proposal:**
This proposal seeks official DAO approval to integrate the Plume Network into BIM Exchange.

The proposed integration includes:

- Native support for Buy
- Native support for Sell
- Native support for Swap
- Native support for Bridge
Integration of Plume ecosystem liquidity into BIM Exchange's aggregation engine

This is a formal governance proposal for execution upon approval.

**Context:**
Plume Network is one of the fastest-growing Layer 1 blockchains dedicated to Real World Assets (RWAs).

Designed specifically for tokenized real-world assets, Plume combines blockchain infrastructure with institutional-grade financial applications, creating one of the largest ecosystems focused on bringing RWAs on-chain.

The network has attracted a rapidly expanding ecosystem of:

- DeFi protocols
- Stablecoin issuers
- Asset tokenization platforms
- Infrastructure providers
- Wallet providers
- Institutional partners
- Oracle providers

As tokenized assets continue to become one of blockchain's fastest-growing sectors, expanding BIM Exchange to Plume represents a strategic opportunity.

**Proposal Details:**
1️⃣ Buy Integration

Allow users to purchase Plume-native assets directly through BIM Exchange.

Objectives:
- Improve accessibility to the Plume ecosystem
- Simplify onboarding for new users
- Increase protocol transaction volume

2️⃣ Sell Integration

Allow users to sell assets issued on the Plume Network directly through BIM Exchange.

Objectives:
- Complete the trading experience
- Improve liquidity accessibility
- Expand protocol utility

3️⃣ Swap Integration

Integrate Plume liquidity into BIM Exchange's aggregation engine.

Objectives:
- Access Plume-native liquidity
- Improve routing efficiency
- Support trading across the Plume ecosystem

4️⃣ Bridge Integration

Enable cross-chain transfers between Plume and all supported BIM Exchange blockchains.

Objectives:
- Improve interoperability
- Facilitate capital movement
- Expand BIM's multi-chain infrastructure

5️⃣ Native DEX Aggregation

BIM Exchange aims to become one of the leading DEX aggregators on the Plume Network.

By integrating Plume-native liquidity sources, BIM will provide users with optimized routing while positioning itself as one of the primary DeFi gateways within the ecosystem.

Strategic Vision
- The long-term objective of BIM Exchange is to become:
- The OnlyOne DeFi Platform and an Aggregator of Aggregators for:
Buy
Sell
Swap
Bridge
Staking

Adding support for Plume strengthens this vision while expanding BIM into one of the fastest-growing blockchain sectors focused on Real World Assets.

Treasury Impact

The integration is expected to generate additional protocol activity, resulting in:
- Increased trading volume
- Additional bridge usage
- Higher protocol revenues
- Additional revenue streams for the BIM DAO
- Increased visibility of BIM Exchange within the Plume ecosystem

No additional DAO treasury allocation is required for this integration.

Strategic Benefits
This proposal positions BIM Exchange to:

- Access the rapidly growing Plume ecosystem
- Expand into the Real World Asset (RWA) sector
- Increase protocol usage and transaction volume
- Diversify supported blockchain ecosystems
- Become a leading DEX aggregator on Plume
- Strengthen BIM's visibility among institutional and DeFi participants
- Generate additional recurring revenues for the DAO

Risks & Considerations
Technical integration complexity
Dependency on the continued growth of the Plume ecosystem
Liquidity maturity during the ecosystem's expansion phase

Infrastructure maintenance requirements
A complete technical review and validation process will be conducted prior to deployment.

**Voting Options:**
✅ For — Approve BIP0XX and authorize the integration of the Plume Network into BIM Exchange.

❌ Against — Reject the proposal.

⚪ Abstain — No position.

**Voting Instructions:**

- Connect to the voting platform using your wallet. 
- Select the proposal regarding the opening of vote submissions.
- Choose the option that you believe best aligns with the vision and strategic objectives of BIM Protocol
 - Confirm your vote.

**Voting Period:**
Voting will begin on [30/07/2026] and conclude on [02/08/2027]

We encourage every member of the BIM Protocol community to participate in this crucial vote. Your voice will guide the future of our platform and strengthen our position in the blockchain
ecosystem.

Discussion (optional): https://governance.bim.finance/t/temp-check-integration-of-the-plume-network-on-bim-exchange/64

title: Requesting 8.5M GIV from to continue GIVpower rewards until Feb 2027
body:
Our 6th period of GIVpower staking incentives has closed and we’re late on an extension!

**Current program ended: July 23, 2026**
**Request:** Top up staking incentives on Optimism & Gnosis Chain for 6.5 months until Feb 2, 2027
**Request amount:** 8,500,000 GIV
**From:** GIVgarden bucket (controlled by GIV holders)

## Justification

According to our dune dashboard, the amount of GIV staked over the last 7 months has increased at a rate of about 2.4%/month. Since the slope is relatively low and the last period we have kept reward rates the same, I am proposing to just extend the rewards with the same total amount we did the last two 6 month periods (8.5M GIV) and, as the last time, keep the same rewards amount every 2 weeks for consistent APRs.

![Screenshot 2026-07-29 at 12.39.28 PM.png](ipfs://bafkreihlc2pgx4bvqnemt6775m2sxrzgmcmb3pbmbu3sqwqzippo56dquq)

In [this spreadsheet](https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1neUUsppi4HZ5b0BlOUR60Vt2Hn-_e-hvoJeO20cTqyk/edit?gid=732335051#gid=732335051) on the GIVpower Jul '26 tab, I calculated the amounts for each notify reward period that we will set up and execute as soon as possible. The first two will be manual, with the first one executed as soon as possible to avoid further days with 0 rewards, and the subsequent ones will be programatic.

I am also proposing to keep the same distribution across chains, namely:

* **75% on Optimism**
* **25% on Gnosis**

## Conclusions

This proposal is asking GIV token holders for permission to:

* Use 8.5M GIV to extend GIVpower staking rewards on Optimism & Gnosis Chain from July 30, 2026 - Feb 2, 2027 (75%/25% on Optimism/Gnosis)

Since the current incentives has already ended, we will set up an extension as soon as possible while simultaneously following the governance process. If the community has change requests and a vote passes to confirm them, we will make changes to the program at that time.

Since the current incentives has already ended, we are working and excuting the extension alongside this vote. However, if this vote does not pass, we will make the appropriate changes.

Vote FOR - if you agree to the proposal as outlined.
Vote AGAINST - if you disagree with the proposal outlined.

title: OIP 9 - Establishing the Orbs DAO
body:
**Summary**:
The Orbs team has submitted a proposal (OIP-9) to establish the Orbs DAO, create the initial DAO multi-sig wallets and delegate the initial powers to the DAO .

If this vote is passed, the steps set forth in OIP-9 will be taken.

The final version of OIP-9 can be found here: https://github.com/orbs-network/OIPs/issues/10

For discussion, please visit the dedicated page at the Orbs discord or join us on Telegram.

***Proposal Voting Instructions***:
Three choices are being presented for community vote:

- APPROVE OIP-9.
- DECLINE OIP-9.
- ABSTAIN from deciding on OIP-9.

Only ORBS tokens that were staked at the Snapshot block (which is the time at which this proposal was created) are entitled to vote. Any changes after the Snapshot block, such as new staking or a change in delegated Guardians, will not be reflected in the voting power for this proposal.

Note that there is also an option allowing voters to abstain from voting. Voting power choosing this option will count for the quorum for this vote.

*Guardians*:
The default option is that the Guardians are entitled to vote on behalf of their entire delegated stake, unless a delegator opts out. Guardians should select their preferred option and sign the message via their wallet. Note that voting is gasless and occurs off chain, but using signed transactions that can be verified onchain if necessary.

*Delegators*:
If a Delegator wishes to vote on their own behalf, they are permitted to do so.

Please consider carefully if you want to allow your Guardian to vote on your behalf or exercise your vote independently. If you want to allow your Guardian to vote on your behalf, you don’t need to take any action. If you want to vote on your own, select your preferred option and sign the message via your wallet.

**Requirements of the Snapshot**:
This proposal will be live and open for voting for a period of 7 days, and will be considered final based on all votes submitted within that period. The Orbs OIP Github repo will be edited in accordance with the governance vote results.

The vote will be considered final if 100M staked ORBS Tokens (approximately 10% of total stake) vote within 7 days, including abstentions. If the option to “APPROVE” the proposal receives the highest percentage of votes, it will be implemented as soon as practicable.

You can change your vote as long as the proposal window on Snapshot is still live, with the last vote being the one that counts.
