title: SCP‑220: Renewal of the International UX Workstream, September 2026 to December 2026
body:
**Workstream Name:** International UX Workstream

**Workstream Leader:** **Giantkin**

* Empowered per SCP‑92 and SCP‑151 (granted budget allocation, administrative authority, and leadership responsibilities).  
* Oversees contributor payments and bounty distributions, and manages the Workstream budget.  
* Requests no personal compensation during this term.

**Executive Contributor:** **Fireb0mb1**  
**International UX and Translations Lead ([Full Job Description](https://docs.google.com/document/d/1U5lrTWiWmxIUQJvaORJQHmWSyxRQpRrc0dTjNyUdPak/edit?usp=sharing))**

* Responsible for operational execution of translations  
  * Translation coordination, translation tooling setup/maintenance  
  * French translations  
  * QA reviews, bounty translations budget tracking, and DAO documentation updates concerning translation processes.  
* Contributes to Ops/Engineering efforts through frequent testing, bug reporting, and UI refinement suggestions. Both to enhance the quality of the English and localized user experiences (UX).  
* Maintains the [listings for ShapeShift products](https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1Xh1ikz2O-8dwKdZEV31kuKdxbldPjqF8u4PUsnSv388/edit?usp=sharing) that require any amount of development and GitHub Pull requests (e.g. Zapper, Defilama, ethereum.org, etc.).  
* Ensures community engagement on Discord (sometimes referred to as the “greeter” role) to guide users seeking help/support or just joining our community.

## Summary

Following the first term of International UX Workstream, there are still recurrent translation/maintenance needed but the cadence of work has diminished, so this proposal for a renewal scales down the budget by approximately 45%. It remains under the leadership of Giantkin. The length of the term is also reduced, this time, at the request of the DFC in order to align with other Workstreams’ future renewals and the calendar year, making the overall budget planning for the DAO easier to manage.

The Workstream will continue to provide professional multilingual support and a variety of important operational activities overseen by Fireb0mb1 (previously within the MKDB Workstream). The Workstream will ensure high-quality translations of ShapeShift’s app and website in order to preserve brand trust and global user engagement. The term will run from September 1, 2026, through December 31, 2026\.

## Abstract

The translation services and other operational activities described here have already been provided to the DAO by the same team of qualified contributors under multiple Workstreams over the year and for the last 6 months as a standalone Workstream.

## Motivation

Translations are essential for a global DeFi platform like ShapeShift, providing clarity and trust for international users making financial decisions. During the current Workstream’s term (\~6 months), approximately 20% of users who connected a wallet used a language other than English. This metric has been maintained stable from the start of the previous term.

To preserve this, the Workstream will:

* Provide translations for:  
  * The app: [app.shapeshift.com](http://app.shapeshift.com) in French, German, Japanese, Portuguese, Russian, Spanish, Turkish, Ukrainian, and Simplified Chinese.  
  * The official Website: [shapeshift.com](http://shapeshift.com) in French (manually reviewed), German, Russian, Spanish, and Simplified Chinese.  
* Maintain the tasks and role executed by Fireb0mb1 (see Job Description above)  
* Continue tests, bug reporting, UX improvements, and suggestions in both English and translated versions of the app.

For information, the automation for translations using AI agents which had been started by Engineering in February 2026 has now been paused due to both lacking funding and motivation considering the lower volume of translations required. This leaves the task exclusively to our translators who do use Machine Translation partially (but not in an automated manner, every translation is manually crafted/reviewed).

From a financial standpoint, quality translations still show as a strategically valuable investment for the DAO. Over the last term (6 months), users whose app locale was set to a non-English language generated approximately $5.03 million in trading volume, resulting in about $30,180 in protocol revenues (assuming the constant 60 bps). This is about 27% of the total volume (English included) for this period.

At the same time, the cost of the previous Workstream’s term was $25,100, meaning localization efforts covered and exceeded their cost. This assumes translations have driven part/most of the non‑English trading volume, which is likely but difficult to prove. This also doesn’t include the revenues from [private.shapeshift.com](http://private.shapeshift.com) where such tracking is not possible, but it suggests the overall impact of localization is likely higher.

Translation expenses are relatively fixed and independent of trading volume or user count but promote a wider global access to the DAO’s services, therefore, any growth in these areas enabled by these translations directly increases the DAO’s net revenue.

## Specification

### Translation Bounties

* 7 active translators are maintaining the following languages: German, Japanese, Portuguese, Russian, Spanish, Turkish, Ukrainian, and Chinese. All native speakers, experienced in crypto, and with knowledge of the ShapeShift products acquired over the years.  
* Current translation bounty rates: **$0.16 per word** (equivalent value in FOX).  
* Fireb0mb1 maintains a transparent budgeting spreadsheet. Giantkin is in charge of the monthly distribution of the bounty compensations.

### Budget Summary

[Full Budget Spreadsheet](https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1wetAHzgvwx552sbcAgD5dTKM2_xZSSdFz8WbzwWvlQM/edit)

#### Recurrent monthly:

* Fireb0mb1 (Part Time): $2,000 paid in FOX  
* Bounty translators (On-demand): $250 paid in FOX.  
  This amount varies monthly based on the volume of work. The latter depends on the frequency/size of the new features and changes in the app. This budget estimation is relying on the previous term’s volume.

  The previous budget for bounty translations was largely spent as planned, currently 38,309.37 FOX are left  (\~$160 at the current rate) and will be transferred to the next term if the Workstream were to be renewed, otherwise they will be returned to the DAO.  
  Likewise, any surplus from this budget item will be returned to the DAO or transferred to the next term if the Workstream were to be renewed.

#### Tooling/Misc.:

* Weglot “Pro” Plan has been renewed for a full year in July (at a preferable rate) with the funds allocated thus the line is zeroed out for this term.  
* Gitlocalize: $0 (Translation SaaS platform for the app translations, currently free).

**Four-Month Total:** $9,000 (paid in FOX)

**Compensation Policy:**

* All salaries and compensations for contributors and bounties are paid in FOX.  
* The DAO contributors may choose to receive locked FOX incentives (per SCP-81), this does not apply to bounties.

## Benefits

* Ensures seamless continuity with proven translators familiar with ShapeShift’s brand and DeFi-specific terminology.  
* Delivers professional translations to maintain trust and credibility for international users of our financial app.  
* Supports global accessibility (\~20% non-English users) to widen the potential audience of our products.  
* Generates positive ROI by supporting non-English user segments that already drive significant trade volumes.  
* Retains Fireb0mb1's proven coordination role for translations, UX testing, bug reporting, and community support.

## Drawbacks

* The Workstream introduces a recurring monthly expense which may reduce treasury flexibility for other initiatives.  
* The ROI on these services depends on growing volume, a major decline in international usage could reduce its direct profitability.  
* The Workstream generally requires coordination with other Workstreams (currently mostly Engineering) to keep content aligned and translatable across languages which occasionally involves small time commitments from those teams.

## Goals and KPIs

* Maintain translation coverage for all supported languages with an overall target of 95% of content translated at all times.  
* Deliver and maintain accurate language glossaries and rules to support Engineering’s AI-assisted translation pipeline, enabling measurable efficiency improvements.  
* Support improving UX through proactive testing, bug reporting, and UI/UX feedback in both English and localized versions.

## Vote

*Yes*: Approve the creation and funding of a 6-month International UX Workstream (September 1 2026 to December 31, 2026).

*No*: Reject this proposal. Evaluate other alternatives

*Yes, with changes*: Support this proposal but request modifications. Please specify changes in comments/forum.

title: CBT Unlock Mechanism Upgrade/ CBT 解锁机制升级
body:
🗳 CBT Unlock Mechanism Upgrade

📖 Proposal Background

To further optimize the CBT unlock mechanism, balancing user fund flexibility while encouraging long-term participation and reducing the pressure of short-term concentrated unlocks, we are proposing an upgrade to the CBT unlock mechanism.

📋 Proposal Details

The CBT earnings/principal unlock schedule will be adjusted as follows:

· 0-day unlock: 30%  
· 30-day unlock: 20%  
· 60-day unlock: 10%  
· 90-day unlock: 5%  
· 120-day unlock: 2%

Special Note:  
CBT that has already entered the unlock process will not be affected by this new policy and will continue to follow the existing rules. The new policy applies only to newly initiated CBT unlock applications.

🎯 Adjustment Objectives

To provide users with more unlock period options. The longer the lock-up period, the lower the unlock cost. To reduce the pressure on the ecosystem caused by short-term concentrated unlocks. To encourage long-term co-building, aligning participants' interests with the long-term development of the ecosystem.

🗳 Voting Options

👍 YES: Approve the implementation of the new CBT unlock mechanism

👎 NO: Maintain the current CBT unlock mechanism

———————————————-

🗳 CBT 解锁机制升级

📖 提案背景

为了进一步优化 CBT 解锁机制，在兼顾用户资金灵活性的同时，鼓励长期参与、降低短期集中解锁压力，现提出 CBT 解锁机制升级方案。

📋 提案内容

CBT 收益 / 本金解锁调整为：

· 0 天解锁：30%  
· 30 天解锁：20%  
· 60 天解锁：10%  
· 90 天解锁：5%  
· 120 天解锁：2%

特别说明：  
已经进入解锁流程的 CBT 不受本次新政策影响，继续按照原有规则执行。新政策仅适用于新发起的 CBT 解锁申请。

🎯 调整目的

给予用户更多解锁周期选择。锁定时间越长，解锁成本越低。降低短期集中解锁对生态造成的压力。鼓励长期共建，让参与者利益与生态长期发展保持一致。

🗳 投票选项

👍 YES：同意实行新的 CBT 解锁机制

👎 NO：维持现行 CBT 解锁机制

title: CBT Unlock Fee Distribution Mechanism Adjustment/ CBT 解锁手续费分配机制调整
body:
🗳 CBT Unlock Fee Distribution Mechanism Adjustment

📖 Proposal Background

As the POTS ecosystem continues to develop, in order to further strengthen the value cycle between the two major ecosystem assets, IBS and POTS, and to enable CBT unlock fees to play a more comprehensive ecological role, we are proposing an adjustment to the fee distribution ratios for collective voting by the DAO community.

⸻

📋 Proposal Details:

CBT unlock fees:

75% → Used to purchase IBS

25% → Used to purchase POTS

⸻

🎯 Adjustment Objectives

To upgrade the CBT unlock fee from a single-direction flow-back to POTS into a two-way value return mechanism of IBS + POTS.

By increasing market buy demand for IBS, further strengthening the IBS ecological cycle; while retaining 25% to continuously flow back to POTS, ensuring that POTS continues to receive long-term value support from CBT fees.

The ultimate goal is to form:

CBT unlock → Fee generation → 75% IBS + 25% POTS → Value returns to the ecosystem

⸻

🗳 Voting Options

👍 YES: Approve adjusting the CBT unlock fee from 100% flowing back to POTS to: 75% used to purchase IBS + 25% used to purchase POTS

👎 NO: Maintain the current plan of 100% flowing back to POTS

———————————————

🗳 CBT 解锁手续费分配机制调整

📖 提案背景

随着 POTS 生态持续发展，为进一步强化 IBS 与 POTS 两大生态资产之间的价值循环，并让 CBT 解锁手续费发挥更全面的生态作用，现提出调整手续费资金分配比例，由 DAO 社区共同投票决定。

⸻

📋 提案內容：

CBT 解锁手续费：

75% → 用于购买 IBS

25% → 用于购买 POTS

⸻

🎯 调整目的

让 CBT 解锁手续费从单一回流 POTS，升级为 IBS + POTS 双向价值回流机制。

通过增加 IBS 的市场购买需求，进一步强化 IBS 生态循环；同时保留 25% 持续回流 POTS，让 POTS 依然能够获得 CBT 手续费带来的长期价值支持。

最终形成：

CBT 解锁 → 手续费产生 → 75% IBS + 25% POTS → 价值回流生态

⸻

🗳 投票选项

👍 YES：同意将 CBT 解锁手续费从 100% 回流 POTS 调整为：75% 购买 IBS + 25% 购买 POTS

👎 NO：维持现行方案100% 回流 POTS

title: PIP-5: Establishing the Pieverse Staking Program and Reward Model
body:
## Summary

This proposal formally establishes the Pieverse staking program as a mechanism for long-term participation and alignment across the ecosystem.

The program will allow PIEVERSE holders to stake their tokens and asks the community to determine how staking participation should be rewarded: through token rewards, platform revenue, platform perks, or enhanced governance voting power.

## Motivation

As the Pieverse ecosystem expands, token holders need a clear mechanism through which they can express long-term commitment and participate more directly in its continued development.

Staking strengthens alignment between token holders, platform activity, and ecosystem growth. The form of its rewards should reflect how the community wants long-term participation to be recognized.

Token rewards provide direct on-chain incentives. Platform revenue connects staking rewards to economic activity generated through Pieverse. Platform perks provide practical utility within the platform through benefits such as free instances and AI credits. Enhanced governance voting power gives long-term stakers greater influence over the future direction of the ecosystem.

## Specification

The Pieverse Foundation formally declares the following:

1. **Staking as Long-Term Alignment** — The Pieverse staking program will provide PIEVERSE holders with a mechanism to demonstrate long-term commitment to the ecosystem and participate in its continued growth.
2. **Token Rewards** — Tokens released under the existing token-unlock schedule may be designated and distributed as staking rewards.
3. **Platform Revenue** — Eligible revenue generated by the Pieverse platform may be allocated to staking rewards. This includes service fees collected by Pieverse when users trade through integrated venues such as Hyperliquid, as well as transaction fees, instance purchases, and other applicable platform charges.
4. **Platform Perks** — Stakers may receive benefits that can be used directly across the Pieverse platform. These may include free instance vouchers, free AI credits, fee rebates, ecosystem airdrops, priority access, partner benefits, reward boosts, and reputation- or tier-based benefits.
5. **Governance Voting Power** — Stakers who commit their tokens for six months or longer may receive enhanced voting power in Pieverse governance proposals. The applicable multiplier and calculation method will be disclosed before implementation.
6. **Community-Determined Reward Model** — The form of staking rewards will be determined through this governance vote.
7. **Transparency and Adaptability** — Material staking conditions, reward calculations, and distributions will be communicated publicly. The framework may evolve as platform usage, ecosystem needs, and governance decisions develop over time.

インドネシアの観光施設「Noyo Gimbal View」に、Nounsキャラクターを模した3輪電動スクーター10台と専用ステーションを設置する。

提案者Degumaは、共同創業者兼マネージャーを務めるインドネシアの観光施設「Noyo Gimbal View」に、異なるNounsキャラクターをデザインした3輪電動スクーター10台を導入する。

来場者がスクーターへの乗車、写真・動画の撮影、SNSへの投稿を行える体験型アトラクションとして運営する。同施設の平均来場者数は月間約29,000人で、試作車「Nouns Zebra」はすでに完成し、現地での来場者テストも実施済み。

運営はNoyo Gimbal Viewの管理チームが担当し、乗車オペレーター2名と、X・Farcaster・Instagram・TikTok・Facebook向けの広報・コンテンツ制作担当者1名をフルタイムで雇用する。日常運営、スタッフ管理、車両整備、事業成長、運営・財務報告を行い、純利益の20%をNounsへ還元する。さらに純利益の5%を車両の定期整備、部品交換、安全点検のために確保する。

Over the past few years, DreamDAO has always been about experimentation, education, and creating opportunities for young people to grow. At the same time, our treasury has seen relatively little deployment recently, leaving an opportunity to invest in initiatives that directly advance that mission.
That’s why I’d like to propose using a portion of the treasury to support my participation at Blockchain.RIO 2026 (August 11–15), Brazil’s largest blockchain and digital assets conference.
This proposal isn’t simply about attending a conference. It’s about investing in the continued growth of a builder who has consistently contributed to DreamDAO and who will bring that knowledge, network, and experience back to the community.
Why Me?
Since joining DreamDAO, some of my contributions include:
Raising over $15,000 for DreamDAO during my time as Co-Steward in 2023.
Building the DreamDAO Knowledge Hub to make Web3 education more accessible + hosting sessions for CU Community.
Creating educational content and sharing insights from ETHCC 2025 to keep our community connected to the broader ecosystem.
Today, I’m pursuing a Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science while building my career in Web3 across startups, community, and product.
One of DreamDAO’s core goals has always been to help young builders grow professionally and educationally. Attending Blockchain.RIO is an opportunity to continue that journey: learning from some of the industry’s leading founders, developers, researchers, and companies while creating resources that benefit the entire DreamDAO community.
Objectives
1. Grow as a DreamDAO Builder
Attend technical talks, workshops, and networking events to deepen my understanding of blockchain technology, product development, AI, and the evolving crypto ecosystem.
As a Computer Science student and Web3 builder, this experience would accelerate both my technical education and my professional development, exactly the kind of growth DreamDAO exists to support.
2. Expand Mine + DreamDAO’s Network
Connect with founders, developers, investors, and organizations such as Visa, Solana, Binance, Cardano ecosystem teams, and other leading companies building the future of crypto and digital finance.
These relationships can create future opportunities not only for me, but also for DreamDAO through collaborations, speakers, educational initiatives, and ecosystem partnerships.

Following the conference, I will produce:
Live coverage and educational posts on the DreamDAO X account throughout the event.
A comprehensive learning artifact summarizing the current state of crypto in 2026, covering major trends, infrastructure, AI, stablecoins, regulation, consumer applications, and emerging opportunities for young builders.
This is what we usually require from attendees of conferences since we started to fund young builders to travel to those.
Why Fund This?
This proposal directly aligns with DreamDAO’s mission of investing in the next generation of Web3 builders.
Funding this initiative would:
Support the continued growth of an active DreamDAO contributor.
Put treasury funds toward an initiative with tangible educational outcomes.
Increase our visibility within one of Latin America’s largest blockchain conferences.
Create lasting educational resources for current and future members.
Strengthen connections across the broader Web3 ecosystem.
Budget Requested
US$1,750
This budget will cover:
Conference ticket
Travel
Accommodation
Food and local transportation
I’m happy to incorporate additional deliverables or suggestions from the community to maximize the value of this initiative for DreamDAO.

title: # [GIP-288] Update global infrastructure for RWA markets and protocol tooling
body:
# Summary

This proposal introduces four updates to Gearbox’s global infrastructure:

- Allows Account Factory v3.11, which creates a new Credit Account for every account opening and does not reuse closed accounts;
- Adds `LOGGER` as a public domain in the Bytecode Repository;
- Registers the Price Feed Compressor in the Address Provider;
- Authorizes a new MixBytes auditor address following a change of CTO at MixBytes.


# Motivation

## Account Factory v3.11

The proposed [Account Factory implementation](https://github.com/Gearbox-protocol/core-v3/blob/dd1e0be09fccd22c4c3e89681b840716baaf739f/contracts/core/DefaultAccountFactoryV3.sol) is designed to better accommodate permissioned and RWA markets.

Previous Account Factory implementations could return a closed Credit Account to the factory and later assign it to another borrower. Account Factory v3.11 changes this behavior:

- Every account opening deploys a new Credit Account;
- Returning a Credit Account to the factory is disabled;
- A previously used Credit Account is never reassigned to another borrower.

This creates a clearer relationship between each Credit Account and the borrower for whom it was created, addressing regulatory and record-keeping concerns associated with account reuse.

The proposal allows the audited bytecode as a system contract in the Bytecode Repository.

## `LOGGER` public domain

The proposal adds `LOGGER` to the Bytecode Repository’s public domains.

Public domains allow new implementations within that domain to be registered without separate DAO approval for every version, provided that the bytecode has been uploaded and signed by an authorized auditor.

This enables audited logger contracts to be introduced through the standard public-contract process. It does not modify existing protocol contracts or grant logger contracts access to user funds.

## Price Feed Compressor

The [Price Feed Compressor](https://etherscan.io/address/0x1fA2637B9fab0CD14290A7EE908DDc9688a15120) is registered in the Address Provider under `GLOBAL::PRICE_FEED_COMPRESSOR`.

This makes the compressor discoverable through the protocol’s canonical Address Provider, removing the need for interfaces and integrations to maintain a hardcoded address.

This is an infrastructure and discoverability change only. It does not change any price feed, oracle configuration, pricing logic, or risk parameter.

## New MixBytes auditor address

Following a change of CTO at MixBytes, MixBytes requested that Gearbox authorize a new address for signing audited bytecode.

The proposal adds [0x749e8dcf…](https://etherscan.io/address/0x749e8dcf9c5BeC1cD69Ad8d04Ae8146DD5EaB647) to the Bytecode Repository under the name `Mixbytes (Cartlex)`.

Once authorized, audit reports signed by this address can be recognized by the Bytecode Repository.

# Proposed changes

If approved, the proposal will execute the following global actions:

| # | Component | Action |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | Bytecode Repository | Add [0x749e8dcf…](https://etherscan.io/address/0x749e8dcf9c5BeC1cD69Ad8d04Ae8146DD5EaB647) as an authorized auditor named `Mixbytes (Cartlex)` |
| 2 | Bytecode Repository | Add `LOGGER` as a public domain |
| 3 | Bytecode Repository | Allow Account Factory v3.11 bytecode with hash `0x62a4ce7cddcc67c9ad5b6e12560620962741dd558bd452626bdbce6a7c7bbfce` as a system contract |
| 4 | Address Provider | Save [0x1fA2637B…](https://etherscan.io/address/0x1fA2637B9fab0CD14290A7EE908DDc9688a15120) under `GLOBAL::PRICE_FEED_COMPRESSOR`, with version tracking enabled |

The complete proposed transaction construction is available in the [`global-setup2.ts` script](https://github.com/Gearbox-protocol/permissionless-interface/blob/staging/packages/scripts/src/commands/global-setup2.ts).

# Transaction log
Txs can be found [here](https://gearboxprotocol.notion.site/GIP-288-3b6145c162248008afeafd9aa7d1992a?source=copy_link)

title: CLUBS INTERGRATION AND BUILDING
body:
## **Club Niches Integration into WEB3 Academy**

### **Building Communities Around Learning, Participation & Contribution**

We propose adding **Club Niches** to the existing WEB3 Academy registration system.

The purpose is to help students, mentors and professionals identify the **community or professional area** they want to participate in—not simply select one subject or one mentor.

This upgrade uses the **existing Academy tools**: Learning Spaces, Voting Pools, Library & Books, Projects, Matrix and NFT Profiles.

---

## 2. Where Will Clubs Appear?

**Club selection will appear during registration as a niche/category selection**, alongside existing areas such as:

**Blockchain • Web3 • AI • Agriculture • Healthcare • Education • Technology • Business • Other professional and community niches**
![WhatsApp Image 2026-08-08 at 04.35.24.jpeg](ipfs://bafybeiffd5l4ijxnnefv6p4m4afydithxf2pnvm2joomtvxtdgj3n4pcoq)
### For a Student

When a student selects a Club niche, it means:

> **“I am joining a community where I can participate in daily learning and activities.”**

It does **not** mean:

> “I am only registering for one mentor's course.”

Students can join relevant Clubs and discover Learning Spaces, books, discussions, polls and projects connected to those communities.

### For a Mentor

When a mentor selects a Club niche, it means:

> **“I am identifying the community I can help build and contribute knowledge to.”**

The mentor can then create relevant Learning Spaces, share materials, organize activities and invite other mentors or specialists when additional knowledge is needed.

---

# 3. How It Works

**Choose Club Niche**
↓
**Join / Build Community**
↓
**Learning Spaces**
↓
**Books & Library**
↓
**Voting Pools**
↓
**Projects & Activities**
↓
**Matrix Connections**
↓
**Learning & Contribution History**
↓
**NFT Profile**

---
![WhatsApp Image 2026-08-08 at 04.35.25.jpeg](ipfs://bafybeic7fxqvg544vcwi2cwu4tu7wkdqiimdmun4o7dcdpotxytwiolnuq)
# 4. Examples

### 👨‍🏫 Teachers

A teacher joins the **Teachers Club**.

**Individual:** shares teaching materials and creates a Learning Space.

**Group:** teachers collaborate, vote on what they need to learn, invite a tutor and develop education projects together.

### 🩺 Doctors & Nurses
![WhatsApp Image 2026-08-08 at 04.35.25 (1).jpeg](ipfs://bafybeieacqcnbpiupzxqzcaby2yvwsgsofhsyjivqr5cbnbjksye6cxkbu)
They can create professional health Clubs where members share knowledge, create Learning Spaces, organize projects and collaborate across institutions.

### 🎓 College & University Students

Students can join course, professional or interest-based Clubs, learn together, share books, vote, build projects and develop their academic contribution history.

### 👮 Police & Army Communities

Where permitted by institutional policy, approved communities can use appropriate Clubs for professional learning, teamwork and knowledge-sharing activities.

---

# 5. Why This Matters

Club Niches make WEB3 Academy more useful to **institutions and partnership communities**.

Instead of inviting an institution only to use a learning platform, we can invite its people to **build their own communities inside the ecosystem**.

Teachers can build teacher communities.

Nurses can build nursing communities.

Students can build academic communities.

Professionals can build career communities.

Institutions can connect their people to **learning, participation, projects and digital professional histories.**

---

# 6. DAO Decision

This proposal does **not require replacing Learning Spaces or creating a new platform.**

It introduces **Club Niches as a new registration and community layer** that connects people to the Academy's existing tools.

### 🗳️ Voting Question

> **Should WEB3 Academy add Club Niches to the registration system, allowing students and mentors to choose or build communities around their professions, interests and shared goals, and use existing Learning Spaces, Voting Pools, Library, Matrix and NFT Profiles for continuous learning, participation and contribution?**

### 🟢 YES

Approve Club Niches integration.

### 🟡 YES, WITH RECOMMENDATIONS

Approve the concept with community recommendations.

### 🔴 NO

Do not implement the upgrade in its current form.

---

### **The Vision**

**Club = Community**
**Learning Space = Knowledge**
**Voting = Voice**
**Projects = Contribution**
**NFT Profile = History**

**One platform. Many communities. A growing digital journey.**

title: 100,000 NFT PROFILE:The WEB3Space Blockchain Milestone
body:
### **What Happens When We Reach 100,000 NFT Profiles?**
![WhatsApp Image 2026-08-08 at 11.50.41.jpeg](ipfs://bafybeigtonzyvjgi6n5lezdv36ujhnbzs72gdd6ymb3trrkffytoq2aume)
The first **100,000 NFT Profiles** are an important milestone for WEB3 Academy. They can mark the proposed move from simply **recording community participation** to building our own **WEB3Space Blockchain**.

---

## 1. 🗳️ Participation Becomes a Record

Learning Space voting pools record participation.

**Example:**
If Kelvin joins a Learning Space and votes in **10 polls**, he receives **10 WEB3Space participation rewards**.

It is like keeping a notebook that says:

> **“Kelvin participated 10 times.”**

The number stays in his profile and can continue growing.

---

## 2. 💵 The $1 Helps Build the Blockchain

Each Student NFT contributes:

**$1 → WEB3Space Blockchain Development Fund**

**Example:**
If **100 students** mint NFTs:

**100 × $1 = $100**

If **100,000 students** mint:

**100,000 × $1 = $100,000**

This creates the proposed **$100,000 development target** for the blockchain MVP.

### **100K NFT Profiles → $100K Development Milestone**

---

## 3. 🔢 Participation Helps Create Utility

When the blockchain is ready, the accumulated participation from Learning Space voting can become the basis for the initial WEB3Space utility-token supply, subject to DAO approval.

**Example:**
Imagine:

**100,000 students**

and each participates in:

**1,000 votes**

Then:

**100,000 × 1,000 = 100,000,000 participation units**

Under this proposed model, **100 million units** could form the initial maximum utility-token supply.

The final tokenomics and migration rules would still require DAO approval.

---

## 4. 🔄 What Happens to the Rewards?

After the blockchain is ready:

**Participation Records**
↓
**DAO Approval**
↓
**WEB3Space Blockchain**
↓
**On-Chain Rewards**

**Simple example:**
A student has accumulated participation rewards through hundreds of Learning Space votes. After approved migration, those rewards can become on-chain WEB3Space utility.

They could potentially be used for:

* NFT migration fees
* Blockchain transaction/gas fees
* Approved Academy activities
* Peer-to-peer transfers
* Future ecosystem utilities

---

## 5. 🤝 First 100K → Next 900K

The first 100,000 members help establish the foundation.

**Example:**

The first **100,000 students** help build the road.

The next **900,000 students** can use that road.

### **100K → Build the Foundation**

### **900K → Grow the Network**

### **1M → One Connected Ecosystem**

---

## 6. ♾️ Why Does Participation Keep Growing?

The participation number is different from the transferable blockchain balance.

**Example:**

If Asha has participated **500 times**, her profile can show:

**Participation History: 500**

Next year she participates another **200 times**:

**500 + 200 = 700**

Her history does not become 200.

It becomes:

### **700 Total Participation**

This tells the story of how much she has contributed to the Academy.

---

## 7. 💎 What About the Token's Price?

The reward gaining blockchain utility does **not guarantee a market price**.

**Simple example:**
Students may decide through governance how the token should be used, but its actual market value would depend on **real usage, supply, demand and participants**.

Exchanges would also independently decide whether to support it.

### **Utility First. Speculation Second.**

---

# 🌍 THE BIG MILESTONE

Imagine WEB3 Academy as a growing city.

**Students participate** → we record the activity.

**100K NFT Profiles** → the foundation becomes strong enough to begin the blockchain phase.

**Blockchain** → participation can gain on-chain utility.

**Next 900K** → more people join and use the network.

### **100K → BLOCKCHAIN → UTILITY → 1 MILLION**

**From learning participation today to community-powered infrastructure tomorrow.**

title: Should the DAO Mandate an Annual Review and Update of All Governance Documents?
body:
> by 0x7bbea9c18cd0541acab8c19da2b11d0c03faef1c (Mxyzptlk)

## Linked Draft Proposal
[Should the DAO Mandate an Annual Review and Update of All Governance Documents?](https://decentraland.org/governance/proposal/?id=0ef1b25f-9d29-441d-93d0-eee26b7fa3ba)

## Summary

Makes Governance Documents Annual Review permanent policy: DAO Council reviews and updates core governance docs yearly, with a 30-day trigger for structural changes, a fixed minimum-scope list, and a public accountability report each cycle.


## Abstract

This proposal makes the Governance Documents Annual Review permanent DAO policy. It follows two passed community votes: the pre-proposal poll (1,008,422 VP, 100% Yes) and the Draft Proposal, both confirming community support for a standing, structured review of governance documentation.

It establishes:

1.  An annual review cycle for all core governance documents.
2.  A 30-day trigger clause requiring documentation updates within 30 days of any structural governance change.
3.  A defined minimum scope of documents that must be kept current
4.  An accountability framework making the DAO Council directly responsible for execution, with authority to commission outside help.

This proposal does not create new governance bodies or shift budget authority. It assigns an existing responsibility, keeping core documentation accurate, to an existing body, the DAO Council, on a fixed schedule with a public compliance report.


## Motivation

Every functioning organization, public or private, traditional or decentralized, maintains its governing documents as living records. Corporations update their bylaws when their structure changes. Nonprofits review their charters annually. Government agencies publish updated procedures when policies change. This is not bureaucratic overhead. It is the minimum standard for any organization that expects its participants to follow rules and processes that are written down and accurate.

The Decentraland DAO currently has no such requirement. Documents may be created when a proposal passes and never touched again. Two specific examples are already confirmed on the public record: the DAO Council's roles and responsibilities are not documented in any single official maintained source, and the DAO's community-approved mission and vision statements, voted on through governance in 2024, have never been published in an official maintained DAO document. They passed through governance and were never formally recorded anywhere the community is expected to look.
(The only place you find these is by attempting to search for them in completed proposals

That is the problem this proposal is designed to fix. Not just discoverability, but the absence of any process to ensure governance decisions are documented, kept current, and maintained by someone accountable for doing so.

This is not a hypothetical risk. On July 7, 2026, a Foundation representative stated in Discord that DAO references were removed from the main Decentraland site to avoid being associated with "web3" publicly, a claim the Foundation has since described as inconsistent with its stated position that it is not distancing from the DAO. Whatever the intent, the DAO's own governance link disappeared from the main site nav, and the contradiction between the two statements is now part of the public record. Outdated and contradictory documentation is not a cosmetic problem. It is how participants lose track of who is accountable for what, and it is a documented factor in DAO legal exposure (see CFTC v. Ooki DAO, 2023; Samuels v. Lido, ongoing). A DAO whose own published description of itself does not match its operating reality cannot demonstrate representative governance or informed consent from participants.
[Discord Conversation](https://discord.com/channels/417796904760639509/538106198419832844/1524123898910871592)
\[Attach: DCL Discord Conversation screenshot]

These gaps affect every community member who tries to understand how the DAO works, every new participant who reads the documentation and forms an inaccurate picture of the current governance structure, and every accountability conversation that stalls because the rules are not written down anywhere reliable.

An annual review cycle with a structural change trigger is the minimum standard expected of any organization that takes its own governance seriously. This proposal asks the DAO to meet that standard.


## Specification

***Responsible Party***
DAO Council. The Council may execute the review directly or commission a contributor or vendor to do so, at its discretion, within existing budget authority.

\*\*\*Review and Approval: \*\*\*
Work done by a commissioned contributor or vendor is submitted as a draft, not a final publication. The Council reviews each draft and records a public approval, or requested changes, on the forum within 14 days of submission. Only Council-approved drafts are published as official governance documentation. If the Council does not respond within the 14-day window, the submission is automatically escalated to the next scheduled Council meeting for a vote. This applies regardless of who performs the work; the Council remains the final approver of anything published under this proposal.

***Annual Review Cycle:***
Once per calendar year, the Council conducts a full review of the minimum-scope document list below, verifies accuracy against current governance structure, and publishes an updated version of each document that has changed. The first review must be completed within 6 months of this proposal passing.

***30-day Trigger Clause***:
Independent of the annual cycle, any structural governance change (a new role created, an existing process modified, a governance body deprecated, or a new mechanism introduced) triggers a requirement to update all affected documents within 30 days of the change taking effect.

Minimum scope (must be kept current at all times):

1.  The Governance Legislative Tracker, restored to public accessibility.
2.  DAO Council roles, responsibilities, and timeline obligations.
3.  Documentation describing how governance proposals advance through each stage
4.  A summary of the Regenesis Labs mandate and operational scope as it relates to DAO governance
5.  Wearable, emote, and creator submission guidelines and fees including where the fees go
6.  Any documentation describing DAO governance bodies, committees, or squads
7.  The DAO's approved mission and vision statements, and where they are published
8.  A List of who's who and bests way to contact them.

***Document Standard:***
Every document in the minimum scope carries a visible last-updated date, a version number, and a status marker (Draft or Official). A single shared changelog records who made each change, what changed, and when the Council approved it, keeping the documents themselves short while the full history stays one click away.

\*\*\*Accountability Framework: \*\*\*Each annual cycle concludes with a short public report to the forum stating which documents were reviewed, which were updated, and which are still pending, with reasons. If the Council commissions the work to a third party, that arrangement and its cost are disclosed in the same report. Failure to complete a review cycle or a 30-day trigger update must be explained publicly within 30 days of the missed deadline, with a revised timeline. No governance document becomes ownerless; ownership transfers must be publicly documented.

***Starting Point***: the community-drafted materials produced in July 2026 (DCL_DAO_How_It_Works_Updated, DCL_Governance_Entities, DCL_Mission_Vision, DCL_Council_Roles_Responsibilities, DCL_DAO_Legal_Status) are offered as a starting draft the Council may adopt, edit, or discard at its discretion. Their existence is proof this work is achievable without new tooling or budget.
****SEE ATTACHED DOCUMENTS****\*


## Impacts

If passed: governance documentation stops drifting further from reality every year. New and existing community members get an accurate, findable description of how decisions get made and who to contact. The 30-day trigger closes the specific failure mode already seen with docs.decentraland.org, where a structural change (deprecating old bodies) happened without a corresponding documentation update, and it has sat wrong for over two years. Public accountability reporting gives the community a way to track whether this is actually happening, instead of relying on informal follow-up.

There is a modest ongoing cost: Council time, or a commissioned contributor's fee, each year. No new governance body is created and no existing authority is transferred, so Council workload is the main cost, offset by using the July 2026 community draft as a starting point rather than starting from zero.

If it fails, or passes but is not enforced: documentation continues to describe deprecated bodies, the Legislative Tracker stays inaccessible, and the gap between what the DAO says about itself and how it actually operates keeps widening, with no standing mechanism to close it.


## Implementation Pathways

1.  Upon passage, the Council designates an owner (a Council member or commissioned contributor) for the first review cycle within 30 days.
2.  The owner reviews the minimum-scope list against current governance reality and either adopts, edits, or replaces the July 2026 community drafts, submitting the result to the Council as a draft.
3.  The Council reviews and approves the draft within 14 days, recording the approval or requested changes publicly on the forum.
4.  Only after Council approval are updated documents published to the appropriate official channels (docs.decentraland.org, governance portal, forum) within the review cycle.
5.  The Legislative Tracker is migrated off its current inaccessible format to a publicly reachable page.
6.  The Council publishes the first accountability report to the forum at the end of the cycle.
7.  The 30-day trigger clause takes effect immediately upon passage and applies to any structural change going forward, including changes already in progress (e.g., the wearables curator restructuring).
8.  This proposal, and each year's completed review, is itself added to the minimum scope list, so the review mechanism documents its own existence.


## Conclusion

The Decentraland DAO approved a mission that includes representative governance and efficient management of collective resources. Governance documents that are outdated, inaccessible, or simply wrong undermine both.
This is not a complex ask. It is the minimum that any serious organization maintains: a regular review cycle, a named responsible party, and a requirement that documentation reflects reality. The fact that it needs to be put through governance at all is itself evidence of why it is needed.

A properly maintained Governance Legislative Tracker, updated as required by this proposal, serves as the living directory of all current governance responsibilities, decisions, and accountable parties — making it the single reference point the community has never had.

**[This proposal is summarized due to technical limitations. To view it complete and vote on it, visit the DCL DAO Governance dApp](https://decentraland.org/governance/proposal/?id=47f93a25-ee84-4f51-a6b7-bd4d48c905ba)**

title: VRnouns Proposal: Sign Et, Hisse ve Altın Biriktir 🪙
body:
##Intro
##Body

VRnouns Proposal: Sign Et, Hisse ve Altın Biriktir 🪙
Tek Cümlede Öneri

Günlük sign ödülü ETH yerine, havuzda biriken parayla tokenize Nvidia, Google hissesi ve tokenize Altın alınsın; sign edenler payları kadar bunları claim etsin.

"Her gün sign et → her gün hisse + altın biriktir."

Nasıl Çalışır? (3 Adım)
Hiçbir şey değişmiyor: NFT tut, floor.fun'da günlük sign et — aynı akış.
Havuz otomatik alım yapar: Biriken ETH, düzenli aralıklarla smart contract ile şu sepete çevrilir:
🟢 %40 NVDA (tokenize Nvidia — NVDAx)
🔵 %30 GOOGL (tokenize Google — GOOGLx)
🟡 %30 GOLD (tokenize Altın — PAXG / XAUt, 1:1 fiziksel altınla destekli)
Claim et: Sign sayına göre 1 hissenin/1 onsun küsuratı kadar token cüzdanına gelir.

Sepet oranları sabit değil — topluluk her ay oylamayla ağırlıkları değiştirebilir.

Neden Altın da Var?
Denge: Hisseler düşerse altın portföyü korur. Sadece tech hissesi = tek yönlü risk.
Herkes anlar: "NFT tutuyorum, altın biriktiriyorum" cümlesi crypto bilmeyen birine bile anlatılabilir.
Kanıtlanmış ürün: PAXG ve XAUt yıllardır çalışan, fiziksel altınla 1:1 desteklenen tokenlar — hisse tokenlarından bile daha oturmuş bir altyapı.
Neden İlgi Çeker?
Bir ilk: ETH dağıtan binlerce proje var. Gerçek hisse + altın dağıtan daily-sign projesi yok.
Base bunu istiyor: Base ekosistemi onchain hisse senedi anlatısını büyütmeye çalışıyor — erken örnek olmak görünürlük getirir.
Otomatik birikim: Havuz düzenli alım yaptığı için topluluk adına otomatik DCA (kademeli alım) yapılmış olur.
Ekstra Fikirler (Opsiyonel)
Streak bonusu: 7 gün üst üste sign = 1.2x pay, 30 gün = 1.5x.
Portföy sayfası: Herkesin biriktirdiği hisse + altını gösteren paylaşılabilir bir "VRnouns Portfolio" ekranı.
Biriktir modu: Claim etmeyenlerin payı otomatik yeni alımlara eklenir (compound).
Bilinmesi Gerekenler
Hisse tokenları fiyat maruziyeti verir, gerçek hissedarlık hakkı (oy vb.) vermez.
ABD kullanıcıları xStocks'a erişemiyor — claim uygunluğu için jurisdiksiyon kontrolü şart.
Base'deki likidite ve swap maliyeti, alım sıklığı belirlenirken hesaba katılmalı.
Yol Haritası
Ön oylama: ETH mi, RWA sepeti mi, karma mı?
Sepet ve ihraççı seçimi (Backed / Ondo / Paxos)
Kontrat geliştirme + audit
Pilot: Havuzun %25'i ile 30 gün deneme
Sonuçlara göre tam geçiş oylaması

title: #Decision 59 // 🌟 Fresh D5 Token Issuance as of July 2026 and Transition to Direct On-Chain Operations due to Colony's Discontinuation
body:
This decision formally adopts the Company's transition from the Colony platform to a direct, intermediary-free on-chain operational model, and authorizes the discontinuation of the Company's existing D5 Token contract and the fresh issuance of D5 Tokens at a new contract address on the Arbitrum One network. The fresh issuance shall be distributed exclusively to the updated list of Token Holders who have confirmed their continued participation and provided verified wallet addresses.

**Background**
Following the Colony platform's technical malfunctions and its eventual discontinuation, and after consultation with all stakeholders regarding continued participation, the Executive Members have determined that a direct on-chain operational model best serves the Company's long-term operational continuity and independence from third-party infrastructure risks.

The Company's complete records covering the period from June 2023 through 2026 have been preserved as the official Historical Records, signed by all Executive Members via Adobe Sign and archived in the Core Company Documents.

Following the preservation of the Historical Records, the Company initiated formal email correspondence with all Token Holders to determine whether each individual wished to continue participating in the Company under the new operational model. Based on the responses received, the updated Token Holder list has been finalized, comprising only those Token Holders who confirmed their continued participation and provided verified wallet addresses. The Company's Token Holder registry and Core Company Documents have been updated accordingly.

**Scope of This Resolution**
By approving this proposal, the Executive Members resolve to:

1. Discontinue all operational reliance on the Colony platform effective immediately.

2. Discontinue the Company's existing D5 Token contract on the Arbitrum One network (0x05AdA8B671FF948D94A1040135fBFcB728c7A3c0). Tokens held under the legacy contract shall no longer be recognized by the Company for governance, participation, or any other Company purpose.

3. Authorize the fresh issuance of D5 Tokens at a new contract address on the Arbitrum One network. Such tokens shall be newly minted from a zero supply base and shall not constitute a technical migration, bridge, or swap of the legacy tokens.

4. Continue Company operations solely with those Token Holders who have confirmed their continued participation and provided verified wallet addresses. For each such participant, the newly issued D5 Tokens shall be calculated based on their aggregate contribution recognition as reflected in the Historical Records and distributed in a single consolidated on-chain transfer. This issuance constitutes recognition of contributions made from the Company's inception through the effective date of this Resolution and does not represent a payment, compensation, or purchase of tokens. Following this initial distribution, monthly issuance and distribution cycles shall resume in accordance with the Operating Agreement.

5. Update the Company's Operating Agreement to reflect the new operational structure, including the new token contract address and the direct on-chain distribution model.

6. Update the Snapshot governance strategy and voting token to reference the new D5 Token contract address established under Section 3, effective for all subsequent votes following this Resolution.

7. File an amendment to the Company's Articles of Organization with the Wyoming Secretary of State to update the smart contract identifier of record. The Executive Members acknowledge that the smart contract identifier currently on record in the Company's Articles of Organization filed with the Wyoming Secretary of State is the Company's original Gnosis Chain contract (0xaE20D452cdd2e312DAe98470D95bd2C133234de3). Although the Company's Operating Agreement was previously updated to reflect the transition to the Arbitrum One network, no corresponding amendment was filed with the Wyoming Secretary of State due to intervening operational disruptions on the Colony platform. The amendment authorized under this Section shall directly update the smart contract identifier of record from the original Gnosis Chain contract to the new contract address established under Section 3.

**By approving this proposal, the Executive Members confirm the Company's transition to the new operational structure and authorize all necessary actions to implement this transition.**

title: FULL VOTE: Migration to a New Onchain Governance Platform
body:
## Background

Decent recently informed us that they will be stopping operations in the near future. They also recommended that Shutter DAO 0x36 migrate to a new onchain governance platform.

## Choices
(Listed in alphabetical order)

- Anticapture
- Snapshot X

## Summary

|  | **Anticapture** (blockful) | **Snapshot X** (Snapshot Labs) |
|----|----|----|
| **What it is** | A frontend on top of the DAO's existing Azorius/Decent contracts | A new onchain governance protocol, added as a Zodiac module on the existing Safe |
| **Contracts** | No change. DAO stays on Azorius | Azorius module swapped for a Snapshot X module. Same Safe, same treasury |
| **Price** | $24k USDC/year | $0 — no migration fee, no protocol fees, no platform fee |
| **Voter gas** | Can be DAO-sponsored if desired | Gasless by default via DAO-sponsored relayer |
| **Other costs** | Execution tx paid by whoever executes | Execution tx paid by whoever executes. Relayer top-ups at "a few dollars per proposal" |
| **SLA** | "Standard SLA." No published uptime or response-time figures. DAO bug fixes and feature requests go "to the front of our queue" | 99% monthly uptime; priority response within 4 hours; spam/malicious proposal detection within 2 hours; dedicated Telegram group with the core team |
| **Migration steps** | None. Live since March 2025 at [shutter.gov.blockful.io](https://shutter.gov.blockful.io/proposals) | 7 steps, 2 already done: (3) create space → (4) internal testing → (5) Safe vote to add module → (6) DAO test transactions → (7) remove Decent module when satisfied |
| **Timeline** | Available today | Parallel run live within August; DAO retires Decent on its own schedule |
| **Migration risk** | Zero — no contracts touched | Additive and parallel; one-action rollback; no treasury movement, no history migration, no downtime |
| **Token / delegations** | Unchanged | Unchanged. SHU used as-is via ERC-20 Votes (EIP-5805); existing delegations carry over automatically |
| **Notable features** | Delegation, voting, proposal creation, complete governance/holder analytics; notification system (telegram, slack), deep data/analytics with focus on security | Gasless voting, execution builder, multisig voting, shielded voting retained, custom domain, delegates dashboard, Discourse in-interface, Snapshot MCP for AI agents |
| **Upgradability** | Bounded by Azorius, which is frozen and no longer developed | Modular — authenticators, voting strategies, proposal validation and execution strategies are swappable by the DAO's controller. No re-migration needed for new features |
| **Long-term maintenance** | blockful maintains the frontend; the underlying contracts currently have no maintainer - blockful has expertise to maintain the contract and update if necessary| Core protocol on Snapshot's onchain roadmap; Shutter engineers are already upstreaming private voting into the Snapshot X monorepo |

title: S7-1 南塘艺术共创营（第三期）· 项目结项报告
body:
**报告提交人：** 苏砚仁、朝林、小红、若曦

**提交日期：** 2026年6月29日

**修订日期：** 2026年7月11日

---

## 1. 项目背景

南塘艺术共创营前两期已验证了「艺术+社区+NT积分」模式的可行性，但也暴露了核心瓶颈：NT系统停留在手动操作阶段，任务发布与NT发放依赖人工记录，效率低且难以形成稳定体验。

第三期与往期最大的区别在于：**NT任务系统首次在网页平台上正式运行**，实现任务发布、领取、验收、NT发放的全流程线上化。这是一次真实的产品内测。

---

## 2. 项目目标

基于原提案，本期聚焦三个核心目标：

1. **NT任务系统实战内测：** 在20人×15天的真实环境中测试系统全流程，产出Bug记录与优化建议。
2. **NT系统与合作社运营融合：** 跑通「劳动→NT→食宿支付→合作社回收」闭环，验证NT在乡村场景的真实适用性。同时融入禅修静心模块。
3. **4人精干团队低成本验证：** 以13,500 NT人力成本完成全部运营工作。

---

## 3. 项目完成情况

**整体评估：** 在招生未满（约10人，原计划20人）的情况下，三个核心目标均已达成，部分维度超出预期。

### 目标一：NT任务系统实战内测 — ✅ 已完成

主线任务（M1-M12）、支线任务（S1-S9）、共创任务（C1-C7）、隐藏任务（H1-H8）全部上线运行。任务发布→领取→完成提交→审核→NT发放的全流程跑通，系统在20天内无重大故障。提案要求的"真实压力测试数据"已形成：555条任务记录、24,293 NT流转数据、Bug记录文本已提交给开发者社区。

超出提案预期的是：在地伙伴和共创人自发发布了17+项任务——任务系统不再只是主办方的工具，开始被社区成员作为日常协调工具使用，验证了去中心化任务发布的可行性。

### 目标二：NT系统与合作社运营的深度融合 — ✅ 已完成

「劳动→NT→食宿支付→合作社回收」闭环完整跑通。共创人通过务农、打扫、晨练等社区劳动赚取NT，再用NT兑换食宿（40 NT/天）。提案规划的禅修静心模块成功融入：素社之晨（站桩/行禅/抄经）参与率89%，静心时刻参与率80%。

**核心突破：** 合作社在此过程中清晰认识到了NT流通次数的价值——NT每多流通一次，就是一次真实协作的发生。NT不只是「代币」，是社区协作的记账工具。这一认识为后续NT系统的推广奠定了认知基础。

### 目标三：4人精干团队低成本运营验证 — ✅ 基本完成

### 超出原定目标的成果

砚仁（总负责/教学）、朝林（后勤/生活）、小红（宣传/协调）、若曦（活动/沟通）全程完成了全部运营工作。人力成本实际为13,900 NT，发现教学与NT审核集中于一人时产生瓶颈，已记录为第四期优化方向。

以下三项在原提案中未被列为独立目标，但在执行中实际达成：

**艺术共创与社区体验。** 共创人完成了从临摹到创作到装裱到布展的完整流程。产出画作在村展（大地书房，6/22）和城市快闪展（宝龙广场，6/24）两次展出。城市展为共创营首次将画展带入商业空间——提案只规划了村展。

**议事规则的实战验证。** 画展延期的决策走完了「个人想法→集体动议→辩论→投票通过」的全过程。提案将议事规则列为支持资源，实际效果超出了预期——它被共创人自发使用，成为了真实的协作基础设施。

**增时事件中的NT双向服务购买。** 10位共创人因创作进度滞后集体申请延期3天，并以支付工作人员延时NT（1,250 NT）为前置条件获得通过。这意味着NT不再只是"主办方发、共创人领"的单向激励——它在协商场景中反向流动，成为真实需求的表达和置换通道。这一模式在提案中未被预见，为未来营队的弹性服务置换提供了可复用的先例。

---

## 4. 资源使用情况

### 4.1 人民币收支

| 项目 | 金额 |
| --- | --- |
| Web3乡建基金（到账） | 1.5675 ETH |
| 共创人学费（10人×599元） | 5,990 |
| 延时住宿费+餐费 | 1,305 |
| **收入合计** | **32,295** |
| 总支出 | 27,086 |
| **结余** | **+5,209** |

支出中包括：工作人员薪资合计 9,850 元（含延期劳务及绩效调整）、合作社水电费及场地费 4,500 元、素社食宿约 7,000 元、招生宣传约 1,050 元、画材与装裱约 630 元、保险约 587 元、活动与展览经费约 2,649 元、其他杂项约 820 元。所有类别均未超预算。

### 4.2 NT收支

| 项目 | NT |
| --- | --- |
| 社区募捐 | 30,000 |
| 拍卖收入 | 5,736 |
| 延期服务费及延时费用 | 1,655 |
| **收入合计** | **37,391** |

#### 4.3.1 一个尚未被回答的问题

结算做完了。但这次结算暴露了一个比数字更根本的问题：

**南塘 DAO 作为 NT 的发行方，至今没有正式定义——NT 可以兑换发行方的什么服务？**

过去，NT 的流通逻辑是单向的：DAO 发 NT 给项目团队或在地伙伴，NT 在任务系统和社区场景中流转，最后结余"交回"国库。这意味着 NT 持有者手里的代币，并不能向发行方（DAO）主张任何确定的服务或资源。一个健康的社区货币，发行者必须自己接受它作为支付手段。否则 NT 只是一个内部记账单位——它记录了你做了多少贡献，却不承诺你可以用它换到什么。

这个问题不回答，NT 的长期价值支撑就始终缺了一环。

#### 4.3.2 一个可能的答案方向：空间服务作为 NT 的赎回标的

上一节提出的问题——"NT 能换发行方的什么"——不是一个需要从零设计的新东西。南塘 DAO 已经管理着真实的空间资产：合作社大院、大地书房、共享厨房、素社餐厅。第三期共创营向合作社支付了 4,500 元的水电费和场地费——这笔钱说明：南塘的空间本身就能产生真实的经济价值，只是这个价值目前以人民币结算，尚未被正式确认为 NT 的赎回标的。

如果 DAO 做出以下公开承诺，NT 就从内部记账单位变成了空间服务的购买凭证：

**（1）基础空间服务保障。** 南塘 DAO 向 NT 持有者公开承诺，提供其管理下的基础空间服务——水电、客房住宿、公共空间使用。NT 持有者可以用 NT 购买这些服务。

**（2）空间维持与 NT 获取机制。** 维持空间需要人力投入。DAO 允许未持有 NT 的成员或参与者，通过提供空间维护劳务（打扫、修缮、田间管理）来换取 NT。这保证了空间能持续维持在一个可用的水准上，同时也为 NT 创造了劳务端的真实需求。

**（3）NT 的价值锚定。** 在上述机制下，NT 的价值不再仅来自"任务系统发了多少"，而是来自"维持和提升南塘生活空间所需的真实劳动投入"。空间越好，使用空间的需求越高，NT 的需求就越强——这是一个正向循环。

**这不是凭空设计。** 第三期共创营已经完成了三项代位验证：

- **空间价值的验证**：合作社大院承载了 17 天的营队活动，产出了画展和城市品牌曝光。共创营为此支付了 4,500 元水电场地费——空间本身是创收资产。
- **劳务→NT 机制的验证**：共创人通过务农、打扫、帮厨等劳动赚取 NT，再用 NT 支付食宿。劳务→NT→消费的链条已经跑通。
- **跨期价值传递的验证**：前两期共创营对合作社空间的持续使用和在地维护，客观上保持了空间的可使用状态，使第三期得以在此基础上运行。空间需要持续投入才能维持价值——这不是成本，是投资。

**共创营不只是验证了可能性，还替 DAO 做了第一次定价尝试。**

组织层面尚未正式定义空间服务的定价体系。但共创营在项目执行中，实际已经做出了主张并付诸行动：我们向南塘 DAO 支付了 4,500 元的水电费和场地费。这个数字参照了南塘 DAO 半年以来的平均电费支出，作为"使用南塘 DAO 空间服务"的一次性定价。这个提议在项目流程中获得了支持并实际执行。

这意味着：共创营不只是在报告里建议 DAO 定义赎回机制，而是**用真实的项目预算，替 DAO 试出了一个空间服务的价格，并且付了钱。** 项目成果回流到南塘 DAO，形成了经济意义上的闭环——而不仅仅是"结余上交"。

**这同时部分回应了 NT 发行方的核心义务问题。** 如果南塘 DAO 作为 NT 发行方，要提供的是"时空和基础设施"，那么维持空间、获取基础费用、提供硬件空间，就不是某个项目的额外贡献，而是 DAO 组织的日常必然义务——每个人都有的义务。共创营支付的水电费不是"帮组织忙"，而是组织履行其空间服务承诺的第一次正式对价。

**需要 DAO 进一步明确的事项**：

1. 南塘 DAO 对合作社大院等空间的管理权限，是否足以支撑公开的服务承诺？
2. 共创营已用半年平均电费做了一次定价——DAO 是否需要、以及如何将它正式化为 NT 空间服务的标准定价？
3. 劳务换 NT 的质量审核标准——谁来判断打扫合不合格、菜地管得好不好？

#### 4.3.3 正在做的事：南塘云村

第三期共创营使用的任务系统和 SEMI 数字身份，由开发者社区开发并提供。我们在 20 天的营队中积累了 555 条任务记录、24,293 NT 的流转数据——这些实战数据是一个很扎实的起点。

共创营结束后，项目组基于这些经验，开始做一个更贴合南塘在地场景的工具——**南塘云村**，一个和南塘实体空间一一对应的实景游戏平台。核心想法很简单：把南塘的实体空间数字化——哪个房间可以住、哪块菜地种了什么、厨房冰箱里有什么——让空间服务变成可以被追踪、定价、结算的数据。这是"NT 赎回空间服务"从概念走向日常运转的基础设施。

SEMI 数字身份继续作为 NT 的 Web3 钱包层使用。

**当前进度**：实景地图和空间语义层正在开发中，移动端适配同步推进。第四期共创营将是云村的第一个完整测试场景。

**三期迭代的数据经验。** 学费从免费到300元到599元，NT系统从无到有，展览从一场到两场。三期对比的预算与实际数据，证明方向是对的——预算精度在提高、实际支出在下降、模式在自我迭代。

## 6. 经验总结

### 成功经验（可复制）

1. **「议事规则+NT任务系统+工笔画」三位一体模式**形成了独特的竞争力，从单纯的「学画画」升级为「在一个真实社区里共同生活、共同决策、共同创作」。
2. **接住系统的运作**——画展延期从个人想法到集体诉求到正式变更的全过程——验证了议事规则在真实协作中的价值。
3. **两次展览（村展+城展）**为共创人提供了完整的成就感闭环，城市展开辟了品牌外溢的新通道。
4. **NT流通闭环**首次在合作社场景中被完整实证，为系统的后续推广提供了最有说服力的案例。

### 主要教训与改进方向

1. **课程节奏失衡：** 临摹阶段占比偏重，创作时间被压缩。教学方式需从「老师示范学生跟画」转向「做一步带一步+小组自学」模式。
2. **开营第一印象管理不足：** 第一天出现工作人员态度不齐、礼物交换规则不明确等问题，影响了初期的信任建立。后续需通过开营前动员会统一对齐。
3. **NT审核效率瓶颈：** 审核无批量操作、转账需逐笔点击，教学与审核集中于一人时形成瓶颈。已向开发者社区提交Bug记录，待系统升级。
4. **展览筹备的追踪缺失：** 主办方在第三期中选择了信任共创人自主完成展览筹备，但缺少中间节点的进度追问，导致布展当天出现混乱。第四期需在关键节点设置追问机制。

## 7. 模式验证与迭代价值

### NT系统验证结论

- **已验证：** NT任务系统可在真实的多任务、多用户环境中稳定运行全流程。
- **核心发现：** NT流通的价值不在总量，而在流通次数。流通次数越多→真实协作越多→系统越健康。合作社对这一原理的认知转变，是第三期最重要的突破。
- **待解决：** 审核效率依赖人工，需尽快完成批量操作等功能的开发。
- **待 DAO 回应：NT 的发行方赎回机制。** 本期验证了 NT 可以在任务系统和社区场景中流通，但 DAO 作为发行方，尚未正式定义 NT 持有者可以用 NT 向 DAO 购买什么。共创营已在项目实践中进行了空间服务定价的代位验证（详见 4.3.2），建议 DAO 在此基础上正式建立 NT 的发行方赎回承诺——这是 NT 从实验工具走向真实货币的关键一步。

### 「DAO式治理」体验验证结论

- **已验证：** 议事规则可融入短期共创营并提升参与感与自主性。共创人从被动参与者转变为主动发起者（画展延期）。
- **核心发现：** 在保障议事规则框架的前提下，主办方需在「充分放手」与「关键节点追问」之间找到平衡。完全放手和全程主导两个极端都不可取。

### 收费模式验证结论

- **已验证：** 599元定价在年轻人群中可接受。更关键的是，当共创体验足够好时，共创人**主动要求延期并愿意支付额外费用**——这验证了收费模式存在向上空间。
- **核心发现：** 价格弹性的基础不是「我们提供了多少课程」，而是「共创人觉得自己被接住了多少」。

## 结语

第三期南塘艺术共创营在招生未满的情况下，完成了NT任务平台的首次大规模实战内测，跑通了「劳动→NT→食宿→南塘社区回收」的流通闭环。20天，555条任务记录，24,293 NT流转，两次展览，一个延期的集体决策——这些数字背后是10位共创人的真实投入和4位工作人员的持续付出。

提案设定的三个核心目标全部达成：系统跑通了，闭环验证了，团队撑住了。三个超出预期的成果——城市展、议事规则实战、NT双向服务购买——指向同一个事实：当一个系统被放进真实场景中运转，它会生长出设计者未曾预见的可能性。

但第三期也留下了一个提案里没有预料到的问题：**DAO 发行的 NT，到底能换 DAO 的什么？** 我们在项目过程中替 DAO 做了它还没来得及做的事：用真实的预算试出了空间服务的价格，付了钱，形成了闭环。我们不是在等 DAO 给答案——我们是经过共创营的实践，尝试回应了本该由 DAO 去回应的事情。剩下的是 DAO 要不要把这一次性的尝试，变成日常的机制。

开发者社区的工具给了我们起点，共创营的实战给了我们问题，富章老师的理论框架给了我们方向。而南塘云村，是在把答案建成能用的东西。第三期是实验，第四期是迭代，每一期都往前推一步。

title: Update Offchain Parameters for the Tokenized Treasury JTRSY Instance
body:
# Update Offchain Parameters for the Tokenized Treasury JTRSY Instance - August 10, 2026

Grove's Operational Facilitator has placed a proposal into the voting system on behalf of nested contributor Grove Development Company.

## Review

If approved, this proposal will update the offchain parameters for the Tokenized Treasury JTRSY Instance, in accordance with the plan agreed with the Core Council Risk Advisor:

- Lower the Capital Reserve Ratio (CRR) from 100% to **25%**
- Raise the maximum exposure for the Instance from its current operative level to **5,000,000 USDS**

Additionally, since the Artifact currently records a combined 5,000,000 USDS maximum exposure for JTRSY and BUIDL, this proposal will update both Instances with per-instance values to reflect the divergence that is being introduced, resulting in BUIDL parameters in the Artifact explicitly having the following values:

- Capital Reserve Ratio (CRR): **100%**
- Maximum exposure: **2,500,000 USDS**

---

The proposed Grove Artifact changes can be found in the following pull request: https://github.com/sky-ecosystem/next-gen-atlas/pull/291

## Outcomes

- If "For" receives the most votes, the proposal will be approved. The associated pull request will be merged into Grove's artifact. When required, the listed changes will proceed to implementation by the relevant actors.
- If "Against" receives the most votes, the proposal will be rejected. No changes will be implemented.

title: 54# WBTC market: rate to 2 x 1.32% and AMM fee to 1.82% (after Curve vote 1486)
body: Set the yb-WBTC (market 7) borrow/donation rate to 2 * 1.32% per year on crvUSD and its AMM fee to 1.82%. Both changes belong together with the new crvUSD/WBTC pool parameters and fee policy installed by Curve ownership vote 1486, so this proposal is guarded: it first asserts that the pool already has a policy contract set (POLICY() != 0x0) and reverts otherwise. It therefore cannot take effect before the Curve vote is executed, and can simply be executed once that has happened.

title: TELxIP: TELx Liquidity Framework Alignment & Pool Standardization
body:
Abstract

This proposal updates the TELx liquidity framework to align with the Telcoin Token Upgrade (TEL v2 → TEL v3) and establishes a unified, standardized pool structure across Ethereum, Polygon, and Base aligning with Uniswap, the most widely adopted and trusted decentralized exchange in the industry.

Under this framework, TELx will focus on a simplified and scalable pool design consisting of two core pools per chain—TEL/ETH (or WETH) and TEL/eUSD—across Ethereum, Polygon, and Base. In addition, the existing USDC/eMXN pool will be deprecated in favor of the eUSD/eMXN pool, aligning with the broader strategy to prioritize eUSD, issued by Telcoin Digital Asset Bank (TDAB).

With the launch of TEL v3, all liquidity incentives will transition to Uniswap v4 pools using the upgraded TEL token. Liquidity providers will be required to migrate their TEL v2 positions to TEL v3 before re-entering incentivized pools.

Reward distribution will be handled through Merkl, as defined in TELxIP: Implementation of Merkl Across TELx Pools.

This proposal positions TELx alongside industry-standard infrastructure, improves capital efficiency, and supports the long-term goal of establishing deep, accessible liquidity for TEL across all supported chains.

This proposal activates upon the successful governance approval and implementation of the Telcoin Token Upgrade and the Merkl TELxIP.

Specification

Pool Structure

The standardized TELx liquidity framework includes the following Uniswap v4 pools and fee tiers:

Ethereum

TEL / ETH — 0.3%
TEL / eUSD — 0.3%
Polygon

TEL / ETH — 0.3%
TEL / eUSD — 0.3%
eUSD / eMXN — 0.05%
Base

TEL / ETH — 0.3%
TEL / eUSD — 0.3%
Incentives

Each pool receives 500,000 TEL per week (reduced from 648,148)
Incentives are reallocated from existing Balancer/Uniswap pools
No new emissions are introduced
Incentives apply only to TEL v3 liquidity positions after the transitionary period.
Reward distribution will be executed via Merkl, as per the dedicated TELxIP
Eligibility Requirement

To receive incentives, liquidity providers must:

Unstake existing TEL v2 positions from TELx
Withdraw liquidity from TEL v2 TELx pools on Uniswap/Balancer
Upgrade TEL v2 → TEL v3 using the official migration process
Add liquidity to the new TEL v3 Uniswap v4 pools
Subscribe the new LP NFT positions on TELx to begin receiving rewards
This ensures all incentivized liquidity is aligned with the upgraded token standard.

Legacy Pool Status

Balancer Pools (Deprecated Incentives)

TEL / USDC
TEL / WETH
TEL / WBTC
These pools will:

Remain active
No longer receive incentives
Continue generating fee-based returns only
Uniswap Pool Adjustment

The USDC/eMXN pool on Uniswap will be deprecated
Replaced by the eUSD/eMXN pool
Liquidity Provision Model

TELx will leverage Uniswap v4’s liquidity design:

Concentrated Liquidity (Primary Strategy)

Optimized capital efficiency
Higher fee generation
Ideal for active LPs
Full Range Liquidity (Secondary Strategy)

Provides continuous coverage during volatility
Ensures liquidity availability if price moves outside tight ranges
This combined approach balances efficiency with resilience, supporting both active and passive liquidity providers.

Rewards Infrastructure

TELx will use Merkl as the reward distribution mechanism across all incentivized pools, as defined in TELxIP: Implementation of Merkl Across TELx Pools.

This provides:

Advanced and flexible incentive mechanisms
Support for rewarding both liquidity provision and fee generation
Reduced reliance on custom smart contract infrastructure
Motivation

The TELx Council’s north star is to provide the deepest, most accessible liquidity for TEL across all supported chains. To achieve this, TELx must:

Consolidate liquidity into high-impact trading pairs
Reduce fragmentation across platforms and pool types
Simplify the user experience
Align with infrastructure that captures the majority of DeFi volume
Additionally, expanding liquidity around eUSD supports broader ecosystem alignment and strengthens the integration between TELx and Telcoin Digital Asset Bank (TDAB).

Rationale

1. Alignment with Uniswap

Uniswap remains the most widely used decentralized exchange. Standardizing TELx liquidity on Uniswap improves:

Discoverability and accessibility
Integration with aggregators and trading tools
Participation from a broader set of liquidity providers
2. Optimal Asset Pairing

Liquidity will be concentrated around:

ETH — the most widely traded and liquid asset in crypto
eUSD — a Telcoin-native stablecoin issued by TDAB
This pairing strategy maximizes both external liquidity access and internal ecosystem alignment.

3. Expandable Pool Design

This proposal establishes an initial focus on core liquidity pairs aligned with strategic priorities, while maintaining flexibility to expand into additional pools as the ecosystem evolves.

4. Transition from Legacy Infrastructure

Balancer pools remain active but unincentivized, signaling the preferred direction for liquidity.

Implementation Timeline

Phase 1 — Governance & Approval

Proposal reviewed and refined by community and TELx Council
Submitted to Snapshot for voting
Contingent on TEL v3 passing governance and being implemented
Contingent on Merkl TELxIP passing governance
Subject to Compliance Council review
Phase 2 — Notice & Preparation

Upon approval, the community will receive two weeks’ notice before incentives transition from the legacy pools to the new TELx liquidity framework.
The transition will be coordinated with the anticipated launch of the TEL2 → TEL3 upgrade portal, where possible, to provide users with a clear window to complete their token upgrade and prepare for the new liquidity pools.
Additional implementation guidance and migration information will be provided ahead of the transition.
Phase 3 — Deployment

Launch new TEL v3 Uniswap v4 pools across Ethereum, Polygon, and Base
Update incentives for existing TEL/ETH pools
Initiate Merkl-based incentive distribution
Maintain legacy pools in non-incentivized state
Phase 4 — Clean Incentive Transition

At the conclusion of the two-week notice period, 100% of TEL incentives will transition to the new pools.
Liquidity providers participating in the new incentivized pools must complete the TEL2 → TEL3 token upgrade and subscribe their Uniswap LP NFT through the TELx platform to qualify for incentives.
Phase 5 — Post-Transition Optimization

Monitor liquidity, trading volume, fee generation, and incentive participation across the new pools.
Adjust the liquidity and incentive strategy as necessary based on performance and community feedback.
Timeline

This TELxIP activates in a week upon the launch of TEL v3.

At that time:

New TEL v3 pools will be deployed
Liquidity providers will migrate from TEL v2 → TEL v3
Incentives will begin flowing to TEL v3 pools via Merkl
No specific date is included, as activation depends on the official TEL v3 release.

Expected Outcomes

Deeper TEL Liquidity Across Chains – Concentrated pools improve depth and trading efficiency
Improved User Experience – Standardized pool structure reduces complexity
Increased Trading Volume & Fees – Better aggregator compatibility may improve routing and activity
Stronger Ecosystem Alignment – eUSD integration supports Telcoin’s broader financial strategy
Flexible, Future-Ready Framework – Supports evolving reward systems and infrastructure decisions
Budget & Funding Source

Incentives funded through reallocation of existing TEL emissions
No new emissions required
Precedent

This proposal establishes the preferred liquidity framework for TELx going forward, aligned with industry-leading infrastructure and the upgraded TEL v3 token standard.

title: VRNouns Ekosistem Gelir Payı Önerisi
body:
### Öneri

VRNouns sahiplerinin, yalnızca VRNouns koleksiyonundan elde edilen gelirlerden değil, **flooor.fun üzerindeki diğer NFT koleksiyonlarının oluşturduğu Community Pool gelirlerinden de pay almasını** öneriyorum.

Mevcut sistemde satışlardan alınan %4,5 Community Fee, ilgili NFT koleksiyonunun daily sign yapan sahipleri arasında dağıtılıyor.

Bu öneriyle birlikte Community Pool'un **%10'unun VRNouns Global Pool'a ayrılmasını** öneriyorum.

### Dağılım

* **%90:** İşlemin gerçekleştiği NFT koleksiyonunun sahiplerine
* **%10:** VRNouns Global Pool'a

VRNouns Global Pool, o gün **daily sign yapan uygun VRNouns sahipleri** arasında eşit olarak dağıtılabilir.

**1 wallet = 1 pay** kuralının korunmasını öneriyorum. Böylece birden fazla VRNouns'a sahip olmak, tek bir cüzdanın birden fazla pay almasına neden olmaz.

### Örnek

flooor.fun üzerinde bir günde toplam **100.000$ işlem hacmi** gerçekleştiğini düşünelim.

%4,5 Community Fee:

**4.500$**

Bunun %10'u VRNouns Global Pool'a ayrılır:

**450$**

Kalan:

**4.050$**

ilgili NFT koleksiyonlarının sahiplerine dağıtılır.

Eğer o gün 20 uygun VRNouns sahibi daily sign yaptıysa:

**450$ / 20 = 22,50$**

Her uygun VRNouns sahibi günlük 22,50$ pay alır.

### Neden?

Bu mekanizmanın amacı VRNouns sahiplerine sadece ekstra bir avantaj sağlamak değil, **VRNouns'u flooor.fun ekosisteminin native NFT'si haline getirmek**.

flooor.fun üzerindeki diğer koleksiyonların işlem hacmi büyüdükçe Community Pool büyür. Bunun sonucunda VRNouns Global Pool da büyür.

Bu model, VRNouns sahiplerini platformun tamamının büyümesine ekonomik olarak ortak ederken, diğer NFT koleksiyonlarının sahiplerine ayrılan Community Pool'un büyük bölümünü (%90) korumaya devam eder.

**Önerilen VRNouns payı: %10**

title: SCP-219 Move rFox to Mainnet
body:
SCP219: Move rFOX to Ethereum
Move rFOX from Arbitrum to Mainnet on October 1st. Most FOX already lives on Mainnet, so this puts the program where the tokens are. Rewards temporarily go from 25% to 50% of revenue for the first three months to get people to move quickly.
Abstract
rFOX is on Arbitrum today, so if you hold FOX on Mainnet you have to bridge before you can stake. Most people hold on Mainnet.
This deploys the same audited rFOX contract to Ethereum Mainnet, live October 1st. Stakers get 25% of DAO revenue in USDC and the 5% burn keeps running exactly as it does now. Arbitrum stops earning rewards that day, and the Arbitrum contract’s unstaking cooldown drops to 0 so nobody is stuck waiting to move.
For October 2026, November 2026, and December 2026, Mainnet rFOX pays 50% of revenue instead of 25%. It goes back to 25% automatically on January 1st.
Motivation
The biggest chunk of FOX is on Mainnet. Meeting FOX holders where they are currently. Also matches where the DAO is headed. We're consolidating liquidity and programs onto Mainnet, and our flagship revenue share program shouldn't be sitting on a different chain.
Engineering already audited the contract and is confident it ports over cleanly.
Specification
• Go live: October 1st, 2026. Mainnet only after that.
• Contract: Same audited rFOX contract, no functional changes.
• Boost: October, November, and December pay 50% of revenue. Back to 25% automatically on January 1st, 2027.
• Arbitrum: Cooldown drops to 0 days immediately so people can move. Rewards go to 0% once Mainnet is live. Anything accrued before then still gets paid.
Cost: The boost runs about $5,000/month, roughly $15,000 total, based on 2026 revenue. It moves with revenue since it's a percentage. Dropping the Arbitrum Snapshot voting strategy saves around $6,000/year per GK on an ongoing basis.
Benefits
• Puts rFOX where the most liquidity and FOX already is.
• Lines up with the DAO's move to simplify and conslidate
• Opens the program to every Mainnet holder who wouldn't bridge.
• Potential ongoing cost savings from not having to pay for advanced snapshot strategies of $6k/year
Drawbacks
• 27M FOX can unlock at once. Dropping the Arbitrum cooldown to 0 means a lot of FOX becomes available at the same time. If people sell instead of migrating to the new contract, there could be massive sell pressure.
• Mainnet gas is more expensive. Staking costs more than on Arbitrum, which hurts smaller stakers most.
• Three months of reduced treasury revenues. Roughly $15,000 in extra payouts.
• Some people won't move due to lack of paying attention. Anyone who misses it stops earning October 1st.
• There's a cliff in January for rewards, could trigger unstaking.
• This will require work on the Engineering side to launch contract, adjust revenue dashboards, and update the interface to include both contracts for withdrawing on the old one if a user is staked into it, and then also to bridge and stake into the new one.
Vote
For: Move rFOX to Ethereum Mainnet on October 1st, 2026, with a 28 day cooldown, 25% of revenue paid in USDC. This would get a temporary bump to 50% of revenue for October through December. Once mainnet contract is launched, a 0 day Arbitrum cooldown, and Arbitrum rewards ending at go live.
Against: rFOX stays on Arbitrum.
