title: Propsal: Adjusting the GPU mining reward rate to close the gap with leading decentralized compute projects
body:
# Summary

As part of our work at the Phala Foundation, we said we'd be publishing our work on protocol incentives soon. Phala has grown incredibly, but hasn't had the same success attracting external compute as other projects like Bittensor, and we're working to change that.

Below is that proposal: an accleration of the previously allotted 160M PHA over 15 months, designed to directly close the USD yield gap that leads GPU operators to run their hardware on Bittensor instead of Phala. We're sharing the full math here for transparency, including the assumptions behind it, and welcome feedback.

# Phala's Growth, and the Gap on the Supply Side

Phala Network began in 2018 as a research effort on confidential compute for Web3, launched its TEE network in 2020, and expanded into GPU TEE and AI workloads in 2024. Today the Phala Foundation positions the network as confidential AI infrastructure under the mission "private compute, public proof" the idea that a result from an AI model or agent should carry verifiable hardware attestation with it, rather than asking users to trust a provider's dashboard.

That positioning has translated into real demand side growth. Over 2025, Phala Cloud grew to just over 10,000 total users, with roughly 2,500 confidential VMs deployed and hundreds of paying customers running production workloads. On peak days, the network has processed over 1.3 billion LLM tokens through confidential inference, with overhead low enough to be practical for real applications. They have built out more than 20 strategic partnerships across AI, zero-knowledge, and decentralized infrastructure — including NEAR Protocol, OpenRouter, and Sentient. While participating in  NVIDIA's Inception Program, achieving SOC 2 Type I and HIPAA compliance, and donating its dstack deployment tooling to the Linux Foundation for neutral governance.

In short: the application and demand side of Phala's flywheel is working. What hasn't kept pace is the supply side. The decentralized GPU capacity that makes all of this possible. That's the gap this proposal is built to close, and why the incentive design below is targeted specifically at compute operators rather than at demand or tooling.

# Objective

The goal of this proposal is to make Phala GPU mining economically competitive with the leading decentralized compute project, Bittensor.

Today, a miner running an H200/B300 on a top TAO subnet earns roughly $145/day (estimate).

The same H200/B300 on Phala earns about $2.61/day, less than the ~$4.50/day power cost.

That gap is potentially one of the main reasons decentralized GPU operators route their hardware to protocols like Bittensor and not Phala. We propose to change this to significantly boost Phala growth.

Accelerating the 160M PHA in the GPU mining contract evenly over 15 months could change the picture. At the starting fleet estimate, the proposed schedule delivers ~$46/day per H200/B300, closing roughly a third of the USD gap to TAO and producing a positive operating margin over power cost.

# Status Quo vs. Proposed Schedule vs. TAO

The proposal takes Phala from 2% of TAO's H200/B300 yield to 32%, the difference between "not worth plugging in" and "a credible second destination for decentralized H200/B300 supply."

Full parity is not achieved on emission alone; it requires either PHA price appreciation, which we expect to deliver through this acceleration of network growth.

# PHA Price Required for Full TAO Parity

Under the proposed schedule, how much would PHA need to appreciate to match TAO's $145/day H200/B300 on a USD basis? By our estimates, a 3.1x PHA move (to ~$0.10) reaches parity, versus a 56x move required under the status-quo emission rate.

The proposal does not promise that move, but it does put parity inside a plausible macro outcome rather than a fantastical one.

To be clear: this proposal is an emission-side lever, not a promise of a specific PHA price outcome. Full parity with TAO would still require PHA price appreciation on top of this schedule, which we believe is a realistic, not fantastical, outcome as network growth accelerates.

# Next Steps

A simple vote to asert community support. From there we will work on implementing the changes and observing their effectiveness. As always, thank you for your continued support.

Sahil Dhital, Director & Head of Strategy, Phala Foundation

title: (STA)Trueo Product Development Proposal
body:
Summary

This proposal seeks approval from TRUE holders to continue the development and expansion of the Trueo product ecosystem.

The proposed direction focuses on improving the overall product experience, strengthening core market infrastructure, expanding user participation, and introducing new features that support the long-term growth of Trueo.

By approving this proposal, TRUE holders authorize the Trueo contributors to continue executing the product roadmap and iterating on product features based on user needs, market conditions, and technical requirements.

Proposal

The Trueo product development roadmap will focus on the following areas:

Improve the core prediction market trading experience
Expand market discovery and user participation
Improve portfolio, position, and PnL experiences
Enhance market creation and creator-related features
Continue improving liquidity and trading infrastructure
Develop new incentive mechanisms and utilities for TRUE holders
Improve governance, oracle, and market resolution experiences
Continue optimizing product usability, performance, and accessibility

Specific implementations, priorities, and timelines may evolve based on technical feasibility, user feedback, market conditions, and ecosystem needs.

Rationale

Trueo is evolving from a prediction market trading interface into a broader ecosystem connecting traders, market creators, liquidity providers, and TRUE holders.

Continued product development is necessary to:

Improve the competitiveness and usability of the protocol
Increase trading activity and market participation
Create stronger utility for TRUE and the broader ecosystem
Support sustainable long-term protocol growth
Allow the product to adapt quickly as user behavior and market conditions evolve

This proposal establishes community support for the overall product development direction while allowing contributors sufficient flexibility to execute and iterate.

Voting Options

Agree

Support the proposed Trueo product development direction and authorize contributors to continue executing and iterating on the roadmap.

Disagree

Do not support the proposed product development direction.

Voting

TRUE holders are invited to vote on this proposal through Snapshot.

The result of this vote will represent the governance position of TRUE holders regarding the proposed direction of Trueo product development.

However, the number of OUSD tokens that you can unwrap to will go up over time, as wOUSD earns yield at the same rate as standard OUSD. The wOUSD to OUSD exchange rate can be read from the wOUSD contract (function number 16), or via the OUSD dapp.

Current exchange rate as of 8/12/26: 1 wOUSD = 1.30141137 OUSD

**Risk Mitigation**

There are three risks when using OUSD, and Origin is making sure to reduce each risk as much as possible:

*Smart contract risk of the yield strategies* - Origin is only using platforms for yield generation that have a proven track record, have been audited, have billions in TVL, maintain a bug bounty program, and provide over-collateralized loans. Over-collateralization in itself, combined with liquidations, provides a reasonable level of security for lenders.

*Stablecoin risk* - Origin has chosen USDC, one of the largest stablecoins to ever exist, to back OUSD, and it has stood the test of time and maintained its peg quite well through multiple bull and bear cycles. It has also demonstrated significant growth in circulating supply, so the Origin team is confident that USDC will maintain its peg and that OUSD will remain stable. OUSD also uses a Chainlink oracle for pricing data for USDC to ensure accurate pricing at all times. If USDC falls below its $1 peg, [OIP-4 disables minting](https://github.com/OriginProtocol/origin-dollar/issues/1000) of additional OUSD tokens using the de-pegged asset.

*Smart contract risk of OUSD* - Origin is taking every step possible to be proactive and lessen the chance of losing funds. Security reviews of OUSD are prioritized over new feature development, with regular audits being done, and multiple engineers are required to review each code change with a detailed checklist. A 48-hour timelock goes into effect before protocol upgrades are launched, and deep dives into the exploits of other protocols are constantly being done to make sure the same exploits don’t exist on Origin contracts. Security is extremely important to the Origin team. 12+ audits have been done on the OUSD codebase since 2020, all of which can be seen on [Audits - OUSD.](https://docs.originprotocol.com/security-and-risk/audits) Origin also holds a top three spot on the [Immunefi leaderboard](https://immunefi.com/bug-bounty/?sort=medianResponseTime%3Aasc) for average response time for bug bounty submissions, and maintains a $1m bug bounty.

**Contracts being called**

- [USDC](https://etherscan.io/token/0xA0b86991c6218b36c1d19d4a2e9eb0ce3606eb48) ‘approve’ (approves the usage of the USDC from the wallet) 
- [OUSD vault](https://etherscan.io/address/0xe75d77b1865ae93c7eaa3040b038d7aa7bc02f70#code) ‘mint’ (receives OUSD using USDC at a 1:1 rate) 
- [OUSD](https://etherscan.io/token/0x2A8e1E676Ec238d8A992307B495b45B3fEAa5e86) ‘approve’ (approves the usage of the OUSD from the wallet) 
- [wOUSD](https://etherscan.io/token/0xD2af830E8CBdFed6CC11Bab697bB25496ed6FA62) ‘deposit’ (wraps OUSD into wOUSD)

title: [BIP-922](rerun) Recover unclaimed legacy LM MerkleRedeem funds to BizDev Safe
body:
# Summary

Recover unclaimed $BAL and $LDO incentives still sitting in Balancer’s pre-veBAL `MerkleRedeem` liquidity-mining contracts (~364k BAL and ~350k LDO respectively), and transfer recovered tokens to the BizDev Safe for redeployment as user incentives at BizDev’s discretion.

# Background

Before veBAL, Balancer distributed liquidity-mining rewards via weekly MerkleRedeem contracts ([erc20-redeemable](https://github.com/balancer/erc20-redeemable)): an owner published a merkle root every week; LPs claim with proofs. Unclaimed tokens remain in the contract indefinitely.

Two legacy Ethereum trees are in scope:

- `MerkleRedeem` at `0x6d19b2bF3A36A61530909Ae65445a906D98A2Fa8` (BAL)
- `MerkleRedeem` at `0x884226c9f7b7205f607922E0431419276a64CF8f` (LDO)

These pre-date `MerkleOrchard` and veBAL. Residual orchard balances from the 2023 incident were handled separately via [BIP-196](https://forum.balancer.fi/t/bip-196-redistribution-of-recovered-legacy-incentives/4422). This BIP covers only the legacy `MerkleRedeem` contracts above.

Per [BIP-882](https://forum.balancer.fi/t/bip-882-transitioning-onchain-operations-of-the-balancer-dao-to-balancer-onchain-limited/6859), the BizDev Safe (`multisigs/balancer_bizdev`) manages third-party incentive funds. Given these Merkle trees haven’t seen claims in years, their incentives will be better off being actively managed under the BD mandate.

# Technical Specifications

Both trees can be reseeded with all existing incentives being attributed to the admin. It can then claim the full amount and forward that to the BD safe: [https://github.com/balancer/multisig-ops/pull/2842](https://github.com/balancer/multisig-ops/pull/2842)
choices: No, this is not the way

title: [BIP-923](rerun) Next Phase Decision for Rescued Funds Distribution from Balancer v2 November 2025 Attacks
body:
### **Summary**

Following the execution of **[[BIP-892]](https://forum.balancer.fi/t/bip-892-distribution-of-rescued-funds-from-balancer-v2-november-3rd-2025-attacks/6883)**[,](https://forum.balancer.fi/t/bip-892-distribution-of-rescued-funds-from-balancer-v2-november-3rd-2025-attacks/6883) which established the initial 180-day (6-month) claim window and distribution framework for funds recovered from the November 3rd, 2025 Balancer v2 exploits, this proposal asks Balancer DAO governance to decide on the path forward for the next phase of claims and remaining recovered assets.

Governance is asked to vote on a window extension for the existing non-socialized, payment-in-kind claim window for an additional 6 months (total 12-month claim window) and hold on redistribution of other recovered assets.

### **Background & Context**

In November 2025, Balancer v2 was subject to multi-network exploits. Whitehat interventions and internal emergency actions successfully rescued multi-million dollar positions across Mainnet, Base, Arbitrum, Optimism, and Polygon. Under [BIP-892], the DAO approved the 10% whitehat bounties and launched a 180-day claim window using a non-socialized, payment-in-kind model per pool.

At the time of writing, there is ~$920k still unclaimed, roughly 500 ETH today. Internally, we can verify that the top claimants are smartcontracts that are known and reachable, so during the extended window, the team will make an effort to redistribute the amount to the rightful victims.

Basically, the extended window provides a fair redemption mechanism via the existing Mekle contract (no action needed).

### **Recovery from Ethena and Shapeshift**

A notable update is the rebate given by Ethena and Shapeshift from the hacker activity in those protocols, respectively 12,518 USDe + 133,905 USDC, that today are sitting with the DAO multisig but not on a Merkle contract.

This proposal also asks for us to wait for the extended window to close, and have a chance to add more funds to the recovery pool, before a decision on how to distribute these assets to the victims.

### **Specification**

Extend existing claim window  for another 6 months, maintaining the current [BIP-892] framework and current Merkle contract live (no action needed); revisit late 2026 the unclaimed assets disposition and other recoveries.
choices: No, this is not the way

body:
# TL;DR

As a result of [BIP-252](https://forum.balancer.fi/t/bip-252-timeless-50k-bal-grant-application-ve8020-program/4453), there is still a grant open in this custom build `VeBalGrant` contract: https://etherscan.io/address/0x89f67f3054bFD662971854190Dbc18dcaBb416f6. The unlock time has since then passed (`2025-02-13T00:00:00Z`). Balancer DAO contributed 50k BAL, Timeless contributed ~42 WETH.

* `setActive(false)`
* `release()`

There is a PR with the DAO safe payload and simulation available at https://github.com/balancer/multisig-ops/pull/2861

title: [Prop 531] Nouns Treasury Management - USDC
body:
# Nouns Treasury Management - USDC

![](https://i.ibb.co/Z6Y85x5Q/nouns-ousd-aug-12-2026.webp)

### 

**TL;DR**

This proposal deploys a portion of the DAO’s idle USDC into productive staking while maintaining meaningful liquidity for future proposals. Specifically, the DAO currently holds 484,743 USDC in its treasury. Under this proposal, 300,000 USDC will be staked via Origin Protocol’s Origin Dollar (OUSD) for yield generation.

After receiving OUSD, the position will be wrapped into wOUSD, a non rebasing version of OUSD that eliminates unnecessary taxable events triggered by daily yield distributions. Following this transaction, the DAO will retain approximately 184,743 in native USDC form to preserve flexibility for future proposals.

Passing of this proposal will generate approximately $1,375 per month ($16,500 per year) that can be used to offset or cover the cost of other future proposals and operational expenses. The wOUSD can be unwrapped and redeemed for the underlying USDC at all times.

![](https://i.ibb.co/RGXXxfT2/nouns-ousd-aug-12-2026-2.webp "OUSD stats")

## Specifications

Launched in 2020 by Origin Protocol, [OUSD](https://www.originprotocol.com/ousd) is an ERC20 stablecoin that generates yield while sitting in your wallet or multi-sig. Backed 1:1 by USDC, holders can go in and out of OUSD as they please. Yield is paid out daily and automatically (sometimes multiple times per day) though a positive rebase in the form of additional OUSD, proportional to the amount of OUSD held. OUSD yield, currently \~5.5% APY, comes from a combination of:

1. Deploying USDC collateral to a Curve AMO 
2. Lending USDC collateral to Morpho on ETH mainnet, Base, and Hyperliquid 
3. Reward tokens (MORPHO, CRV, and CVX) are automatically claimed and converted to stablecoin 
4. OUSD sitting in non-upgradable contracts does not rebase, instead the interest generated from those tokens is provided to those that can rebase 

Current and historical OUSD yields can be seen via the OUSD[ analytics page](https://analytics.originprotocol.com/oeth/) at all times.[ Proof of Yield](https://analytics.originprotocol.com/ousd/poy/) tracks every OUSD yield event as the yield is distributed.

There is no set emission schedule for OUSD - similar to stETH, OUSD is minted on demand when users deposit their stablecoin into the protocol, and burned on demand when users redeem OUSD for the collateral USDC. OUSD is completely non-custodial, there are no lock-ups, terms, or conditions. Any web3 wallet can support OUSD and its rebasing function, including hardware wallets and multi-sigs. There is no need to ever again give up the keys to a 3rd party platform, such as Celsius, Blockfi, or FTX, to earn yield on stablecoin.

A visual representation of OUSD’s design appears as follows:

![](https://i.ibb.co/5yjhdZc/Screenshot-2026-02-12-at-2-27-12-PM.png "OUSD design")

Similar to wstETH, there is a corresponding tokenized vault version of OUSD, which is wOUSD. wOUSD is a ERC-4626 tokenized vault designed to accrue yield in price rather than in quantity. When you wrap OUSD, you get back a fixed number of wOUSD tokens. This number will not go up - you will have the same number of wOUSD tokens tomorrow as you have today. However, the number of OUSD tokens that you can unwrap to will go up over time, as wOUSD earns yield at the same rate as standard OUSD. The wOUSD to OUSD exchange rate can be read from the wOUSD contract (function number 16), or via the OUSD dapp.

Current exchange rate as of 8/12/26: 1 wOUSD = 1.30141137 OUSD

**Risk Mitigation**

There are three risks when using OUSD, and Origin is making sure to reduce each risk as much as possible:

*Smart contract risk of the yield strategies* - Origin is only using platforms for yield generation that have a proven track record, have been audited, have billions in TVL, maintain a bug bounty program, and provide over-collateralized loans. Over-collateralization in itself, combined with liquidations, provides a reasonable level of security for lenders.

*Stablecoin risk* - Origin has chosen USDC, one of the largest stablecoins to ever exist, to back OUSD, and it has stood the test of time and maintained its peg quite well through multiple bull and bear cycles. It has also demonstrated significant growth in circulating supply, so the Origin team is confident that USDC will maintain its peg and that OUSD will remain stable. OUSD also uses a Chainlink oracle for pricing data for USDC to ensure accurate pricing at all times. If USDC falls below its $1 peg, [OIP-4 disables minting](https://github.com/OriginProtocol/origin-dollar/issues/1000) of additional OUSD tokens using the de-pegged asset.

*Smart contract risk of OUSD* - Origin is taking every step possible to be proactive and lessen the chance of losing funds. Security reviews of OUSD are prioritized over new feature development, with regular audits being done, and multiple engineers are required to review each code change with a detailed checklist. A 48-hour timelock goes into effect before protocol upgrades are launched, and deep dives into the exploits of other protocols are constantly being done to make sure the same exploits don’t exist on Origin contracts. Security is extremely important to the Origin team. 12+ audits have been done on the OUSD codebase since 2020, all of which can be seen on [Audits - OUSD.](https://docs.originprotocol.com/security-and-risk/audits) Origin also holds a top three spot on the [Immunefi leaderboard](https://immunefi.com/bug-bounty/?sort=medianResponseTime%3Aasc) for average response time for bug bounty submissions, and maintains a $1m bug bounty.

**Contracts being called**

- [USDC](https://etherscan.io/token/0xA0b86991c6218b36c1d19d4a2e9eb0ce3606eb48) ‘approve’ (approves the usage of the USDC from the wallet) 
- [OUSD vault](https://etherscan.io/address/0xe75d77b1865ae93c7eaa3040b038d7aa7bc02f70#code) ‘mint’ (receives OUSD using USDC at a 1:1 rate) 
- [OUSD](https://etherscan.io/token/0x2A8e1E676Ec238d8A992307B495b45B3fEAa5e86) ‘approve’ (approves the usage of the OUSD from the wallet) 
- [wOUSD](https://etherscan.io/token/0xD2af830E8CBdFed6CC11Bab697bB25496ed6FA62) ‘deposit’ (wraps OUSD into wOUSD)

title: BOT-14: Strategic Allocation in Atoms
body:
# TLDR

This proposal allocates 400,000 USDC from the DAO treasury to acquire equity exposure to Atoms, the physical automation company led by Uber cofounder Travis Kalanick, at a $16.75 billion post money valuation.

Atoms recently announced a $1.7 billion equity investment led by a16z, with Ben Horowitz joining the board, and consolidated its businesses into a single Atoms equity structure.

Unlike the DAO’s existing humanoid portfolio companies, Atoms focuses on what it calls gainfully employed robots, specialized machines designed for productive work across food, mining, and transportation. Its portfolio combines operating businesses with physical automation, including CloudKitchens, Otter, Lab37, and Pronto.

The allocation expands the DAO’s exposure into a complementary layer of Physical AI, adding specialized automation and operating infrastructure alongside its existing positions in general purpose humanoid robotics.

![DAO Portal Highlights (1280 x 499 px) (1).png](ipfs://bafkreich35hldtfqfrrg5fta3gz3u3hpgeficvnzgrm2ip5stna2cwvqz4)

# Executive Summary

Atoms is a physical automation company led by Travis Kalanick, cofounder and former CEO of Uber. The company emerged from City Storage Systems, where Kalanick became CEO in 2018. After operating with limited public visibility for eight years, the company adopted the Atoms identity in 2026 and expanded its strategy across Food, Mining, and Transport.

Atoms takes a different approach to Physical AI than the general purpose humanoid companies that currently form the core of the DAO’s robotics portfolio. Rather than developing a single machine designed to perform many tasks, Atoms focuses on what it calls gainfully employed robots, specialized machines designed around specific, economically productive workflows.

The group combines established operating businesses with emerging automation platforms. CloudKitchens provides food infrastructure, Otter provides restaurant software, Lab37 develops food automation systems, and Pronto develops autonomous haulage technology for mines and quarries. Together, these businesses give Atoms direct exposure to the physical environments where its automation systems are intended to operate.

For the DAO, Atoms represents exposure to a complementary layer of the Physical AI ecosystem. While the treasury’s core conviction remains centered on general purpose humanoids, Atoms adds exposure to specialized automation already being deployed across productive physical environments, broadening the portfolio across both technology approach and commercial maturity.

# Company and Technology Overview

Atoms organizes its operations across three areas, Food, Mining, and Transport. Across these businesses, the company applies software, robotics, and automation to physical industries where repetitive workflows create opportunities for purpose built systems.

Atoms Food includes CloudKitchens, Otter, Lab37, Picnic, and ProFood. CloudKitchens provides delivery focused kitchen infrastructure, while Otter provides software for restaurant orders, delivery platforms, and kitchen operations, with the company reporting more than 100,000 restaurants worldwide. Lab37 develops automated food preparation systems, including its Bowl Builder, while Picnic operates an office catering business and ProFood focuses on food related real estate.

Atoms Mining operates through Pronto, which develops autonomous haulage systems for mines and quarries. Its technology can be retrofitted across trucks from multiple manufacturers. At Heidelberg Materials’ Lake Bridgeport quarry in Texas, autonomous trucks using Pronto technology hauled more than 2 million tons of limestone over eight months. The companies have since entered a broader agreement covering more than 100 trucks across more than 12 sites, although this represents a planned rollout rather than the current deployed fleet.

Atoms Transport remains earlier in development. The company has not yet introduced a public product, although it is building a vehicle, hardware, and firmware team in San Francisco. This leaves Transport as the least commercially validated of the group’s three principal areas today.

# Strategic Rationale

Atoms combines operating businesses with physical automation, giving the company direct access to the environments where its systems are developed and deployed. This creates a model where automation can be tested against real commercial workflows while generating physical world data through paid activity across restaurants, kitchens, and industrial operations.

A significant part of the investment case is Travis Kalanick. At Uber, he demonstrated an ability to build and scale a technology enabled physical network across global markets. At Atoms, he is applying that operating experience to a broader set of physical industries, combining software, infrastructure, robotics, and automation under a single platform.

The company’s $1.7 billion financing led by a16z, with Ben Horowitz joining the board, provides further institutional validation at an important stage of its development. If Atoms can successfully scale its operating model across industries, the combination of physical infrastructure, automation, and proprietary operational data could become a meaningful advantage.

Given the $16.75 billion post money valuation and limited consolidated financial disclosure, the proposed 400,000 USDC allocation provides meaningful exposure to that potential while maintaining disciplined position sizing.

# The Deal

The DAO has secured access to invest 400,000 USDC in Atoms at a $16.75 billion post-money valuation through a single-layer SPV.

**Transaction Details**  
• Allocation: 400,000 USDC  
• Post Money Valuation: $16.75 billion  
• Instrument: Single layer SPV

**Fee Structure**  
• Participation Fee: 9%, applied upfront and paid to the SPV manager  
• Carried Interest: None  
• Ongoing Management Fees: None  
• Additional Transaction Costs USDC to USD conversion, off ramping, and wire transfer fees, expected to remain under $4,000 USDC

No portion of these fees are retained by the DAO, its members, or any internal working unit.

# Potential Liquidity Events

While no liquidity outcome is guaranteed, several potential paths could emerge as Atoms scales its operating businesses and automation platforms.

**_Initial Public Offering_**  
If Atoms successfully scales its businesses across Food, Mining, and Transport and develops sufficient financial and operating maturity, a future public listing could provide a liquidity path for shareholders.

**_Strategic Acquisition_**  
Atoms operates across restaurant software, food infrastructure, industrial autonomy, and transportation. These assets could attract strategic interest from technology or industrial companies seeking capabilities in physical automation. Given Atoms’ consolidated equity structure, any potential transaction would depend on the structure and scope of the acquisition.

**_Secondary Liquidity_**  
Future financing rounds may create opportunities for secondary liquidity as the company matures and its shareholder base expands. Any such transaction would remain subject to market conditions, company approvals, and the terms of the SPV.

Any decision to liquidate or partially exit the position will require DAO deliberation and formal governance approval.

# Key Risks & Considerations

**_Valuation and Financial Disclosure_**  
The investment is being offered at a $16.75 billion post money valuation, while Atoms does not publicly disclose consolidated revenue, profitability, or detailed unit economics, limiting visibility into current financial performance.

**_Execution Risk_**  
Atoms is pursuing an ambitious strategy across Food, Mining, and Transport. Several businesses are commercially active, but newer automation initiatives remain early and will require significant execution to reach scale.

**_Conglomerate Complexity_**  
Atoms combines seven businesses with different operating models, capital requirements, and stages of maturity. Successfully integrating them under a common automation strategy introduces additional operational complexity.

**_Key Person Risk_**  
Travis Kalanick is central to the company’s strategy and operating model. His leadership is a significant part of the investment thesis, creating corresponding dependence on his continued involvement.

**_Liquidity Risk_**  
The investment should be considered a long term, illiquid private market position, with no assurance of an IPO, acquisition, or future secondary liquidity.

# Mitigating Factors

**_Commercial Validation_**  
Atoms already operates businesses across food infrastructure, restaurant software, and industrial automation, reducing reliance on future products alone.

**_Real World Deployment_**  
Pronto has demonstrated autonomous haulage at Heidelberg Materials’ Lake Bridgeport quarry, with more than 2 million tons of limestone hauled autonomously over eight months.

**_Institutional Backing_**  
Atoms recently raised $1.7 billion in equity led by a16z, with Ben Horowitz joining the board and participation from established investors including Uber and Fifth Wall.

**_Founder Experience_**  
Travis Kalanick has demonstrated an ability to build and scale a technology enabled physical network across global markets, experience directly relevant to the operational ambitions of Atoms.

**_Integrated Operating Model_**  
Atoms owns or operates within many of the environments it seeks to automate, creating direct access to commercial workflows and real world operational data.

## Governance Execution

If approved, the DAO’s Execution Engine will:

1.  Finalize terms and compliance with the intermediary.
    
2.  Coordinate legal and treasury operations for the transaction.
    
3.  Document the full transaction flow with a transparent paper trail for auditability.
    
4.  Complete third party attestation confirming ownership of the underlying equity exposure, in accordance with DAO standards.
    

All treasury activity will be trackable on dao.xmaquina.io for transparency and accountability.

-The Northstar Council

title: SCP-223: Change the rFOX 5% Burn to a 5% FOX Buyback
body:
SCP-223: Change the rFOX 5% Burn to a 5% FOX Buyback
Summary
Stop burning the rFOX 5% and instead buy FOX with it instead. Same 5% of revenue, same monthly cadence, same market impact on the buy side. The only difference is that the FOX ends up in the treasury as an asset instead of at a burn address.

Abstract
Every month, when the rFOX revenue share runs, 5% of revenue goes toward FOX that gets burned. This proposal changes how that portion of the revs is used. At the same point in the monthly rFOX distribution cycle, we swap into FOX on the open market using ETH or another low slippage asset, and keep that FOX to go towards ongoing expenses and for DAO contribituros. Nothing changes for rFOX stakers, and nothing changes about how much revenue is set aside.

Motivation
The DFC is watching runway closely, and 5% a month adds up faster than it sounds. At 2026 average revenue, holding that 5% of revenue in FOX covers almost an extra month of expense and runway over the next 18 months. That’s a meaningful number for a DAO in austerity. We are trimming workstream budgets and scrutinizing every line item, this will add up over time.

Specification
When the monthly rFOX revenue share executes, the 5% currently allocated to the burn is instead used to buy FOX on the open market.
Funding asset: ETH or another low slippage loss asset already held from revenue
Execution: TWAP when the month’s revenue supports it, otherwise the lowest slippage swap option available through the platform
Destination: Ethereum Shapeshift Treasury: 0x90A48D5CF7343B08dA12E067680B4C6dbfE551Be
Cadence: monthly, alongside the existing rFOX revenue share actions
No change to the rFOX reward rate, the revenue share percentage, or the staker experience. This only redirects the 5% that currently goes to the burn address.

Benefits
• Keep an extra 5% of the revenue generated each month
• Additional volume and buy pressure each month.
• Small win for FOX LPs. Predictable, recurring buy volume they can count on.
• Treasury flexibility. FOX in the treasury can be used later. FOX at a burn address cannot.
Drawbacks
• FOX is no longer deflationary.
• The Volume could get gamified. Using a TWAP and varying execution helps, but it doesn’t eliminate the risk.
• Optics. Buybacks that sit in the treasury are a weaker headline than burns, even when they’re better for the balance sheet.

Vote
For: Change the rFOX FOX burn to a FOX buyback.
Against: Continue to Burn

## Nouns DAO Proposal 990 — Signal Vote

Source: https://nouns.wtf/vote/990  
Proposer: 0x0081e6f9373c1ffb7d7fc702eb15ac805eb50389

### TLDR
インドネシアの観光地 Noyo Gimbal View に、Nounishな電動スクーターを5台追加する提案。  
完成済みの試作車と合わせて計6台を設置し、料金必須ではない「Pay-What-You-Can」方式で提供する。  
来場者が実際に見て、触れて、乗れるNounsの公共体験をつくり、新規層への認知拡大を目指す。

### 概要
提案者でありNoyo Gimbal Viewの管理者でもあるDegumaが、同施設のクリエイティブチームとともに、Nounishキャラクターをデザインした電動スクーター5台を製作・運営する。

同施設には月間約29,000人が訪れ、すでに「NOUNS Scooter Zebra」の試作車1台が完成し、来場者によるテストも行われている。本提案では追加の5台を製作し、既存の保管設備を利用して計6台を配備する。

利用料は固定せず、来場者が支払える額を任意で拠出する「Pay-What-You-Can」方式とする。支払いが難しい来場者も無料で利用でき、集まった拠出金は修理、充電、交換部品、安全装備、再塗装などの運営・維持費に充てる。提案者は来場者からの拠出金を個人利益として受け取らない。

拠出金が不足する場合は、Noyo Gimbal Viewが維持・修理費を補助する。また、同施設は完成済み試作車の製作費を負担する。提案者は利用者数、拠出総額、維持費、車両状態、来場者の利用状況などを写真・動画とともにNounsコミュニティへ報告する。

### 予算
総額：7,015米ドル  
内訳：NOUNS Scooter 5台 × 1,403米ドル  
完成済み試作車の製作費はNoyo Gimbal Viewが負担する。

### イベント
- 助成承認後、追加5台を製作、Nounishデザイン、安全・運用テストを実施
- 完成目標：3か月
- 計6台をNoyo Gimbal Viewへ配備し、「Pay-What-You-Can」方式で運用開始

body:
**Background  **
The DAO requires ongoing development and technical services in connection with its products, systems, blockchain-related infrastructure, and other operational needs.  
To ensure continuity of such development activities and secure the necessary development resources in advance, the DAO proposes making an advance payment to BLUEBELT Co., Ltd. for development costs to be incurred in providing services to the DAO.

**Purpose of This Proposal  **
This proposal is submitted to the DAO for approval of an advance payment of 300,000 USDT to BLUEBELT Co., Ltd. for development-related costs.  
The advance payment shall be applied toward actual development costs and related service fees incurred by BLUEBELT Co., Ltd. in connection with services provided to the DAO.  
BLUEBELT Co., Ltd. shall maintain appropriate records of the costs incurred and shall provide reasonable supporting documentation upon request by the DAO.

**Resolutions  **
*The DAO hereby resolves:  *
To approve an advance payment of 300,000 USDT to BLUEBELT Co., Ltd. for development costs.  
To authorize the payment to be transferred to the following wallet address:  
Wallet Address:  
**0xf1626b7f0514ea69949fb1d37da704cd1722d95f  **
To authorize the appropriate DAO representatives to execute and complete the transfer following approval of this resolution.  
To require BLUEBELT Co., Ltd. to apply the advance payment solely toward development-related costs and associated service fees for services provided to the DAO.  
To require BLUEBELT Co., Ltd. to maintain and, upon reasonable request, disclose records supporting the use and allocation of the advance payment.  
Any unused portion of the advance payment shall remain subject to reconciliation between the DAO and BLUEBELT Co., Ltd.

**Effective Date  **
This resolution shall become effective upon approval in accordance with the DAO’s applicable governance and voting procedures.  
Upon approval, the DAO shall be authorized to proceed with the transfer of 300,000 USDT to the wallet address specified above.

title: (STA) Product
body:
# **Summary**

This TIP proposes a demand-driven expansion of the $TRUE supply to conduct an at-the-money sale targeting $4M.

The sale price will be determined using TRUE’s 30-day moving average at the time the sale is initiated. It will be conducted via an NFT mint, where each NFT will be redeemable for a set amount of $TRUE.

The supply expansion is a direct function of the market demand for $TRUE.

If there is no demand, no $TRUE will be issued. If there is maximum demand, up to $4M TRUE will be issued.

An additional 25M TRUE will be minted for the protocol as part of a strategic reserve.

- **Note**: While the TRUE token mint function is callable, it is gated by a 45-day timelock and subject to governance approval. Any new TRUE issuance takes at least 45 days to take effect.

# **Rationale**

The case for Prediction Markets is stronger now than ever as growth in event contracts continues its acceleration.

While uniquely differentiated from other prediction market apps, Trueo has raised markedly less capital than its competitors.

With the flagship product now live, this is the time to focus on growth.

Raising at the current stage would provide the project with the resources needed to grow liquidity, accelerate distribution, and develop new products while maintaining a meaningful runway that enables Trueo to compete with well-capitalized competitors.

The structure proposed below is intended to balance the need for a fresh capital raise with the needs of existing TRUE holders.

The raise will be entirely demand driven.

Rather than an arbitrary supply increase regardless of demand, this proposal makes supply expansion strictly contingent on actual subscriptions.

If demand is strong enough to raise the full $4M, the protocol can raise the full target.

If demand is weaker, the protocol raises less capital and correspondingly expands supply by less.

The strategic reserve provides Trueo with additional flexibility for future initiatives while keeping that issuance separate from the sale target.

The result is a supply expansion mechanism that is demand-driven, capped at $4M, and fully transparent.

# **Trueo Today**

Trueo has evolved significantly since launch, and has become a fully-integrated permissionless prediction market platform.

From market creation, to trading, to resolution, Trueo permissionlessly manages the entire life cycle of an event contract.

The foundational layers required to make this architecture work have been built over the past year:

**Multi-stage optimistic oracle**

- Dispute resolution system incorporating automation, economic stake, and human judgment in one model

**TYD (True Yield Dollar)**

- Yield bearing collateral enabling yield-bearing markets, reducing the cost of capital, and making long duration contracts viable

**PM-AMM**

- A custom UniswapV4 hook which maps the core features of a traditional prediction market orderbook onto Uniswap’s price curve
- Supports both limit orders and ranged liquidity

**User Created Markets** **+ Launch Pad**

- flagship feature and the most mature product of its kind
- integrated with multiple AI models, enabling users to generate context aware prediction markets for virtually any event imaginable
- permissionless launchpad contracts and built-in graduation mechanism to filter spam and seed liquidity

# **Sale Mechanics**

Each NFT represents a fixed amount of $TRUE based on the 30-day moving average price.

The amount of TRUE minted is determined solely by actual demand, up to the $4M target.

For every $1 in subscriptions:

- The corresponding amount of TRUE will be issued
- An additional 25M TRUE issued into the strategic reserve

Any NFTs that are not sold will not be minted, and the corresponding TRUE will NOT be issued.

**Examples**

**If TRUE’s 30-day moving average is $0.05:**

- $4M target = **80M TRUE** for sale
- Maximum new issuance = **105M TRUE**

If only $1M is subscribed:

- **20M TRUE** issued and sold
- **45M TRUE** total new issuance

If $0 is subscribed:

- **Zero TRUE** issued and sold
- **25M TRUE** total new issuance

**If TRUE’s 30-day moving average is $0.025:**

- $4M target = **160M TRUE** for sale
- Maximum new issuance = **185M TRUE**

If only $1M is subscribed:

- **40M TRUE** issued and sold
- **65M TRUE** total new issuance

If $0 is subscribed:

- **Zero TRUE** issued and sold
- **25M TRUE** total new issuance

# **Proposal Breakdown**

Pending governance approval, the proposal advances in 5 stages:

1. An NFT sale targeting up to **$4M** in subscriptions at TRUE’s 30-day moving average price.
2. Minting TRUE in proportion to NFTs actually sold.
3. Issuing an additional 25M TRUE for a strategic reserve.
4. Unminted NFTs and their corresponding TRUE will be excluded from the supply expansion.
5. Distributing pro rata TRUE allocations to NFT holders

# **Strategic Reserve**

In addition to the TRUE allocated to NFT purchasers, the protocol will mint an amount equal to 25% of the existing TRUE supply into a designated strategic reserve.

The reserve is intended for staking/oracle incentives in the new TRUE staking mechanism, as well as other strategic uses:

- Staking rewards
- Tokenomics flywheel
- Strategic partnerships
- Builder grants
- Trading incentives

The reserve will not be distributed as part of the NFT sale. It will be issued separately pending the approval of this proposal.

The purpose of the reserve is to provide Trueo with an additional pool of TRUE that can be deployed strategically in the future without requiring another supply expansion.

title: Snapshot 13: Expanding tETH Redemption Access via Treehouse NFTs
body:
## Summary

This proposal seeks DAO approval to introduce a new redemption feature that allows **tETH** holders who own a Treehouse Squirrel Council NFT to tender it to the Treehouse treasury in exchange for a one-time **Normal Track redemption without the existing 50 wstETH minimum threshold**.

All other Normal Track redemption mechanics, including the prevailing tETH exchange rate and withdrawal period, will remain unchanged. Each Treehouse Squirrel Council NFT may only be tendered once and will be permanently transferred to the Treehouse treasury upon use.

## Motivation

While the 50 wstETH Normal Track minimum supports protocol liquidity management, it limits access to this redemption pathway for mid-sized tETH holders who fall below the threshold.

Introducing a Treehouse Squirrel Council NFT tender mechanism would:

-   Expand access to Normal Track redemption for eligible tETH holders below the 50 wstETH minimum
    
-   Reward early community members and Treehouse Squirrel Council NFT holders with meaningful, tangible utility
    
-   Strengthen the utility of the Treehouse Squirrel Council NFT collection within the broader Treehouse ecosystem
    
-   Deepen alignment between Treehouse's NFT community and its core protocol mechanics
    

No changes are made to existing redemption tracks or parameters. This proposal introduces an additive feature that expands optionality without affecting existing mechanics.

## Specification

If approved, this proposal will:

-   Allow a tETH holder to tender an eligible Treehouse Squirrel Council NFT to the Treehouse treasury (0xc5bfcbd72f9846138d6094f4236c0711dc28c670) via a smart contract interaction
    
-   Grant the tendering user eligibility for one Normal Track redemption without the 50 wstETH minimum threshold
    
-   Limit each NFT to a single use, with ownership permanently transferred to the Treehouse treasury upon tendering
    
-   Maintain all other Normal Track redemption mechanics and risk parameters
    

The DAO retains authority to revise, suspend, or discontinue this mechanism through future governance proposals.

## Risk Considerations

This mechanism may increase Normal Track redemption activity among tETH holders whose positions fall below the existing 50 wstETH threshold.

The following mitigations apply:

-   All existing Normal Track redemption mechanics and safety parameters remain in place
    
-   The mechanic is limited to holders of the Treehouse Squirrel Council NFTs, with a total supply of 1,000 NFTs currently in circulation
    
-   Dynamic liquidity management across existing redemption tracks remains unchanged
    
-   DAO authority to revise or suspend this mechanic through governance if redemption conditions materially change
    

## Implementation

If approved, the DAO assigns Treehouse Protocol to:

1.  Develop and deploy a smart contract to accept eligible Treehouse Squirrel Council NFT tenders and register the associated Normal Track redemption eligibility
    
2.  Submit the relevant smart contract(s) for security audit before deployment
    
3.  Update the tETH redemption interface to support the Treehouse Squirrel Council NFT tender option
    
4.  Monitor redemption activity and liquidity conditions following implementation
    

## Voting Options

-   For — Approve the introduction of the Treehouse Squirrel Council NFT tender mechanic for one-time Normal Track redemption without the 50 wstETH minimum threshold
    
-   Against — Reject the proposal
    
-   Abstain — Record sentiment without voting for or against
    

## Vote Outcomes

**If FOR passes:**  
The Treehouse Squirrel Council NFT tender mechanic will be implemented, allowing eligible tETH holders to tender a Treehouse Squirrel Council NFT to the Treehouse treasury in exchange for one Normal Track redemption without the 50 wstETH minimum threshold.

**If AGAINST passes:**  
No changes will be made to the current tETH redemption framework.

**If ABSTAIN:**  
No direct effect; recorded for sentiment but not counted toward quorum.

title: [Prop 991] Cancel the Endaoment Stream
body:
# Cancel the Endaoment Stream

Hello Nouners,

I'd like to propose that we cancel the 120 WETH charity stream to Endaoment that was passed in Prop 471, and return the unstreamed balance to the Treasury.

Prop 471 committed 120 WETH over 10 years, about 12 ETH per year until November 2033 — to Endaoment's Universal Impact Pool. I don't think a decade-long automated stream is the right way for us to be charitable, for two reasons.

**First, we already give directly, and we do it well.** The most recent example is Prop 960, "Party Under the Sea", where we funded a real charitable project with a USDC grant that the DAO voted on with full context. Direct grants let us decide the cause, the amount, and the recipient at the time we give, on the merits of each one. A standing 10-year pipe to a single intermediary does the opposite, it pre-commits our Treasury years in advance and takes that decision away from the Nouners who come after us.

**Second, the capital does nothing while it waits.** The 88.55 WETH still inside this stream is locked in the stream contract and drips out slowly through 2033, earning no yield for us while it sits there. Returned to the Treasury, it can be put back to work alongside our primary staked assets (wstETH, mETH, rETH, and WETH) at our current ~2% staked yield, and it stays available for us to deploy, including on charity, directly - whenever we choose.

Here is the stream today:

### The Endaoment stream (Prop 471)

| Description | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Total committed | 120 WETH |
| Streamed to date (~26%) | 31.9 WETH |
| Remaining in the stream | 88.1 WETH |
| Returned to the Treasury on cancel | 88.1 WETH |

This stops only the unstreamed portion. It does not claw back the WETH already delivered to Endaoment, and it does not touch the ~2 WETH currently vested and claimable.

And here is what that balance is worth to us back in the Treasury:

### Yield on the returned balance

| Description | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Returned to the Treasury | 88.1 WETH |
| Estimated annual yield (2%, accrued daily) | ~1.77 WETH |
| Remaining term (to Nov 2033) | ~7.3 years |
| Estimated yield we forgo by continuing to stream | ~13 WETH |

I believe cancelling this stream and returning 88 WETH to the Treasury will put our capital back to work, keep our charitable giving deliberate and voter-led as it was in Prop 960, and give future Nouners the flexibility that a 10-year lock-in takes away.

Note that the WETH returned here will land in the Treasury as plain WETH, earning nothing until it's deployed. A follow-up maintenance proposal will swap and stake it so it joins our primary staked assets and starts earning the yield described above.

This proposal seeks official BIM DAO approval to integrate Citrea into BIM Exchange and expand BIM's infrastructure into the emerging Bitcoin DeFi ecosystem.

The proposed integration includes:
- Buy
- Sell
- Swap
- Bridge
Citrea-native liquidity aggregation
Access to Bitcoin-focused DeFi infrastructure

The objective is to position BIM Exchange as a major liquidity aggregation and access layer within the Citrea ecosystem while continuing BIM's multi-chain expansion strategy.

This is a formal governance proposal for execution upon approval.

**Context:**
Citrea is a blockchain infrastructure designed to expand Bitcoin's capabilities by enabling programmable financial applications and DeFi functionality connected to the Bitcoin ecosystem.

Citrea combines Bitcoin-oriented infrastructure with zero-knowledge technology and EVM-compatible execution, creating an environment where developers can build applications such as:

- Decentralized exchanges
- Lending and borrowing protocols
- Stablecoin infrastructure
- Yield strategies
- Bitcoin-backed financial applications
- Cross-chain liquidity solutions

For BIM Exchange, Citrea represents an opportunity to expand beyond traditional EVM ecosystems and strengthen BIM's exposure to Bitcoin-native DeFi.

Why Citrea?
Bitcoin represents the largest pool of capital in the cryptocurrency industry.

However, compared with EVM ecosystems, a significant portion of Bitcoin liquidity remains underutilized within decentralized finance.

Citrea aims to expand the utility of Bitcoin by enabling programmable financial applications around the Bitcoin ecosystem.

Integrating Citrea would therefore allow BIM Exchange to position itself early within this emerging market and potentially capture new users, liquidity, transaction volume, and protocol revenue.

**Proposal Details:**
1️⃣ Buy Integration

Enable users to access supported Citrea ecosystem assets through BIM Exchange's Buy infrastructure and compatible payment providers.

Objectives:
- Simplify onboarding into the Citrea ecosystem
- Increase accessibility for retail users
- Generate additional Buy transaction volume

2️⃣ Sell Integration

Enable users to sell supported Citrea ecosystem assets through BIM Exchange.

Objectives:
- Provide complete entry and exit infrastructure
- Improve accessibility to Citrea liquidity
- Generate additional Sell transaction volume

3️⃣ Swap Integration

Integrate Citrea-native liquidity sources into BIM Exchange's aggregation infrastructure.
BIM Exchange would aggregate available liquidity and routing sources to identify competitive execution routes for users.

Objectives:
- Aggregate Citrea liquidity
- Improve swap execution
- Increase protocol volume
- Generate additional revenue for BIM DAO

4️⃣ Bridge Integration

Enable bridge functionality between Citrea and compatible networks supported by BIM Exchange.

The long-term objective is to facilitate liquidity movement across:

Bitcoin ↔ Citrea ↔ EVM ecosystems

Actual routes will depend on the bridge infrastructure available and validated by BIM Labs at the time of deployment.

Security and technical validation will be required before any bridge provider is activated.

5️⃣ Citrea Liquidity Aggregation

BIM Exchange aims to become a leading liquidity and DEX aggregator within the Citrea ecosystem.

Rather than competing directly with individual decentralized exchanges, BIM's strategy is to aggregate available liquidity sources and provide users with optimized access through a unified interface.

This follows BIM Exchange's broader strategy of becoming an:

Aggregator of Aggregators.

Strategic Vision
BIM Exchange's long-term objective is to become:
The OnlyOne DeFi Platform and an Aggregator of Aggregators providing access to:

- Buy
- Sell
- Swap
- Bridge
- Staking

The Citrea integration adds an important new strategic vertical:

Bitcoin DeFi

BIM's objective is not simply to integrate additional blockchains, but to connect major liquidity ecosystems through a single interface.

Potential Benefits

The proposed integration could provide BIM and the DAO with:

- Access to the emerging Bitcoin DeFi ecosystem
- New liquidity sources
- Additional transaction volume
- Increased bridge activity
- Additional protocol revenues
- Greater visibility for BIM Exchange
- Diversification beyond traditional EVM ecosystems
- Early positioning within the Citrea ecosystem
- Exposure to Bitcoin-native users and liquidity

Increased Buy, Sell, Swap and Bridge activity would create additional opportunities to generate recurring revenues for the BIM DAO.

**Treasury Impact**

The integration is intended to create additional protocol activity and revenue opportunities through BIM Exchange.

No specific additional DAO treasury allocation is requested through this BIP.

Any future expenditure requiring DAO treasury funds beyond the existing BIM Labs operational framework would require separate governance authorization where applicable.

**Risks & Considerations**

The integration introduces several risks that must be considered:

- Citrea ecosystem maturity and adoption risk
- Liquidity fragmentation
- Cross-chain bridge security risk
- Smart contract integration risk
- Dependency on third-party infrastructure
- Bitcoin interoperability complexity
- Technical maintenance requirements
- Potential changes in supported infrastructure or liquidity providers

BIM Labs will conduct technical and security validation before production deployment.

Bridge providers and other critical infrastructure will only be activated after appropriate assessment.

Implementation

Upon approval of this BIP, BIM Labs will be authorized to:

- Integrate Citrea into BIM Exchange
- Implement Buy and Sell support through compatible providers
- Integrate Citrea-native liquidity sources
- Enable Swap functionality
- Evaluate and integrate appropriate bridge infrastructure
- Deploy Citrea support within BIM Exchange following technical and security validation
- Expand integrations as the Citrea ecosystem develops

**Voting Options:**
✅ For — Approve BIP056 and authorize the integration of Citrea into BIM Exchange for Buy, Sell, Swap, Bridge and liquidity aggregation.

❌ Against — Reject the Citrea integration proposal.

⚪ Abstain — No position.


**Voting Instructions:**

- Connect to the voting platform using your wallet. 
- Select the proposal regarding the opening of vote submissions.
- Choose the option that you believe best aligns with the vision and strategic objectives of BIM Protocol
 - Confirm your vote.

**Voting Period:**
Voting will begin on [23/08/2026] and conclude on [27/08/2026]

We encourage all BIM token holders to participate in this governance vote.

The integration of Citrea represents an opportunity for BIM Exchange to expand beyond traditional multi-chain DeFi and establish an early position within the emerging Bitcoin DeFi ecosystem.

If approved, BIM Labs will proceed with the technical integration subject to the required security and infrastructure validation.

Discussion (optional): https://governance.bim.finance/t/temp-check-integration-of-citrea-on-bim-exchange/74

## Nouns DAO Proposal 991 — Signal Vote

Source: https://nouns.wtf/vote/991

### TLDR
Proposal 471で承認されたEndaomentへの120 WETHの10年間ストリームを停止する提案。  
未送金分の約88.1 WETHをNouns DAO Treasuryへ返還する。  
返還後のWETHをステーキング資産へ移す処理は、別のメンテナンス提案で行う予定。

Proposal 471では、EndaomentのUniversal Impact Poolへ、2033年11月までの10年間に合計120 WETHを送るストリームが承認された。本提案はこのストリームを解約し、未送金残高をTreasuryへ戻すもの。

これまでに約31.9 WETH（全体の約26%）が送金済みで、残る約88.1 WETHが返還対象となる。すでにEndaomentへ送られたWETHは回収せず、現在権利確定済みで請求可能な約2 WETHにも影響しない。

提案者は、慈善活動ごとにNounersが使途・金額・受取人を判断できる直接助成を維持することと、ストリーム内で利回りを生まない資金をTreasuryで再活用することを目的としている。返還されるWETHは当初そのままTreasuryに入り、ステーキングへの交換・運用は後続提案で実施する予定。

title: Trueo Public Raise Proposal
body:
# **Summary**

This TIP proposes a demand-driven expansion of the $TRUE supply to conduct an at-the-money sale targeting $4M.

The sale price will be determined using TRUE’s 30-day moving average at the time the sale is initiated. It will be conducted via an NFT mint, where each NFT will be redeemable for a set amount of $TRUE.

The supply expansion is a direct function of the market demand for $TRUE.

If there is no demand, no $TRUE will be issued. If there is maximum demand, up to $4M TRUE will be issued.

An additional 25M TRUE will be minted for the protocol as part of a strategic reserve.

-   **Note**: While the TRUE token mint function is callable, it is gated by a 45-day timelock and subject to governance approval. Any new TRUE issuance takes at least 45 days to take effect.
    

# **Rationale**

The case for Prediction Markets is stronger now than ever as growth in event contracts continues its acceleration.

While uniquely differentiated from other prediction market apps, Trueo has raised markedly less capital than its competitors.

With the flagship product now live, this is the time to focus on growth.

Raising at the current stage would provide the project with the resources needed to grow liquidity, accelerate distribution, and develop new products while maintaining a meaningful runway that enables Trueo to compete with well-capitalized competitors.

The structure proposed below is intended to balance the need for a fresh capital raise with the needs of existing TRUE holders.

The raise will be entirely demand driven.

Rather than an arbitrary supply increase regardless of demand, this proposal makes supply expansion strictly contingent on actual subscriptions.

If demand is strong enough to raise the full $4M, the protocol can raise the full target.

If demand is weaker, the protocol raises less capital and correspondingly expands supply by less.

The strategic reserve provides Trueo with additional flexibility for future initiatives while keeping that issuance separate from the sale target.

The result is a supply expansion mechanism that is demand-driven, capped at $4M, and fully transparent.

# **Trueo Today**

Trueo has evolved significantly since launch, and has become a fully-integrated permissionless prediction market platform.

From market creation, to trading, to resolution, Trueo permissionlessly manages the entire life cycle of an event contract.

The foundational layers required to make this architecture work have been built over the past year:

**Multi-stage optimistic oracle**

-   Dispute resolution system incorporating automation, economic stake, and human judgment in one model
    

**TYD (True Yield Dollar)**

-   Yield bearing collateral enabling yield-bearing markets, reducing the cost of capital, and making long duration contracts viable
    

**PM-AMM**

-   A custom UniswapV4 hook which maps the core features of a traditional prediction market orderbook onto Uniswap’s price curve
    
-   Supports both limit orders and ranged liquidity
    

**User Created Markets** **+ Launch Pad**

-   flagship feature and the most mature product of its kind
    
-   integrated with multiple AI models, enabling users to generate context aware prediction markets for virtually any event imaginable
    
-   permissionless launchpad contracts and built-in graduation mechanism to filter spam and seed liquidity
    

# **Sale Mechanics**

Each NFT represents a fixed amount of $TRUE based on the 30-day moving average price.

The amount of TRUE minted is determined solely by actual demand, up to the $4M target.

For every $1 in subscriptions, the corresponding amount of TRUE will be issued.

Any NFTs that are not sold will not be minted, and the corresponding TRUE will NOT be issued.

An additional 25M TRUE will be minted for the protocol as part of a strategic reserve.

**Examples**

**If TRUE’s 30-day moving average is $0.05:**

-   $4M target = **80M TRUE** for sale
    
-   Maximum new issuance = **105M TRUE**
    

If only $1M is subscribed:

-   **20M TRUE** issued and sold
    
-   **45M TRUE** total new issuance
    

If $0 is subscribed:

-   **Zero TRUE** issued and sold
    
-   **25M TRUE** total new issuance
    

**If TRUE’s 30-day moving average is $0.025:**

-   $4M target = **160M TRUE** for sale
    
-   Maximum new issuance = **185M TRUE**
    

If only $1M is subscribed:

-   **40M TRUE** issued and sold
    
-   **65M TRUE** total new issuance
    

If $0 is subscribed:

-   **Zero TRUE** issued and sold
    
-   **25M TRUE** total new issuance
    

# **Proposal Breakdown**

Pending governance approval, the proposal advances in 5 stages:

1.  An NFT sale targeting up to **$4M** in subscriptions at TRUE’s 30-day moving average price.
    
2.  Minting TRUE in proportion to NFTs actually sold.
    
3.  Issuing an additional 25M TRUE for a strategic reserve.
    
4.  Unminted NFTs and their corresponding TRUE will be excluded from the supply expansion.
    
5.  Distributing pro rata TRUE allocations to NFT holders
    

# **Strategic Reserve**

In addition to the TRUE allocated to NFT purchasers, the protocol will mint an amount equal to 25% of the existing TRUE supply into a designated strategic reserve.

The reserve is intended for staking/oracle incentives in the new TRUE staking mechanism, as well as other strategic uses:

-   Staking rewards
    
-   Tokenomics flywheel
    
-   Strategic partnerships
    
-   Builder grants
    
-   Trading incentives
    

The reserve will not be distributed as part of the NFT sale. It will be issued separately pending the approval of this proposal.

The purpose of the reserve is to provide Trueo with an additional pool of TRUE that can be deployed strategically in the future without requiring another supply expansion.

title: Project Caribou — Phase 2 Proposal
body:
### **Summary**

This proposal seeks DAO approval to transition Project Caribou into Phase 2. Following the completion of Phase 1 build and electronics integration, Phase 2 focuses on executing the PT1 flight-test campaign, building an upgraded PT1.5 prototype in the USA featuring modular payload bays, and releasing full open-source community build documentation.

### **Phase 1 & August Interim Progress**

-   **Completed Phase 1 Milestones:** Assembled PT1 (182 kg dry weight), designed and integrated all 3 Caribou PCBs, wrote CBC firmware, and completed powered ground tests with 1% motor matching and zero CAN errors.
    
-   **SORA 2.5 Application Submitted:** The complex SORA 2.5 application has been fully finalized and submitted to regulatory authorities, establishing a legal framework for 12–24 months of flight testing.
    
-   **Folding Arm Connectors Fitted:** PT1 has already been upgraded with foldable motor arm connectors during August, achieving a transport footprint of **1.4 m × 2.4 m**.
    
-   **August Budget Usage:** The remaining safe wallet balance (~5,876 USDC) directly funded the SORA regulatory application process and the PT1 folding arm integration work during August.
    

### **Phase 2 Scope & Deliverables**

1.  **PT1 Flight-Test Campaign:** Complete tethered hover, step-by-step controller tuning, automated waypoint missions, endurance/lift testing, and transition to free flight operations under SORA 2.5.
    
2.  **PT1.5 Build & Flight (USA):** Build an updated iteration in Texas in collaboration with JPL featuring factory folding arms, structural weight reductions, and dual standard payload bays (compatible with DJI Agras T40 liquid/seeding modules).
    
3.  **PT1 Standardization:** Retrofit PT1 to matching PT1.5 structural specs to maintain two standardized test vehicles.
    
4.  **Community Build Release:** Publish full documentation (BOM, build guides, config files, test protocols) enabling independent community fabrication.
    

### **Timeline, Budget & Continuity**

-   **Window:** September 2026 – February 2027 (6 Months).
    
-   **Budget Cap:** Unchanged at $30,000/month ($25,000 labor / $5,000 hardware) in accordance with AIP-007, with no rollover.
    
-   **Partner Funding:** The US build is executed in partnership with JPL, avoiding major additional prototype hardware costs for the DAO.
    
-   **Governance Continuity:** All leadership, team organization, and governance processes remain completely unchanged from the initial project proposal.
    

### **Voting Options**

-   **For:** Approve Phase 2 proposal and funding
    
-   **Against:** Reject Phase 2 proposal
    
-   **Abstain:** Abstain
    

---

-   [Phase 2 Discussion Thread](https://dao.arrowair.com/t/project-caribou-phase-1-review-phase-2-proposal/181)

title: TEMP CHECK: Retroactive Grant for blockful’s Security Work
body:
## Summary

This temp check seeks to determine community consensus regarding a retroactive grant for blockful’s security work benefiting Shutter DAO 0x36, including:

- implementation of the security council and proposer roles
- security platform: https://app.anticapture.com/shu

blockful twice proposed a grant of $150K, and both proposals were not accepted. However, members of the community have stated that blockful’s work has provided meaningful value to Shutter DAO 0x36 and should be recognized through a retroactive grant.

Rather than asking the community to vote on a single proposed amount, this temp check is intended to identify the level of funding that has the broadest support.

## Voting Options

Voters should select one of the following amounts:

- $0
- $25K
- $50K
- $75K
- $100K
- $125K
- $150K

## How the Result Will Be Determined

After voting closes, the median dollar value of all SHU voting power cast will be calculated. 

For example, if the total voting power cast is 20M SHU, the votes are ordered from the lowest selected amount to the highest, and the cumulative voting weight reaches 10M SHU at the $X option, then the median dollar value is $X. 

This approach is intended to measure not simply whether there is support for a grant, but also the amount that best reflects the community’s overall preference.

## Quorum

There is no quorum requirement for this temp check.

## Next Step

That median amount will be used as the proposed retroactive grant amount in a subsequent full onchain proposal, will be subject to the Shutter DAO 0x36’s normal onchain governance requirements.

body:
# [Grove Artifact] Standing Authorization for Uniswap V3 Fee Collection - August 24, 2026

Grove's Operational Facilitator has placed a proposal into the voting system on behalf of nested contributor Grove Development Company.

## Review

If approved, this proposal will update the Grove Artifact with a standing authorization for fee collection, so that a routine `collect` on a Grove-held position does not require a fresh authorization each time. Any change to where collected fees are directed would still be proposed separately.

Grove's Uniswap V3 position accrues trading fees, which are realised by calling `collect` on the Uniswap V3 `NonfungiblePositionManager` through the Grove ALM Proxy. Collection moves fees that have already accrued to Grove into the ALM Proxy. It allocates no new funds, changes no position parameters, and does not alter Grove's exposure.

Each collection to date has been authorized individually, because fee collection currently has no standing basis in the Grove artifact. At least one further collection is required to complete the unwind of the legacy position, and collection recurs for as long as Grove holds a Uniswap V3 position.

### Change summary

- Artifact change: add a standing authorization for fee collection via `collect` on [Uniswap V3 positions](https://etherscan.io/address/0xC36442b4a4522E871399CD717aBDD847Ab11FE88) held by the [Grove ALM Proxy](https://etherscan.io/address/0x491EDFB0B8b608044e227225C715981a30F3A44E), with fees collected to that proxy.

---

The proposed Grove Artifact changes can be found in the following pull request: https://github.com/sky-ecosystem/next-gen-atlas/pull/310

## Outcomes

- If "For" receives the most votes, the proposal will be approved. The associated pull request will be merged into Grove's artifact. When required, the listed changes will proceed to implementation by the relevant actors.
- If "Against" receives the most votes, the proposal will be rejected. No changes will be implemented.

body:
## Intro
This proposal relates to the management of our treasury's stablecoin income over September 2026.

## Description
Since our treasury regularly receives stablecoins (for example, from contributions), this vote is related to the way we're going to invest/use these stablecoins.

#### Currently, our treasury holds the following stablecoins
- 263.92 USDC on Venus ($263.92)
- 195.05 USDC on Aave ($195.05)
- 1.27 BUSD ($1.27)

**Totalling $460.24**

#### As well as the following RPTR-denominated assets
- 24,170,984.54 RPTR
- 999,779.00 RPTR in the RPTR-USDC pool

**Totalling 25,170,763.54 RPTR worth $1,015.18**

In addition to :
- 0.003965364349 WBETH worth $10.86 
- 0.0007899865202 Binance-Peg BTC worth $62.40 
- 0.01425228341 Stader BNBx worth $11.14
- 1234.933236 Klima kVCM worth $17.89

### **For a grand total of $1,755.96**

## Consequences
The stablecoins received by the Raptor Treasury over September 2026 will be used/invested following the results of this proposal :
- "Lend them on Venus" => we'll lend them on Venus
- "Lend them on Aave" => we'll lend them on Aave
- "Buy BTC" => we'll buy BTC and hold it as Binance-Peg BTC on BNB Chain
- "Stake ETH" => we'll buy WBETH on BNB Chain
- "Stake BNB" => we'll stake it through Stader
- "Stake SOL" => we'll stake SOL on Solana, then bridge the mSOL to the Treasury through Wormhole
- "Leave them here for now" => we'll leave them uninvested
- "Buy Toucan Protocol CHAR on Base" => We'll buy CHAR tokens on the secondary market on Base
- "Buy Klima Protocol kVCM on Base" => We'll buy kVCM on the secondary market on Base

Please note that this doesn't apply to the interests accruing on our Venus/Aave positions, since it would require scooping up the yield manually, and paying gas fees. Thus, we're going to let these compound over time.

Additionally, we won't claim the fees from the RPTR-USDC liquidity position every time, since it also requires gas fees, which might be counterproductive (e.g. if the gas fees exceed the claimable amount).

## Other investment ideas
If you think of something that's not listed here, please drop your ideas in our telegram group (the one that's attached below)

Buy Klima Protocol kVCM on Base

title: BIP-116: Beets Gauge Voting Modification and Buyback Programme
body:
## Proposal
Modify the Beets gauge vote with the aim of minimizing BEETS token inflation and introducing a BEETS buyback programme.

## Motivation
The current BEETS gauge vote mechanics have remained relatively unchanged for some time. Gauge votes take place every two weeks, with 420,000 BEETS distributed as LP farming rewards based on the gauge voting results.

By reconfiguring and optimizing the gauge vote, it should be possible to achieve a BEETS tokenomics model with close to zero net new emissions.

Regarding current inflation, approximately 7.6M BEETS tokens were distributed in Q1 2026. If all protocol revenue had been used to buy back BEETS, as is currently being done under the active Q3 budget, approximately 7.4M BEETS could have been bought from the market. This would have resulted in net inflation of approximately 140,000 BEETS tokens for Q1. For Q2, these figures were approximately 6.4M BEETS distributed, 5.7M BEETS that could have been bought back, and 650,000 BEETS of net inflation, respectively.

The following changes are proposed for the gauge vote:
1. Reduce the amount of BEETS distributed based on gauge vote results to 300,000 BEETS.
2. Limit eligible gauge vote pools to fee-generating and/or strategically important pools, at MD's discretion.

In addition, this BIP proposes introducing a BEETS buyback programme. Together with the aforementioned changes to the gauge vote, this should ensure that more BEETS tokens are bought from the market than are distributed.

Given the current liquidity pool balances and the experience from previous revenue buybacks, even relatively small buybacks can have a tangible.

The following is proposed for the buyback programme:
1. Use up to $4,000 per month to buy back BEETS from the open market.
2. The bought BEETS will be stored in the DAO treasury.
3. The exact buyback method and amount will remain at MD's discretion.

## Impacts/Risk Assessment
The gauge vote modification and buyback programme should result in the protocol buying back more BEETS from the open market than it distributes. This should reduce net BEETS inflation and, all else being equal, create upward pressure on the BEETS token price.

The changes to the gauge vote may make it more difficult for external protocols to have their pools included. However, there have not been any external bribes for some time, and MD's discretionary budget could accommodate any strategically important partnerships if needed.

The buyback programme will use DAO treasury funds, which currently amount to approximately $900,000.

## Specification/Execution Plan
The gauge vote modifications will take effect at the next gauge vote following the passage of this BIP.

The buyback programme will begin in the same month in which the BIP passes.

title: 56# Increase WBTC and cbBTC market caps to $50M
body: Raise the deposit caps of the yb-WBTC (market 7) and yb-cbBTC (market 8) markets to $50M each, up from ~$32M and ~$43.5M. Both markets are currently at or above their cap and therefore accept no new deposits. Since a cap equals the market's crvUSD allocation divided by 2 (the markets run at 2x leverage), this sets the crvUSD allocation of each of the two markets to $100M, moving ~$36M and ~$13M of crvUSD respectively out of the Factory reserve (~$717M) and into the markets.

title: [NMPIP 265 - Part A - Re Investment] Fern Re Formation, Capital Commitment & Governance Approval
body:
## Summary

This NMPIP is broken up into two parts. 

Part A - The redemption of the DAO's existing investment in Re (made ahead of the launch of Re's reUSDe token) and its reallocation, partly back into reUSDe and partly toward the Fern Re capital commitment.

Part B - The ownership, capitalization, and leadership structure of Fern Re (Cayman based entity). and Fern Speciality Ltd (UK based entity).

The full context of both proposals is as follows

Following on from NMPIP-262 (Bridging Capital to Traditional Markets), DAO members and the Foundation team have made significant progress toward establishing a regulated reinsurance entity aligned with the Nexus Mutual protocol. An application for a B(iii) Reinsurance Licence in the Cayman Islands has now been submitted for Fern Re.

These actions bring the wider Nexus Mutual ecosystem a step closer to establishing a fully licensed reinsurance vehicle owned by the DAO and its legal wrapper, while continuing to deepen the relationship with Re through initiatives including the Real-World Insurance Vault.

---

## Background

NMPIP-262 gave the Advisory Board a mandate to pursue regulatory approval for building regulated insurance cells on top of the Mutual, with the intention of diversifying the DAO's risk exposure and unlocking additional sustainable sources of return, while preserving the Mutual's primary function as an onchain discretionary mutual.

Since then, the project team has:

* Established the most appropriate jurisdiction and structure. Being a Cayman Islands reinsurance entity, Fern Re, sponsored by Terrapin International Foundation (the Panamanian foundation that wraps Nexus Mutual DAO).
* Submitted a formal application to the Cayman Islands Monetary Authority (CIMA) for a B(iii) Reinsurance Licence.
* Worked through the initial capital structure, governance, and staffing required to operate Fern Re as a standalone regulated entity in its first phase, ahead of deeper onchain integration.
* Set up Fern Specialty Limited, a UK service company intended to provide operational services to Fern Re.

Separately, the DAO holds an existing investment with Re, made prior to the launch of Re's reUSDe token. That investment is coming to the end of its intended lifecycle and has performed well, and the project team believes now is the right time to redeem it and redeploy some of the proceeds.

---

## Part A — Re Investment: Redemption & Reallocation

The Mutual's [existing investment with Re](https://forum.nexusmutual.io/t/nmpip-grant-advisory-board-the-power-to-enter-into-investment-and-retrocession-agreement-with-cover-re/1315) was made prior to the launch of Re's reUSDe token and is now approaching the end of its intended lifecycle. The investment has performed well, growing from $12m to approximately $14.2m, a return of over $2m.

### Proposal

* Withdraw the full existing Re investment (~$14.2m).
* Reallocate $9m back into reUSDe, maintaining the Mutual's exposure to Re's yield-bearing product in its current, tokenized form.
* Direct the remainder (~$5.2m) toward the Fern Re capital commitment described in Part 1, subject to the $5m surplus note cap approved above, and source the remaining required funds from USDC in the capital pool.

The Mutual continues to work closely with Re on other initiatives, including the Real-World Insurance Vault, and members should expect further updates and proposals related to this relationship over the coming months.

---

## What Members Are Being Asked to Approve

The Members are being asked in addition to the authority previously granted under Governance Votes 262, to confirm, approve and authorise the following:

1. Redemption of the existing Re investment (~US$14.2 million).
2. Allocation of US$9 million into reUSDe.
